title: Erlang Factory 2014 - That's 'Billion' with a 'B': Scaling to the Next Level at WhatsApp
title_zh: Erlang Factory 2014 - 是“十亿”的 B：WhatsApp 的下一级扩展
summary_zh: WhatsApp 的 Rick Reed 在 Erlang Factory 2014 上解释服务如何以极小的工程团队扩展到数十亿条消息。内容涵盖 FreeBSD 与 Erlang 技术栈、Mnesia 使用、服务器数量和瓶颈优化。
why_zh: 展示 Erlang 如何让小团队运营大型消息系统的首选演讲。
summary: Rick Reed of WhatsApp explains at Erlang Factory 2014 how the service scaled to billions of messages with a very small engineering team. He covers the FreeBSD and Erlang stack, Mnesia usage, server counts and bottleneck work.
why_hn: The go-to talk showing how Erlang let a tiny team run a massive messaging system.

title: Fear the Boom and Bust: Keynes vs. Hayek - The Original Economics Rap Battle!
title_zh: 恐惧繁荣与萧条：Keynes vs. Hayek - 原版经济学说唱对决！
summary_zh: 一场 John Maynard Keynes 与 F. A. Hayek 之间的说唱对决，辩论繁荣与萧条的原因、刺激政策和救助。由 Econstories 制作，用于讲解两大思想流派。
why_zh: HN 推荐它作为关于凯恩斯主义与奥地利学派商业周期观点有趣、准确且易懂的入门。
summary: A rap battle in which John Maynard Keynes and F. A. Hayek debate the causes of boom and bust, stimulus, and bailouts. It was produced by Econstories to teach the two schools of thought.
why_hn: HN recommends it as a funny, accurate and easy primer on Keynesian versus Austrian views of the business cycle.

title: A Tour of the Acme Editor
title_zh: Acme 编辑器巡览
summary_zh: Russ Cox 用 23 分钟带看 Plan 9 的 Acme 文本编辑器，展示其鼠标驱动界面、从文本执行命令，以及基于文件系统的程序间接口。
why_zh: HN 推荐它作为了解 Acme 及其对编辑器、shell 和 GUI 独特取法的最佳入门。
summary: Russ Cox gives a 23-minute tour of the Acme text editor from Plan 9, showing its mouse-driven interface, executing commands from text, and its filesystem-based interface to other programs.
why_hn: HN points people to it as the best introduction to Acme and its very different take on editors, shells, and GUIs.

title: A Deep Dive into Nanite Virtualized Geometry
title_zh: Nanite 虚拟化几何深度解析
summary_zh: Brian Karis 的 SIGGRAPH 2021 演讲解释 Unreal Engine 5 的 Nanite 虚拟化几何如何工作。涵盖网格导入、数据结构、流送、解压、剔除、软硬件光栅化和着色。
why_zh: HN 视其为 Nanite 的权威深度解析，赞赏像素级三角形和计算驱动渲染背后的工程雄心。
summary: Brian Karis's SIGGRAPH 2021 talk explains how Unreal Engine 5's Nanite virtualized geometry works. It covers mesh import, the data structures, streaming, decompression, culling, software and hardware rasterization, and shading.
why_hn: HN treats it as the definitive deep dive on Nanite, admired for the engineering ambition behind pixel-sized triangles and compute-driven rendering.

title: Hammock Driven Development - Rich Hickey
title_zh: 吊床驱动开发 - Rich Hickey
summary_zh: Rich Hickey 在 2010 年首届 Clojure Conj 上的哲思演讲。他主张好的设计来自离开键盘的深思熟虑，并讲述如何喂养后台思维来解决问题。
why_zh: HN 反复引用它，作为编码前深入思考的许可和方法，也是对抗“一直工作”焦虑的解药。
summary: Rich Hickey's philosophical talk from the first Clojure Conj in 2010. He argues that good design comes from deliberate, away-from-keyboard thinking, and describes how to feed the background mind so it solves problems.
why_hn: HN returns to it constantly as permission and method for thinking deeply before coding, and as an antidote to always-working anxiety.

title: U.S. NAVY  BASIC MECHANISMS OF FIRE CONTROL COMPUTERS  MECHANICAL COMPUTER INSTRUCTIONAL FILM  27794
title_zh: 美国海军：火控计算机的基本机械结构
summary_zh: 这部 1953 年美国海军教学片讲解火控计算机中的轴、齿轮、凸轮与差速器，以及这些机械部件如何计算舰船与目标的射击诸元。
why_zh: HN 视其为模拟机械计算的经典演示，尤其是差速齿轮部分。
summary: A 1953 US Navy training film on the basic mechanisms in fire control computers: shafts, gears, cams and differentials. It shows how these mechanical parts compute ship and target firing solutions.
why_hn: HN treats it as the classic demonstration of how analog mechanical computation works, especially the differential gear section.

title: JavaScript: The Good Parts
title_zh: JavaScript: The Good Parts
summary_zh: Douglas Crockford 在 2009 年 Google 技术演讲中，基于同名书剖析 JavaScript 的优劣，主张只使用可靠子集、避开缺陷特性。
why_zh: 这是推荐给 JavaScript 学习者的经典演讲，尽管有些人认为它教条且过时。
summary: Douglas Crockford's 2009 Google tech talk on the good and bad parts of JavaScript, based on his book. He argues for using a reliable subset of the language and avoiding its flawed features.
why_hn: A classic recommended to people learning JavaScript, even though some find it dogmatic and dated.

title: The Ingenious Design of the Aluminum Beverage Can
title_zh: 铝制饮料罐的巧妙设计
summary_zh: Engineer Guy 的 Bill Hammack 讲解铝罐背后的工程：为何做成圆柱、如何制造、顶部为何收窄、双层卷边和拉环如何工作。
why_zh: 每当讨论易拉罐、好设计或量产物品时，它都会被推荐，很多人也会推荐整个频道。
summary: Bill Hammack of Engineer Guy explains the engineering behind the aluminum beverage can: why it is cylindrical, how it is manufactured, why it narrows at the top, the double seam, and how the pull tab works.
why_hn: It is a go-to recommendation whenever cans, good design or mass-produced objects come up, and many also recommend the whole channel.

title: How Crash Bandicoot Hacked The Original Playstation | War Stories | Ars Technica
title_zh: 《Crash Bandicoot》如何破解初代 PlayStation | War Stories | Ars Technica
summary_zh: 在 Ars Technica 的 War Stories 中，Naughty Dog 联合创始人 Andy Gavin 讲述团队如何把 Crash Bandicoot 塞进初代 PlayStation：覆写内存中的 Sony 库代码、自制动效压缩，并针对缓慢寻道时间流式加载资源。
why_zh: 它是 HN 上最常被推荐的老派游戏开发视频之一，展示了严苛硬件限制下的黑科技。
summary: In Ars Technica's War Stories, Naughty Dog co-founder Andy Gavin explains how the team squeezed Crash Bandicoot onto the original PlayStation. They overwrote Sony library code in RAM, built custom animation compression, and streamed assets around slow seek times.
why_hn: It is one of the most frequently recommended videos on HN for old-school game development hacks under tight hardware constraints.

title: MarI/O - Machine Learning for Video Games
title_zh: MarI/O——电子游戏中的机器学习
summary_zh: SethBling 展示 MarI/O：用神经网络和 NEAT 遗传算法学会玩 Super Mario World，说明中附源码、论文与延伸阅读。
why_zh: 它被当作神经进化和 NEAT 的通俗入门，也因注明前人研究而受到好评。
summary: SethBling shows MarI/O, a program using neural networks and the NEAT genetic algorithm to learn to play Super Mario World. The description links the source code, the paper and background reading.
why_hn: The go-to accessible introduction to neuroevolution and NEAT, praised for crediting prior research.

title: A Mind Is Born (256 bytes)
title_zh: A Mind Is Born（256 字节）
summary_zh: Linus Akesson 的 Commodore 64 演示程序，把视频和音乐压缩进 256 字节，赢得 Revision 2017 的 Oldskool 4K Intro 比赛，并附技术解析。
why_zh: 它是 HN 最爱的极端代码压缩范例：比一条推文还小的程序带来动人的音乐与画面。
summary: A Commodore 64 demo by Linus Akesson that fits video and music into 256 bytes, winning the Oldskool 4K Intro compo at Revision 2017. A technical write-up accompanies it.
why_hn: It is HN's favorite example of extreme code compression, a compelling song and visuals from a program smaller than a tweet.

title: Why This Channel Exists (and why I hate Houston)
title_zh: 这个频道为何存在（以及我为什么讨厌休斯顿）
summary_zh: Not Just Bikes 借创作者在休斯顿郊区散步，说明频道缘起，并展示依赖汽车的设计如何让城市对行人充满敌意。
why_zh: 它被强烈推荐为该频道关于北美城市规划与汽车依赖的入门视频。
summary: Not Just Bikes explains why the channel exists, through the creator's walk in suburban Houston. It shows how car-dependent design makes cities hostile to pedestrians.
why_hn: Strongly recommended as the entry point to a channel on urban planning and car dependency in North America.

title: The Loving Trap
title_zh: 《The Loving Trap》
summary_zh: 一部三分钟恶搞 Adam Curtis 纪录片风格的短片，用档案影像拼出其典型旁白与逻辑跳跃。
why_zh: 它常被推荐为 Adam Curtis 作品的标配对照，既能调侃其风格，也提醒人们对其论断保持怀疑。
summary: A three-minute parody of Adam Curtis's documentary style, assembled from archive footage with his typical narration and leaps of logic.
why_hn: Recommended as the standard companion to any Adam Curtis film, since it lampoons the style and gives reasons to take his claims with skepticism.

title: LISA11 - Fork Yeah! The Rise and Development of illumos
title_zh: LISA11——Fork Yeah! illumos 的兴起与发展
summary_zh: Bryan Cantrill 在 LISA11 讲述 Oracle 关闭 OpenSolaris 后 illumos 如何诞生，涵盖 Sun、ZFS、DTrace 与 Zones 的历史及内核工程师的流散，并有一段关于 Oracle 和 Larry Ellison 的著名吐槽。
why_zh: HN 视其为 Sun 在 Oracle 治下命运的权威又有趣的记录，每当 Oracle 行为不端就引用其中 Ellison 的割草机建议。
summary: Bryan Cantrill's LISA11 talk on how illumos arose after Oracle closed OpenSolaris. It covers the history of Sun, ZFS, DTrace and Zones, and the diaspora of kernel engineers, with a famous rant about Oracle and Larry Ellison.
why_hn: HN points to it as the definitive, entertaining account of Sun's fate under Oracle, and quotes its Ellison lawnmower advice whenever Oracle behaves badly.

title: Tech Talk: Linus Torvalds on git
title_zh: 技术演讲：Linus Torvalds 谈 git
summary_zh: Linus Torvalds 在 Google 技术演讲中介绍他两年前创建的 git，论证分布式版本控制优于 CVS、Subversion 等集中式系统。
why_zh: HN 反复推荐它，因为它是 git 为何如此设计、分布式 VCS 为何胜出的标志性解释。
summary: Linus Torvalds gives a Google tech talk on git, the source control system he created two years earlier. He argues for distributed version control over centralized systems such as CVS and Subversion.
why_hn: HN repeatedly recommends it as the iconic explanation of why git is designed as it is and why distributed VCS beats centralized ones.

title: Why American Cities Are Broke - The Growth Ponzi Scheme [ST03]
title_zh: 美国城市为何破产——增长庞氏骗局 [ST03]
summary_zh: Not Just Bikes 解释 Strong Towns 的观点：依赖汽车的美国郊区维护成本高于税收产出，并描述支撑市政财政的增长庞氏骗局。
why_zh: HN 常引用它，认为它最清晰地解释了低密度基础设施如何融资、为何不可持续。
summary: Not Just Bikes explains the Strong Towns argument that car-dependent American suburbs cost more to maintain than they generate in taxes. It describes the growth Ponzi scheme that props up municipal finances.
why_hn: HN keeps pointing to it as the clearest explanation of how low-density infrastructure is financed and why it is unsustainable.

title: Deep Dive into LLMs like ChatGPT
title_zh: 深入理解 ChatGPT 这类 LLM
summary_zh: Andrej Karpathy 面向大众做了三小时以上的深度讲解，覆盖从预训练到后训练的完整训练栈，并给出理解幻觉等特性以及更好使用 LLM 的思维模型。
why_zh: HN 最常推荐它，因为它不依赖繁重数学就能清晰、通俗地讲清 LLM 的工作原理。
summary: Andrej Karpathy's three-hour-plus general-audience deep dive into how ChatGPT-style LLMs are built, covering the full training stack from pretraining to post-training. It also gives mental models for their quirks, like hallucination, and how to use them well.
why_hn: HN's most frequent recommendation for a clear, approachable foundation in how LLMs work without heavy math.

title: Alan Kay's tribute to Ted Nelson at "Intertwingled" Festival
title_zh: Alan Kay 在“Intertwingled”节上对 Ted Nelson 的致敬
summary_zh: 在“Intertwingled”节上，Alan Kay 向 Ted Nelson 致敬，并演示了运行在模拟 1970 年代 Xerox PARC 硬件上的复活 Smalltalk-78 系统，展示了那个时代可实时用户编程的软件。
why_zh: HN 反复推荐它，因为它展示了 1970 年代系统相比今天有多么可编程和可组合。
summary: Alan Kay's tribute to Ted Nelson at the Intertwingled festival, presented using a revived Smalltalk-78 system running on emulated 1970s Xerox PARC hardware. It shows live, user-programmable software from that era.
why_hn: HN returns to it again and again as a demonstration of how programmable and composable 1970s systems were compared with today's.

title: Jonathan Blow - How to program independent games -  CSUA Speech
title_zh: Jonathan Blow：如何编写独立游戏——CSUA 演讲
summary_zh: Jonathan Blow 在 UC Berkeley 的 CSUA 讲述如何编写独立游戏，主张保持代码简单、避免不必要的工作并坚持发布。
why_zh: HN 推荐它，因为其中关于简单性和避免不必要工作的建议远不止适用于游戏。
summary: Jonathan Blow speaks at UC Berkeley's CSUA about how to program independent games. He argues for keeping code simple, avoiding unnecessary work, and shipping.
why_hn: HN recommends it as a talk whose advice on simplicity and avoiding unnecessary work applies well beyond games.

title: The Engoodening of No Man's Sky
title_zh: 《无人深空》的变好之路
summary_zh: Internet Historian 讲述《无人深空》从过度宣传、口碑糟糕的发布到 Hello Games 多年更新救赎游戏的故事，是一部冗长而喜剧化的迷你纪录片。
why_zh: 常被推荐为关于失败发布与恢复的有趣叙述，尤其在讨论 Star Citizen 和过度承诺的帖子中。
summary: Internet Historian tells the story of No Man's Sky, from its over-hyped and badly received launch to years of updates by Hello Games that redeemed the game. It is a long, comedic mini-documentary.
why_hn: Frequently recommended as an entertaining account of a failed launch and recovery, especially in threads about Star Citizen and over-promising.

title: Tim Ewald - Clojure: Programming with Hand Tools
title_zh: Tim Ewald——Clojure：使用手工工具编程
summary_zh: Tim Ewald 在 Clojure/conj 的演讲以手工工具与机器工具制作家具为喻，探讨自动化如何改变我们所造之物和对工作的思考，以及 Clojure 一小套简单工具为何重要。
why_zh: HN 多次将其列为最佳编程演讲之一，喜爱它关于复杂工具可能掩盖更简单解决方案的匠人精神信息。
topic: craftsmanship and simple tools in software
summary: Tim Ewald's Clojure/conj talk uses furniture making with hand tools versus machine tools as an allegory for software. It explores how automation changes what we make and how we think about our work, and why Clojure's small set of simple tools matters.
why_hn: HN repeatedly names it among the best programming talks, loved for its craftsmanship message that complex tooling can hide simpler solutions.

title: Brian Beckman: Don't fear the Monad
title_zh: Brian Beckman：不要害怕 Monad
summary_zh: 微软的 Brian Beckman 用一小时白板式讲解 Monad，从函数组合和幺半群出发，使用中学数学，面向实践程序员而非范畴论专家。
why_zh: HN 反复推荐它作为最清晰、最正确的 Monad 入门解释，有评论者说终于让他豁然开朗。
summary: Microsoft's Brian Beckman gives an hour-long, whiteboard-style walk through monads, building from function composition and monoids using school-level math. It is aimed at practicing programmers rather than category theorists.
why_hn: HN repeatedly recommends it as the clearest and most correct beginner explanation of monads, with several commenters saying it finally made them click.

title: The Coming Collapse of the Middle Class with Elizabeth Warren
title_zh: Elizabeth Warren：中产阶级即将崩溃
summary_zh: Elizabeth Warren 2007 年在伯克利的讲座，当时她是哈佛法学院教授，讲述中产阶级家庭财务压力日增的原因，依据破产研究考察住房、医疗和教育成本上升。
why_zh: HN 在不平等、成本病和中产阶级收入停滞的讨论中经常引用它，称赞其数据驱动的方法。
summary: Elizabeth Warren's 2007 Berkeley lecture, when she was a Harvard law professor, on why middle-class families are under growing financial strain. She draws on bankruptcy research to examine rising costs of housing, health care and education.
why_hn: HN cites it often in debates on inequality, cost disease and stagnant middle-class income, praising its data-driven approach.

title: "Turning the database inside out with Apache Samza" by Martin Kleppmann
title_zh: Martin Kleppmann：用 Apache Samza 把数据库翻个底朝天
summary_zh: Martin Kleppmann 认为数据库是全局共享可变状态，提议将其视为不断增长的不可变事实日志，再由 Apache Samza 等流处理器构建缓存、索引和视图等派生数据，演讲借鉴 Kafka 和 LinkedIn 的提交日志经验。
why_zh: 评论者反复引用它，称其重塑了他们对缓存、派生数据和事件溯源的思考方式。
summary: Martin Kleppmann argues that databases are global shared mutable state and proposes treating them as an ever-growing log of immutable facts. Derived data such as caches, indexes and views is then built by stream processors like Apache Samza. The talk draws on Kafka and LinkedIn's experience with commit logs.
why_hn: Commenters repeatedly cite it as the talk that reframed how they think about caching, derived data and event sourcing.

title: The Problem With Facebook
title_zh: Facebook 的问题
summary_zh: Veritasium 的 Derek Muller 认为 Facebook 的商业模式不利于页面和创作者，因为它向他们收费才能触达自己建立的受众，并解释过滤和付费推广如何削弱点赞的价值。
why_zh: HN 评论者推荐它及其续集，视其为对虚假点赞和机器人活动的揭露，也是投放 Facebook 广告前的警告。
summary: Veritasium's Derek Muller argues that Facebook's business model works against pages and creators, because it charges them to reach the audiences they built. He explains how filtering and paid promotion undermine the value of likes.
why_hn: HN commenters recommend it, with its follow-up, as an exposé of fake likes and bot activity, and as a warning before spending on Facebook ads.

title: "How NOT to Measure Latency" by Gil Tene
title_zh: Gil Tene：如何错误地测量延迟
summary_zh: Azul Systems 的 Gil Tene 解释测量延迟和响应时间的常见陷阱，包括平均值为何误导以及协调遗漏问题，并介绍 HdrHistogram 等开源工具以改进测量和报告。
why_zh: 每当百分位数、尾部延迟、负载测试或平均值话题出现时的经典推荐，有人称其改变了自己的认知。
summary: Gil Tene of Azul Systems explains common pitfalls in measuring latency and response time, including why averages mislead and the problem of coordinated omission. He introduces open source tools like HdrHistogram for better measurement and reporting.
why_hn: The canonical recommendation whenever percentiles, tail latency, load testing or averages come up, described by some as life changing.

title: Joe Rogan Experience #1035 - Paul Stamets
title_zh: Joe Rogan Experience #1035——Paul Stamets
summary_zh: 与真菌学家 Paul Stamets 的两小时 Joe Rogan Experience 对话，围绕真菌、菌丝体、生物修复和药用蘑菇，涉及猴头菇、裸盖菇素及真菌的多种用途。
why_zh: 每当蘑菇或菌丝体话题出现，评论者都会推荐它作为对真菌世界迷人且易懂的介绍。
summary: A two-hour Joe Rogan Experience conversation with mycologist Paul Stamets about fungi, mycelium, bioremediation and medicinal mushrooms. It touches on Lion's Mane, psilocybin and the many uses of fungi.
why_hn: Commenters offer it as a fascinating, accessible introduction to the world of fungi whenever mushrooms or mycelium come up.

title: RSA ANIMATE: Drive: The surprising truth about what motivates us
title_zh: RSA ANIMATE：驱动力——关于激励我们的惊人真相
summary_zh: RSA Animate 将 Dan Pink 关于工作激励的演讲改编为白板动画，主张在简单任务之外，自主、精通和目的比金钱更能驱动绩效。
why_zh: HN 在薪酬、管理和激励讨论中用它作为对自主、精通和目的的标准简短解释。
summary: An RSA Animate whiteboard adaptation of Dan Pink's talk on what motivates people at work. It argues that beyond simple tasks, autonomy, mastery and purpose drive performance more than money.
why_hn: HN uses it in discussions of pay, management, and motivation as the standard short explanation of autonomy, mastery and purpose.

title: Computer program that learns to play classic NES games
title_zh: 一个能学会玩经典 NES 游戏的计算机程序
summary_zh: Tom7 讲解并演示了一款软件：它在内存中寻找分数模式，再搜索能提高分数的输入，从而学会玩 NES 游戏。这是他的 SIGBOVIK 论文配套视频。
why_zh: HN 喜爱它是黑客与学术结合的搞笑又精彩范例，常在游戏 AI 或 fuzzing 讨论中被引用。
summary: Tom7 explains and demos software that learns to play NES games by finding score patterns in memory and then searching for inputs that raise it. It is the video companion to his SIGBOVIK paper.
why_hn: Loved on HN as a hilarious, brilliant example of hacker-academic work and cited whenever game-playing AI or fuzzing comes up.

title: Ruby Conf 12 - Boundaries by Gary Bernhardt
title_zh: RubyConf 12：Gary Bernhardt 谈 Boundaries
summary_zh: Gary Bernhardt 在 RubyConf 2012 的演讲，讲如何在不把所有东西都 mock 掉的前提下做隔离测试。他讨论行为与数据、可变与不可变，并说明“函数式核心、命令式外壳”如何自然带来隔离与并行。
why_zh: HN 推荐它是“functional core, imperative shell”的经典阐述，也是单元测试与集成测试之争的实用答案。
summary: Gary Bernhardt's RubyConf 2012 talk on testing in isolation without mocking everything. It goes through behavior versus data, mutation versus immutability, and how a functional core with an imperative shell yields natural isolation and parallelism.
why_hn: HN recommends it as the canonical presentation of 'functional core, imperative shell' and a practical answer to unit versus integration testing.

title: CppCon 2016: Jason Turner “Rich Code for Tiny Computers: A Simple Commodore 64 Game in C++17”
title_zh: CppCon 2016：Jason Turner《为微型计算机编写丰富代码：用 C++17 写一个简单的 Commodore 64 游戏》
summary_zh: Jason Turner 用 C++17 构建一个简单的 Commodore 64 游戏，展示 constexpr 和 const 如何让现代编译器生成紧凑的 6502 代码。他通过汇编输出说明抽象如何被优化掉。
why_zh: 长期热门推荐，证明富有表现力的现代 C++ 即使在微型复古硬件上也能编译出高效代码。
summary: Jason Turner's CppCon 2016 talk builds a simple Commodore 64 game using C++17, showing how constexpr and const let a modern compiler produce tight 6502 code. He walks through assembly output to show abstractions being optimized away.
why_hn: A perennial favorite, recommended as proof that expressive modern C++ can compile to efficient code even on tiny retro hardware.
categories: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

title: USENIX ATC '21/OSDI '21 Joint Keynote Address-It's Time for Operating Systems to Rediscover Hardware
title_zh: USENIX ATC '21/OSDI '21 联合主题演讲：操作系统是时候重新认识硬件了
summary_zh: ETH Zurich 的 Timothy Roscoe 在 USENIX ATC/OSDI 2021 联合主题演讲中指出，现代硬件是处理器、固件和协处理器的异构集合，而非简单机器，操作系统必须正视这一点。演讲展示了 Linux 之下和旁边还有多少东西在运行。
why_zh: 多次被推荐为令人大开眼界的演讲，揭示主操作系统对现代 SoC 和 PC 的控制其实少得可怜。
summary: Timothy Roscoe of ETH Zurich delivers the joint USENIX ATC/OSDI 2021 keynote arguing that operating systems must reckon with modern hardware, which is a heterogeneous collection of processors, firmware and coprocessors rather than a simple machine. It shows how much runs below and beside Linux.
why_hn: Repeatedly recommended as a revelatory talk on how little control the main OS has over modern SoCs and PCs.

title: Why Being Delusional is a Superpower
title_zh: 为什么“妄想”是一种超能力
summary_zh: Veritasium 通过模拟和案例探讨运气在成功中的作用，说明微小优势与偶然如何复利。它主张顶尖结果不成比例地由运气驱动，同时仍承认努力的价值。
why_zh: 在关于精英体制、职业和创业的讨论中被引用，提醒人们运气如何塑造最终站在顶端的人。
summary: Veritasium examines the role of luck in success, with simulations and examples showing how small advantages and chance can compound. It argues that top outcomes are disproportionately luck-driven while still crediting effort.
why_hn: Linked in threads about meritocracy, careers and startups as a reminder that luck shapes who ends up on top.

title: The Only Unbreakable Law
title_zh: 唯一牢不可破的定律
summary_zh: Casey Muratori 在马德里理工大学的演讲，论证 Conway 定律是软件架构中唯一真正的“定律”候选。他用 Windows 多个音量控制等例子，解释软件如何随着时间模仿组织结构。
why_zh: HN 视其为 Conway 定律的权威解释，几乎在所有“组织结构塑造软件”的讨论中都会链接。
summary: Casey Muratori's lecture, originally given at the Technical University of Madrid, arguing that Conway's Law is the only viable candidate for a true law of software architecture. He explains how software mimics the organization over time, using examples like Windows' multiple volume controls.
why_hn: HN treats it as the definitive explanation of Conway's Law and links it in almost any thread about org structure shaping software.

title: Dr. Michael Greger | How Not To Die | Talks at Google
title_zh: Michael Greger 博士谈《How Not to Die》| Talks at Google
summary_zh: Michael Greger 博士在 Google 纽约介绍他的书《How Not to Die》，主张饮食和生活方式改变可以预防或逆转许多主要死因。他梳理了全食物植物性饮食的相关证据。
why_zh: 在营养、癌症和素食讨论中常被推荐，作为以科学为重点的植物性饮食论据，甚至有评论者说它让自己转为素食。
summary: Dr. Michael Greger presents his book How Not to Die at Google NYC, arguing that diet and lifestyle changes can prevent or reverse many of the top causes of death. He walks through evidence on whole-food plant-based eating.
why_hn: Frequently recommended in threads on nutrition, cancer and veganism as a science-focused case for plant-based diets, with at least one commenter saying it made them go vegan.

title: Using Python to Code by Voice
title_zh: 用 Python 实现语音编程
summary_zh: Tavis Rudd 讲述 RSI 如何迫使他用语音编程，并展示他用语音识别搭建的 Python 与 Emacs Lisp 系统。现场演示在不碰键盘的情况下创建并部署一个小系统。
why_zh: 在 RSI、无障碍和语音编程讨论中反复出现，是自定义语音命令语言的首选演示。
summary: Tavis Rudd describes how RSI forced him to program by voice, and shows the Python and Emacs Lisp system he built with voice recognition. A live demo creates and deploys a small system without touching the keyboard.
why_hn: Recurs in threads about RSI, accessibility and voice coding as the go-to demo of a custom spoken command language.

title: Clasp: Common Lisp using LLVM and C++ for Molecular Metaprogramming
title_zh: Clasp：用 LLVM 和 C++ 实现 Common Lisp，用于分子元编程
summary_zh: Christian Schafmeister 的 Google Tech Talk 介绍设计 spiroligomer 分子，以及构建可与 C++ 互操作的 LLVM Common Lisp——Clasp，用编程方式进行分子设计。内容涵盖化学、力场自动微分以及编译器如何构建。
why_zh: HN 多次引用它作为 Common Lisp 推动科学前沿的惊人例子，也是最鼓舞人心的技术演讲之一。
summary: Christian Schafmeister's Google Tech Talk on designing spiroligomer molecules and building Clasp, a Common Lisp on LLVM that interoperates with C++, to program molecular design. It covers the chemistry, automatic differentiation for force fields, and how the compiler is built.
why_hn: HN repeatedly cites it as a striking example of Common Lisp used to push the frontier of science, and as one of the most inspiring tech talks.

title: Personal Growth Series: Dr. William Dement on Healthy Sleep and Optimal Perfo...
title_zh: 个人成长系列：William Dement 博士谈健康睡眠与最佳表现
summary_zh: 睡眠研究者 William Dement 博士在 Google Tech Talk 中谈健康睡眠与表现。他认为睡眠债必须偿还，并描述了健康睡眠的三个特征。
why_zh: HN 多年来推荐它是关于睡眠最实用也最有趣的演讲，常推荐给受困于疲惫或生产力问题的人。
summary: A Google Tech Talk by sleep researcher Dr. William Dement on healthy sleep and performance. He argues sleep debt must be repaid and describes the three characteristics of healthy sleep.
why_hn: HN has recommended it for years as the most useful and entertaining talk on sleep, often to people struggling with tiredness or productivity.

title: Marty Lobdell - Study Less Study Smart
title_zh: Marty Lobdell：少学而学得更聪明（Study Less Study Smart）
summary_zh: 心理学教授 Marty Lobdell 用一小时讲座讲如何高效学习，涵盖短时专注加休息、学习环境、记笔记和记忆技巧。它面向那些拼命临时抱佛脚却收效甚微的学生。
why_zh: HN 在生产力、专注和居家办公讨论中推荐它，因为关于休息和心智模式的建议不只适用于学习。
summary: Psychology professor Marty Lobdell gives a one-hour lecture on how to study effectively, covering short focused sessions with breaks, study environment, note-taking and memory techniques. It was aimed at students who cram without improving.
why_hn: HN recommends it for productivity, focus and working-from-home threads, since its advice on breaks and mental modes applies beyond studying.

title: "Simple Made Easy" - Rich Hickey (2011)
title_zh: 《Simple Made Easy》——Rich Hickey（2011）
summary_zh: Rich Hickey 在 Strange Loop 2011 的主题演讲区分“简单”（不交织）与“容易”（熟悉或触手可及），并主张软件复杂性来自把事物缠在一起。它提供了一套评判设计与抽象的词汇。
why_zh: 这是 HN 最常推荐的编程演讲之一，每当人们争论复杂性、简单性和抽象时都会被引用，其价值远超 Clojure。
summary: Rich Hickey's Strange Loop 2011 keynote separates 'simple' (not intertwined) from 'easy' (familiar or near at hand) and argues that software complexity comes from complecting things. It offers a vocabulary for judging designs and abstractions.
why_hn: It is one of HN's most frequently recommended programming talks, cited whenever people debate complexity, simplicity and abstraction, and valued well beyond Clojure.

title: You Need a Theme, Not a Goal
title_zh: 你需要一个主题，而不是一个目标
summary_zh: CGP Grey 主张为一年或一个阶段选定一个“主题”，而不是制定目标或新年决心。他指出，主题能给出方向，却没有非成即败的评判标准。
why_zh: 每逢新年决心和目标设定的讨论，都会有人推荐它，许多评论者也开始采用“年度主题”的做法。
summary: CGP Grey argues for picking a theme for the year or season instead of setting goals or new year's resolutions. He explains how a theme gives direction without a pass/fail target.
why_hn: A staple recommendation in new year and goal-setting threads, with many commenters adopting yearly themes.

title: Transforming Code into Beautiful, Idiomatic Python
title_zh: 把代码改写成优美、地道的 Python
summary_zh: Raymond Hettinger 在 PyCon 2013 的演讲中，通过一组组改写前后的对比，演示如何把代码变成地道的 Python，并讲解迭代器、字典、named tuple 等特性的恰当用法。
why_zh: HN 视之为写出 Pythonic 代码的必看经典，不过对现代 Python 而言内容略显过时。
summary: Raymond Hettinger's PyCon 2013 talk on transforming code into idiomatic Python through a series of before-and-after refactorings. It shows how to use iterators, dictionaries, named tuples and other language features well.
why_hn: HN treats it as a must-watch classic for writing Pythonic code, though somewhat dated for modern Python.

title: Shenzhen: The Silicon Valley of Hardware (Full Documentary) | Future Cities | WIRED
title_zh: 深圳：硬件领域的硅谷（完整纪录片）| Future Cities | WIRED
summary_zh: WIRED《Future Cities》系列纪录片聚焦深圳，呈现当地的硬件原型制造文化与“山寨”仿制生产，并探讨这座城市的产业生态如何演化、世界其他地方能从中借鉴什么。
why_zh: 在深圳与硬件相关讨论中被强烈推荐，因为它展现了快速迭代、宽松的知识产权环境与创客生态。
summary: A WIRED Future Cities documentary on Shenzhen, covering its hardware-prototyping culture and shanzhai copycat manufacturing. It looks at how the city's ecosystem evolved and what the rest of the world can learn.
why_hn: Strongly recommended in Shenzhen and hardware threads for its view of fast cycles, loose IP and the maker ecosystem.

title: Ideas about a new programming language for games.
title_zh: 关于一门面向游戏的新编程语言的构想
summary_zh: 这是 Jonathan Blow 首场讲解为游戏设计新编程语言的演讲，这门语言后来成为 Jai。他剖析了 C++ 的种种问题，并说明为何 Go、Rust 和 D 都不适合游戏开发。
why_zh: HN 程序员推荐它和后续的 Jai 系列演讲，既因为其中有游戏行业对替代 C++ 的思考，也因为能看着一门语言被发明出来。
summary: Jonathan Blow's first talk on designing a new programming language for games, which became Jai. He explains the problems with C++ and why Go, Rust and D do not fit game development.
why_hn: HN programmers recommend it, and the Jai series that followed, for the game-industry view on replacing C++ and for watching a language being invented.
categories: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

title: The essence of calculus
title_zh: 微积分的本质
summary_zh: 这是 3Blue1Brown《微积分的本质》系列第一集，从一个简单的几何问题出发，一路构建到积分、导数与微积分基本定理，力图让观众觉得自己本可以发明微积分。
why_zh: 学习数学的经典推荐，因其直观的视觉讲解让死记硬背的公式变得讲得通。
summary: The first video of 3Blue1Brown's Essence of Calculus series, which builds toward integrals, derivatives, and the fundamental theorem of calculus from a simple geometry question. It aims to make viewers feel they could have invented calculus themselves.
why_hn: A staple recommendation for anyone learning math, praised for visual intuition that makes memorized formulas make sense.

title: How to Do 90% of What Plugins Do (With Just Vim)
title_zh: 只用 Vim，就能做到插件 90% 的事
summary_zh: Max Cantor 在 thoughtbot meetup 的演讲，讲如何仅用 Vim 内置功能实现热门插件的大部分能力，涵盖自动补全、文件跳转、文件系统浏览、构建集成与代码片段，并附有幻灯片和 vimrc。
why_zh: HN 视其为此观点的标准演讲：原生 Vim 已足够强大，插件依赖反而是负担。
summary: A thoughtbot meetup talk by Max Cantor on getting most of what popular plugins provide using only built-in Vim features. It covers autocomplete, file jumping, filesystem navigation, build integration and snippets, with slides and a vimrc available.
why_hn: HN treats it as the canonical talk for the case that vanilla Vim goes a long way and plugin dependencies are a burden.

title: The Wrong Way to Set Speed Limits [ST06]
title_zh: 设置限速的错误方式 [ST06]
summary_zh: Not Just Bikes 讲解北美如何设定道路限速，以及为何路牌上的限速远不如街道设计重要。他认为司机是跟着道路的暗示开车，因此安全车速必须“建”进街道里。
why_zh: 在交通安全讨论中被反复推荐，让人们对道路设计与限速标识、驾驶行为之间的关系大开眼界。
summary: Not Just Bikes explains how North American speed limits are set and why posted limits matter far less than street design. It argues that drivers follow the road's cues, so safe speeds have to be built into the street.
why_hn: Recommended again and again in traffic-safety threads as an eye-opener on road design versus posted limits and driver behavior.

title: The Fast Fourier Transform (FFT): Most Ingenious Algorithm Ever?
title_zh: 快速傅里叶变换（FFT）：史上最巧妙的算法？
summary_zh: Reducible 对快速傅里叶变换的可视化讲解，以多项式乘法为切入点，展示如何通过提出正确的问题一步步发现 FFT 的核心思想。
why_zh: HN 屡次称它是让 FFT 豁然开朗的绝佳讲解，并有人会定期重看。
summary: Reducible's visual walkthrough of the Fast Fourier Transform, motivated by polynomial multiplication. It shows how the FFT's key ideas can be discovered by asking the right questions.
why_hn: HN repeatedly calls it a fantastic explanation that made FFT click, with some rewatching it periodically.

title: Dick Proenneke in Alone in the Wilderness
title_zh: Dick Proenneke 的《荒野独居》
summary_zh: 这部影片由 Dick Proenneke 自拍的 8mm 影像剪辑而成，记录他用双手和就地取材的材料在阿拉斯加荒野建起小木屋、独自生活。
why_zh: HN 常推荐它且评价温暖，在小木屋、独居与木工相关讨论中，它是关于自力更生与手作精神的动人而宁静的呈现。
summary: A condensed film of Dick Proenneke's footage of building a cabin and living alone in the Alaskan wilderness, using hand tools and local materials. It draws on the 8mm films he shot himself.
why_hn: HN recommends it often and warmly, as an inspiring and peaceful view of self-reliance and handcraft, in threads on cabins, solitude and woodworking.

title: Mike Monteiro: F*ck You, Pay Me
title_zh: Mike Monteiro：去你的，给钱
summary_zh: Mike Monteiro 在 CreativeMornings 的演讲，讲创意与自由职业者如何拿到报酬：合同、与律师合作、拒绝免费干活，语气直白辛辣。
why_zh: 每当客户拖欠款项或谈到合同，HN 老用户就把自由职业者和顾问们引向这个演讲。
summary: Mike Monteiro's CreativeMornings talk on getting paid for creative and freelance work, covering contracts, working with lawyers, and refusing to work for free. It is delivered with blunt humor.
why_hn: HN regulars send freelancers and consultants to it whenever clients don't pay or contracts come up.

title: Spec-ulation Keynote - Rich Hickey
title_zh: Spec-ulation 主题演讲 —— Rich Hickey
summary_zh: Rich Hickey 关于软件版本管理的主题演讲，主张破坏性变更才是真正的问题，库应当只增不减：提供更多、要求更少。他批评语义化版本，并与 Clojure spec 相呼应。
why_zh: 每逢版本管理与 API 稳定性之争，HN 都会回到这场富有挑战性、观点逆向的演讲。
summary: Rich Hickey's keynote on software versioning, arguing that breaking changes are the real problem and that libraries should only grow by providing more and requiring less. It critiques semantic versioning and ties into Clojure spec.
why_hn: HN returns to it in every versioning and API stability debate as a challenging, contrarian talk worth watching.

title: Modern Dictionaries by Raymond Hettinger
title_zh: Raymond Hettinger：现代 Python 字典
summary_zh: Python 核心开发者 Raymond Hettinger 讲解 Python 字典如何演变为 3.6 中紧凑且有序的实现，并用图示和少量纯 Python 代码介绍 key-sharing、压缩和版本化等机制。
why_zh: HN 认为这是关于哈希表内部原理和 Python 字典有序性的最佳、最生动的演讲，常在技术演讲推荐列表中提及。
summary: Python core developer Raymond Hettinger explains how Python's dictionary implementation evolved into the compact, ordered dict in Python 3.6. He uses pictures and small bits of pure Python, and covers key-sharing, compaction and versioning.
why_hn: HN treats it as the definitive, engaging talk on hash table internals and Python dict ordering, and recommends it in tech-talk lists.

title: Refterm Lecture Part 1 - Philosophies of Optimization
title_zh: Refterm 讲座第 1 部分：优化哲学
summary_zh: Casey Muratori 在 refterm 系列首讲中阐述优化哲学，区分“优化”和“非悲观化”（避免不必要的工作），并用快速终端渲染器项目展示计算机实际有多快。
why_zh: HN 在软件性能争论中反复引用它，把它视为“非悲观化”以及现代软件为何缓慢的入门读物。
summary: Casey Muratori's first refterm lecture lays out philosophies of optimization, distinguishing optimization from non-pessimization, which means avoiding needless work. It uses his fast terminal renderer project to show how fast computers really are.
why_hn: HN returns to it constantly in software performance debates as the primer on non-pessimization and why modern software is slow.

title: "Money doesn't interest me" - Ton Roosendaal 2017 Interview
title_zh: “钱对我没有吸引力”——Ton Roosendaal 2017 年访谈
summary_zh: Blender Guru 对 Blender 创造者 Ton Roosendaal 的长篇访谈，涵盖 Blender 的起源、转向开源、他为何不受金钱驱动、Autodesk，以及 Blender 与其他开源项目的不同之处。
why_zh: HN 推荐它为了解 Blender 历史及其以用户为中心的自由软件成功故事的最佳材料。
summary: A long interview by Blender Guru with Ton Roosendaal, creator of Blender. They cover Blender's origins, the move to open source, why Ton is not driven by money, Autodesk, and what sets Blender apart from other open source projects.
why_hn: Recommended as the best account of Blender's history and its user-focused approach as a free software success story.

title: CppCon 2014: Mike Acton "Data-Oriented Design and C++"
title_zh: CppCon 2014：Mike Acton《面向数据的设计与 C++》
summary_zh: Insomniac Games 的 Mike Acton 认为程序的目的就是转换数据，并展示常见 C++ 做法如何在性能关键的游戏开发中违背这一点；他讨论了缓存行为、数据布局和编译器的局限。
why_zh: 尽管 Acton 风格直率，HN 仍把它视为面向数据设计和硬件感知性能思维的首选演讲。
summary: Mike Acton of Insomniac Games argues that a program's purpose is transforming data, and shows how common C++ approaches work against that in performance-critical game development. He covers cache behavior, data layout and the limits of compilers.
why_hn: It is the go-to talk HN points to for data-oriented design and hardware-aware performance thinking, despite Acton's blunt style.
categories: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

title: Siggraph2019 Geometric Algebra
title_zh: SIGGRAPH 2019 几何代数课程
summary_zh: SIGGRAPH 2019 的几何代数课程：Charles Gunn 作入门介绍，随后 Steven De Keninck 带来面向程序员的课程，并用 ganja.js 做实时演示。
why_zh: HN 评论者一再推荐它，认为这是几何代数及其在图形学和物理中应用的最易上手、对开发者最友好的入门材料。
summary: A SIGGRAPH 2019 course on geometric algebra. Charles Gunn gives an intro, then Steven De Keninck gives a programmer-focused course with live examples in ganja.js.
why_hn: HN commenters repeatedly point people to it as the most accessible, developer-friendly introduction to geometric algebra and its use in graphics and physics.

title: The Mother of All Demos, presented by Douglas Engelbart (1968)
title_zh: Douglas Engelbart 演示“所有演示之母”（1968）
summary_zh: Douglas Engelbart 1968 年演示的完整录像，介绍了鼠标、超文本、视频会议、文字处理和实时协作编辑，时长约 100 分钟。
why_zh: HN 视其为计算史必看材料，展示了多少现代界面理念在 1968 年就已经被解决。
summary: The full recording of Douglas Engelbart's 1968 demonstration, which introduced the mouse, hypertext, video conferencing, word processing, and real-time collaborative editing. It runs about 100 minutes.
why_hn: HN treats it as an essential piece of computing history that shows how many modern interface ideas were already solved in 1968.

title: RSA ANIMATE: Changing Education Paradigms
title_zh: RSA Animate：改变教育范式
summary_zh: 改编自 Sir Ken Robinson 演讲的 RSA Animate 动画，主张现行教育体系沿袭工业时代模式；它讨论了发散性思维、标准化以及学校如何让孩子失去参与感。
why_zh: HN 推荐它作为对学校教育的通俗且广泛传播的批判，并在 ADHD、创造力和教育改革讨论中引用。
summary: An RSA Animate drawn from a Sir Ken Robinson talk arguing that current education systems are modeled on the industrial age. It discusses divergent thinking, standardization, and how schools disengage kids.
why_hn: HN recommends it as an accessible, widely shared critique of schooling, and cites it in threads on ADHD, creativity and education reform.

title: RL Course by David Silver - Lecture 1: Introduction to Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: David Silver 强化学习课程第 1 讲：强化学习导论
summary_zh: David Silver 强化学习课程的第一讲，介绍该领域及其基本概念；课程内容跟随 Sutton 和 Barto 的教材。
why_zh: 它常被推荐为出色而清晰的强化学习入门课程，由 AlphaGo 负责人讲授，并与 Sutton 和 Barto 教材搭配良好。
summary: The first lecture of David Silver's reinforcement learning course, introducing the field and its basic concepts. The course follows the Sutton and Barto textbook.
why_hn: Frequently recommended as an excellent, clear introductory RL course from the lead of AlphaGo, pairing well with Sutton and Barto.

title: Lecture 6: Version Control (git) (2020)
title_zh: 第 6 讲：版本控制（git）（2020）
summary_zh: MIT“Missing Semester”课程中关于 git 版本控制的一讲；它从 git 的数据模型而非命令出发来构建理解。
why_zh: HN 常称它是最好的单一 git 视频，因为它讲授底层数据结构。
summary: A lecture from MIT's Missing Semester course covering version control with git. It builds up git from its data model rather than from commands.
why_hn: HN frequently calls it the best single video on git because it teaches the underlying data structures.

title: 28c3: The Science of Insecurity
title_zh: 28c3：不安全性的科学
summary_zh: Meredith Patterson 和 Sergey Bratus 认为，网络软件之所以不安全，是因为协议和输入过于复杂，无法被安全识别；他们提出用形式语言理论和文法来构建安全、可验证的输入处理。
why_zh: HN 评论者称它是最好的安全演讲之一，也是 LANGSEC 的标准入门材料，用来论证应采用更简单、规格明确的输入格式。
summary: Meredith Patterson and Sergey Bratus argue that networked software stays insecure because protocols and inputs are too complex to recognize safely. They propose using formal language theory and grammars to build secure, verifiable input handling.
why_hn: HN commenters call it one of the best security talks and the standard introduction to LANGSEC, which they use to argue for simpler, well-specified input formats.

title: Mindfulness with Jon Kabat-Zinn
title_zh: Jon Kabat-Zinn 谈正念
summary_zh: Jon Kabat-Zinn 在 Google 科技讲座中进行约一小时的正念讲解，介绍基本理念并包含一段引导冥想，面向初学者。
why_zh: 十多年来，HN 一直把询问压力、专注或冥想的人引向这个平静而平易近人的正念入门视频。
summary: Jon Kabat-Zinn leads an hour-long Google tech talk on mindfulness, introducing the basic ideas and including a guided meditation. It is aimed at newcomers.
why_hn: For over a decade HN has pointed people asking about stress, focus or meditation to this as a restful and approachable introduction to mindfulness.

title: Is Most Published Research Wrong?
title_zh: 大多数已发表的研究都是错的吗？
summary_zh: Veritasium 解释了为何相当大比例的已发表研究结论可能是假的，涉及 p 值、p-hacking、发表偏倚和低复现率等问题。视频以 John Ioannidis 的著名论文为基础，并介绍了预注册等改革措施。
why_zh: 每当出现站不住脚的研究或讨论 p<0.05 阈值时，HN 评论者都会引用它，把它当作科学中假阳性的简明入门。
summary: Veritasium explains why a large share of published research findings may be false, covering p-values, p-hacking, publication bias and low replication rates. It draws on John Ioannidis's well-known paper and describes reforms such as preregistration.
why_hn: HN commenters link it whenever a shaky study or the p<0.05 threshold comes up, as a short primer on false positives in science.

title: How I program C
title_zh: 我是怎么写 C 的
summary_zh: Eskil Steenberg 用两小时讲述他个人写 C 的方式，涵盖代码风格、结构、命名、指针以及大型项目的组织。他事先提醒其中包含不少“编程信仰”成分。
why_zh: HN 把它推荐为唯一值得看完的长篇编程视频，认为它对 C 的看法极具挑衅性且影响深远。
summary: Eskil Steenberg's two-hour talk on his personal approach to writing C, covering code style, structure, naming, pointers and large-project organization. He warns it contains a fair bit of programming religion.
why_hn: HN recommends it as the one long programming video worth watching, a provocative and influential take on C.
categories: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

title: The Extreme Engineering of ASML’s EUV Light Source
title_zh: ASML EUV 光源的极限工程
summary_zh: Asianometry 讲解 ASML 光刻机中的 EUV 光源：激光两次击中下落的锡液滴，产生 13.5 纳米的光。视频逐步拆解液滴发生器、预脉冲与主激光以及由此形成的等离子体。
why_zh: 只要话题涉及 EUV、ASML 或芯片制造，评论者就会反复提到它，因为它清晰而出色地解释了这一芯片制造中最难的工程问题之一。
summary: Asianometry explains the EUV light source inside ASML's lithography machines, where lasers hit falling tin droplets twice to produce 13.5 nm light. It walks through the engineering of the droplet generator, the pre-pulse and main laser, and the plasma that results.
why_hn: Commenters repeatedly point to it whenever EUV, ASML or chip manufacturing comes up, as a clear and astonishing explanation of one of the hardest engineering problems in chipmaking.

title: 30 Essential Ideas you should know about ADHD, 1A Intro, Chronic Developmental Disability
title_zh: 关于 ADHD 你应该知道的 30 个核心观点，1A 引言：慢性发育性障碍
summary_zh: 这是 Russell Barkley 的“30 个核心观点”系列第一段，把 ADHD 介绍为一种慢性发育性障碍。它出自一位顶尖 ADHD 研究者关于该障碍的系列讲座。
why_zh: HN 评论者一再推荐 Barkley 的讲座，认为它是理解 ADHD 的最佳入门。
summary: The first clip from Russell Barkley's 30 Essential Ideas about ADHD series, introducing ADHD as a chronic developmental disability. It is part of a lecture series on the disorder by a leading ADHD researcher.
why_hn: HN commenters repeatedly recommend Barkley's lectures as the best introduction to understanding ADHD.

title: Cities Aren't Loud: Cars Are Loud
title_zh: 城市并不吵，汽车才吵
summary_zh: Not Just Bikes 主张城市噪音主要来自机动车，论据取自《Curbing Traffic》一书以及对认真治理噪音的代尔夫特的走访。
why_zh: 在关于噪音、电动车和无车城市的讨论中，HN 频繁引用它作为“吵的是车不是城市”的出处。
summary: Not Just Bikes argues that urban noise comes mostly from motor vehicles, drawing on the book Curbing Traffic and a visit to Delft, a city that takes noise seriously.
why_hn: HN cites it constantly in threads on noise, EVs and car-free cities as the source that cars, not cities, are loud.

title: Category Theory 1.1: Motivation and Philosophy
title_zh: 范畴论 1.1：动机与哲学
summary_zh: 这是 Bartosz Milewski 面向程序员的范畴论系列第一讲。内容涵盖范畴论背后的动机与哲学，以及为何组合性对处理复杂性至关重要。
why_zh: HN 评论者反复称它是面向在职程序员最友好的范畴论入门。
summary: The first lecture in Bartosz Milewski's category theory series for programmers. It covers the motivation and philosophy behind category theory and why composition matters for handling complexity.
why_hn: HN commenters repeatedly name it as the friendliest entry point to category theory for working programmers.

title: "Propositions as Types" by Philip Wadler
title_zh: Philip Wadler 谈“命题即类型”
summary_zh: Philip Wadler 在 Strange Loop 的演讲，讲逻辑与计算之间的联系（Curry-Howard 对应）。他沿 Church、Gödel 和 Turing 追溯其历史，并展示它如何塑造了定理证明器和编程语言。
why_zh: HN 认为它是理解逻辑为何与函数式编程相通的生动而令人开眼的入门，也是“最爱的技术演讲”类帖子中的常客。
summary: Philip Wadler's Strange Loop talk on Propositions as Types, the link between logic and computation (the Curry-Howard correspondence). He traces its history through Church, Godel and Turing and shows how it shaped theorem provers and programming languages.
why_hn: HN regards it as an entertaining and eye-opening introduction to why logic and functional programming are connected, and it is a frequent pick in favorite-tech-talk threads.

title: Why Some Diseases Only Traveled One Direction
title_zh: 为什么有些疾病只单向传播
summary_zh: CGP Grey 解释了为何欧洲疾病重创美洲，而几乎没有致命疾病反向传入欧洲。他把原因归结为家畜驯化、密集城市以及《枪炮、病菌与钢铁》中的观点。
why_zh: HN 评论者把它当作解释疾病单向传播以及《枪炮、病菌与钢铁》核心论点的简明短片。
summary: CGP Grey explains why European diseases devastated the Americas while few deadly diseases traveled the other way. He ties it to livestock domestication, dense cities, and the ideas of Guns, Germs and Steel.
why_hn: HN commenters point to it as a clear, short explanation of one-directional disease spread and the core argument of Guns, Germs, and Steel.

title: Richard Feynman Fire
title_zh: Richard Feynman 讲火
summary_zh: 一段 Richard Feynman 采访短片，他解释火：燃烧的木头释放的是树储存的阳光，而树主要由空气构成。视频展现了他的好奇心和朴素直白的讲解方式。
why_zh: HN 反复引用它作为对火与光合作用的优雅而令人开窍的解释，也是 Feynman 那种富有感染力的求知欲的范例。
summary: A short clip from a Richard Feynman interview in which he explains fire, describing how burning wood releases sunlight stored by the tree, which built itself mostly from air. It showcases his curiosity and plain-spoken explanations.
why_hn: HN repeatedly cites it as an elegant, eye-opening explanation of fire and photosynthesis and as an example of Feynman's infectious love of knowledge.

title: Jim Keller: Moore's Law, Microprocessors, and First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #70
title_zh: Jim Keller：摩尔定律、微处理器与第一性原理 | Lex Fridman 播客第 70 期
summary_zh: Lex Fridman 采访传奇芯片架构师 Jim Keller，谈摩尔定律、微处理器设计与第一性原理思维。Keller 结合自己在 AMD、Apple、Tesla 和 Intel 的经历，讨论指令集、晶体管预算和自动驾驶。
why_zh: 每当涉及芯片架构、摩尔定律或 CPU 设计，HN 都会引用它，因为这是一位顶级设计师难得深入又易懂的视角。
summary: Lex Fridman interviews legendary chip architect Jim Keller about Moore's Law, microprocessor design, and first-principles thinking. Keller draws on his work at AMD, Apple, Tesla and Intel, discussing instruction sets, transistor budgets, and self-driving.
why_hn: HN cites it whenever chip architecture, Moore's Law or CPU design comes up, as an unusually deep and accessible view from a top designer.

title: Object-Oriented Programming is Bad
title_zh: 面向对象编程并不好
summary_zh: Brian Will 主张过程式编程优于面向对象编程，认为 OOP 承诺的封装与解耦在很大程度上是虚幻的。他通过真实代码示例分析将数据与行为绑定在类中的问题。
why_zh: HN 常把它当成批评 OOP 的首选视频，认为它比大多数文字论证更能说明抽象带来的代价。
summary: Brian Will makes the case for procedural programming over object-oriented programming, arguing that OOP's promised encapsulation and decoupling are largely illusory. He analyzes real code examples and the problems of tying data to behavior in classes.
why_hn: HN returns to it as the go-to critique of OOP, recommended for explaining the costs of abstraction better than most written arguments.

title: The Language of the System - Rich Hickey
title_zh: 系统的语言 — Rich Hickey
summary_zh: Rich Hickey 2013 年的演讲把语言设计思维应用于整个系统，讨论命名、队列、数据、故障以及程序之间的接口。演讲最后呼吁以整体视角构建系统。
why_zh: HN 推荐它是 Hickey 关于系统设计的关键演讲，能改变人们对分布式状态和接口的思考方式。
summary: Rich Hickey's 2013 talk applies language-design thinking to whole systems, covering names, queues, data, failure, and the interfaces between programs. It ends with a call to action for building systems holistically.
why_hn: HN recommends it as a key Hickey talk on system design that changes how people think about distributed state and interfaces.

title: Why Canadians Can't Bike in the Winter (but Finnish people can)
title_zh: 为什么加拿大人冬天不能骑车（但芬兰人可以）
summary_zh: Not Just Bikes 以芬兰奥卢为例指出，阻止加拿大人冬天骑车的不是天气，而是安全且维护良好的自行车基础设施。只要设施到位，严寒中也能全年骑行。
why_zh: 每当有人声称寒冷或下雪就无法骑车时，HN 就引用它作为简洁反驳：决定因素在于基础设施和维护。
summary: Not Just Bikes argues that winter is not what stops Canadians cycling, using Oulu, Finland as proof that safe, well-maintained cycling infrastructure enables year-round biking despite harsh weather.
why_hn: HN links it whenever someone claims cold or snow rules out cycling, as the concise rebuttal that infrastructure and maintenance decide it.

title: This Video Is Sponsored By ███ VPN
title_zh: 本视频由 ███ VPN 赞助
summary_zh: Tom Scott 拍了一则更诚实的 VPN 广告，把赞助商名字打码，并解释 VPN 广告中的典型说法为何具有误导性。他提到赞助商对此并不满意。
why_zh: 每当 VPN 营销话题出现，HN 都会引用它，清晰揭穿 VPN 广告背后的恐吓营销。
summary: Tom Scott writes a more honest VPN ad, with the sponsor's name redacted, and explains why the typical claims in VPN advertising are misleading. He notes the sponsor was not happy about it.
why_hn: The standard link when VPN marketing comes up, as a clear debunking of the scare tactics behind VPN ads.

title: How the Dutch got their cycle paths
title_zh: 荷兰人如何建起自行车道
summary_zh: BicycleDutch 的短片讲述荷兰自行车基础设施的由来，包括 1970 年代的抗议和城市规划从以汽车为中心转向。该频道后来发布了更新版。
why_zh: HN 用它作为“汽车主导的城市能否变得自行车友好”的标准简短回答：荷兰人当年也是争取来的。
summary: A short BicycleDutch video on how the Netherlands got its cycling infrastructure, including the 1970s protests and the shift away from car-centric planning. The channel later published an updated version.
why_hn: HN uses it as the standard short answer to whether car-dominated cities can become bike-friendly, since the Dutch had to fight for it.

title: Quantum Entanglement & Spooky Action at a Distance
title_zh: 量子纠缠与幽灵般的超距作用
summary_zh: Veritasium 在不到十分钟内解释量子纠缠与“幽灵般的超距作用”，梳理贝尔不等式以及排除隐变量的实验。
why_zh: HN 推荐它是贝尔定理最清晰的通俗解释之一。
summary: Veritasium explains quantum entanglement and spooky action at a distance, walking through Bell's inequality and the experiments that rule out hidden variables, in under ten minutes.
why_hn: HN recommends it as one of the clearest layman explanations of Bell's theorem.

title: This is how you treat ADHD based off science, Dr Russell Barkley part of 2012 Burnett Lecture
title_zh: 基于科学如何治疗 ADHD：Russell Barkley 博士 2012 年 Burnett 讲座片段
summary_zh: 这是 Russell Barkley 博士 2012 年 Burnett 讲座中关于 ADHD 治疗的片段。他认为 ADHD 是执行功能与自我调节障碍，应通过设计外部环境来补偿。
why_zh: HN 上受 ADHD 影响的用户或家属把它作为权威且实用的演讲分享，称它帮助一些人去寻求诊断。
summary: A short excerpt from Dr Russell Barkley's 2012 Burnett Lecture on ADHD, focused on treatment. He argues ADHD is a disorder of executive function and self-regulation, and that environments should be designed to compensate.
why_hn: HN people with ADHD or ADHD-affected relatives share it as an authoritative, practical talk that helped some seek diagnosis.

title: Agile is Dead • Pragmatic Dave Thomas • GOTO 2015
title_zh: 敏捷已死 • Pragmatic Dave Thomas • GOTO 2015
summary_zh: 敏捷宣言合著者 Dave Thomas 在 GOTO 阿姆斯特丹 2015 上指出，作为品牌产业的“敏捷”已经失去意义。他说 agile 是形容词而非名词，呼吁开发者重新找回敏捷性。
why_zh: 几乎每个抱怨 Agile 或 Scrum 的帖子都会引用它，作为关于敏捷本意与现状的权威观点。
summary: Dave Thomas, a co-author of the Agile Manifesto, argues at GOTO Amsterdam 2015 that Agile as a branded industry has lost its meaning. He says agile is an adjective, not a noun, and urges developers to reclaim agility.
why_hn: Offered in nearly every Agile or Scrum complaint thread as the authoritative take on what agile was meant to be versus what it became.

title: Music Software & Bad Interface Design: Avid’s Sibelius
title_zh: 音乐软件与糟糕的界面设计：Avid 的 Sibelius
summary_zh: Tantacrul 逐一剖析 Avid 制谱软件 Sibelius 的 UX 与 UI，列出一长串糟糕的设计选择。这既是一场喜剧式吐槽，也是一堂实用的界面设计课。
why_zh: HN 推荐它是针对软件界面最有趣又严肃的批评，也是 UX 错误的速成教材。
summary: Tantacrul dissects the UX and UI of Avid's Sibelius music notation software, going through a long list of bad design choices. The review is both a comic rant and a practical lesson in interface design.
why_hn: Recommended as the most entertaining serious critique of a software interface, and a crash course in UX mistakes.

title: Google I/O 2012 - Go Concurrency Patterns
title_zh: Google I/O 2012 — Go 并发模式
summary_zh: Rob Pike 在 Google I/O 2012 的演讲展示 goroutine 和 channel 如何用简洁的 Go 代码解决棘手的并发问题，包括地鼠传消息的趣味演示和搜索引擎示例。
why_zh: 学习 Go 并发的经典推荐，被赞既有趣又能讲清何时用 channel、何时用 mutex。
summary: Rob Pike's Google I/O 2012 talk shows how goroutines and channels solve tricky concurrency problems with simple Go code. It features a playful goroutine demo with gophers passing messages and a search engine example.
why_hn: The canonical recommendation for learning Go concurrency, praised as entertaining and clarifying when to use channels versus mutexes.
categories: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

title: Origins of Precision
title_zh: 精度的起源
summary_zh: Machine Thinking 追溯机械精度从何而来，从平板与三平板法讲到车床和早期测量工具。这是“复刻第一把千分尺”系列的第一集。
why_zh: HN 评论者反复推荐它，称其是半小时内讲清精度如何从零起步建立的迷你纪录片，与机械加工和芯片制造讨论相关。
summary: Machine Thinking traces where mechanical precision comes from, from flat surface plates and the three-plate method up through lathes and early measuring tools. It is the first in a series on recreating the first micrometer.
why_hn: HN commenters repeatedly recommend it as a half-hour mini-documentary on how precision is bootstrapped from scratch, relevant to machining and chip manufacturing threads.

title: Václav Smil at Driva Climate Investment Meeting 2019
title_zh: Václav Smil 在 Driva 气候投资会议 2019 的演讲
summary_zh: Václav Smil 讲述历史上的能源转型及其对气候投资的启示。他认为转型缓慢、技术逐步改进，只有绝对减少能源使用才真正有效。
why_zh: HN 常把它作为对脱碳和绿色增长技术乐观主义的清醒、基于数据的反驳。
summary: Vaclav Smil's talk on historic energy transitions and what they imply for climate investment. He argues that transitions are slow, technology improves gradually, and only absolute cuts in energy use would truly work.
why_hn: Frequently linked as a sobering, data-grounded counterpoint to techno-optimism about decarbonization and green growth.

title: Let's build GPT: from scratch, in code, spelled out.
title_zh: 让我们从零构建 GPT：用代码一步步讲清楚
summary_zh: Andrej Karpathy 用 PyTorch 从零实现 GPT，参照 Attention Is All You Need 与 GPT-2/3，约两小时。他把实现与 ChatGPT 联系起来，并假定观众熟悉其早前的 makemore 视频。
why_zh: 它是学习 Transformer 和 LLM 实际工作原理的首选推荐，以清晰和 Karpathy 的教学著称。
summary: Andrej Karpathy builds a GPT from scratch in code, following Attention Is All You Need and GPT-2/3, in about two hours using PyTorch. He connects it to ChatGPT and assumes familiarity with his earlier makemore videos.
why_hn: It is the go-to recommendation for learning how transformers and LLMs actually work, praised for its clarity and Karpathy's teaching.

title: The Spider's Web: Britain's Second Empire | The Secret World of Finance
title_zh: 蜘蛛网：英国的第二个帝国 | 金融的秘密世界
summary_zh: 这部纪录片讲述帝国衰落后，伦敦金融城和英国海外领地如何建立起全球离岸保密辖区网络。影片追踪该网络如何攫取并隐藏来自世界各地的财富。
why_zh: 在避税天堂和离岸金融讨论中，HN 评论者反复推荐它，称其以极低成本出色概述了英国离岸金融体系。
summary: A feature-length documentary on how the City of London and Britain's overseas territories built a global web of offshore secrecy jurisdictions after the empire declined. It traces how this network captured and hid wealth from around the world.
why_hn: Commenters repeatedly recommend it in tax haven and offshore finance threads as an excellent, low-budget overview of British offshore finance.

title: Stop Writing Classes
title_zh: 别再写类了
summary_zh: Jack Diederich 在 PyCon 2012 的演讲认为 Python 中类被过度使用，并通过真实代码重构掉不必要的类、异常和模块。他推广了一个经验法则：只有两个方法且其中一个是 __init__ 的类应改为函数。
why_zh: HN 一再把它作为简洁、反对过早抽象的标准论证，有评论者说它改变了自己的写代码方式。
summary: Jack Diederich's PyCon 2012 talk argues that classes are overused in Python and walks through real code, refactoring away unnecessary classes, exceptions and modules. It popularized the heuristic that a class with two methods, one being __init__, should be a function.
why_hn: HN returns to it repeatedly as the canonical argument for simplicity and against premature abstraction, and several commenters say it changed how they write code.

title: Alan Kay: Doing with Images Makes Symbols (Full Version)
title_zh: Alan Kay：用图像做事，造就符号（完整版）
summary_zh: 这是 Alan Kay 1987 年演讲的完整上传，演示了多个 Smalltalk 时代的软件系统，并阐述视觉、动觉和符号推理的理念。片中还包括一个 12 岁孩子写的 Smalltalk 程序以及 Rand 平板的影像。
why_zh: HN 推荐它是自己最喜欢的科技演讲之一，充满被遗忘的 1980 年代软件中的好点子，值得完整观看。
summary: A full upload of Alan Kay's 1987 talk, with demos of several Smalltalk-era software systems and ideas about visual, kinesthetic and symbolic reasoning. It includes a Smalltalk program written by a 12-year-old and footage of the Rand tablet.
why_hn: HN recommends it as a favourite tech talk full of good ideas from forgotten 1980s software, worth watching in full.

title: Joe Rogan Experience #1109 - Matthew Walker
title_zh: Joe Rogan 播客 #1109：Matthew Walker
summary_zh: Joe Rogan 采访伯克利神经科学教授、《Why We Sleep》作者 Matthew Walker。他们讨论睡眠对大脑和身体的作用、睡眠剥夺的影响以及常见睡眠误区。
why_zh: HN 读者推荐它作为《Why We Sleep》的通俗且激励人心的总结，适合不打算读全书的人。
summary: Joe Rogan interviews Matthew Walker, Berkeley neuroscience professor and author of Why We Sleep. They discuss what sleep does for the brain and body, the effects of sleep deprivation, and sleep myths.
why_hn: HN readers recommend it as an accessible, motivating summary of Why We Sleep for people who will not read the book.

title: Your Brain Thinks Your Whole Home Is One Room
title_zh: 你的大脑把整个家当成一个房间
summary_zh: CGP Grey 认为封锁期间大脑会把整个家当作一个房间，模糊工作、休息和休闲的界限。他建议为不同活动划分独立空间和日常习惯，以保持平衡。
why_zh: 在远程办公、倦怠和拖延的讨论中，HN 经常推荐它，作为把工作与家庭生活分开的实用建议。
summary: CGP Grey argues that your brain treats a whole home as one room during lockdown, blurring work, rest and leisure. He recommends creating separate spaces and routines for different activities to stay balanced.
why_hn: HN recommends it constantly in work-from-home, burnout and procrastination threads as practical advice for separating work from life at home.

title: Pete Hunt: React: Rethinking best practices -- JSConf EU
title_zh: Pete Hunt：React：重新思考最佳实践 -- JSConf EU
summary_zh: Facebook 和 Instagram 的 Pete Hunt 在 JSConf EU 2013 介绍 React 并解释其设计原则。他认为把模板和逻辑分开只是分离技术而非关注点，并论证组件的价值。
why_zh: HN 称它是理解 React 为何拒绝按技术分离关注点的著名演讲，也适合被 JSX 困扰的新手。
summary: Pete Hunt of Facebook and Instagram introduces React at JSConf EU 2013 and explains its design principles. He argues that separating templates from logic only separates technologies, not concerns, and makes the case for components.
why_hn: HN calls it the famous talk for understanding why React rejected separation of concerns by technology and for newcomers puzzled by JSX.

title: The man with 1,000 Klein Bottles UNDER his house - Numberphile
title_zh: 地下藏有 1000 个克莱因瓶的人 - Numberphile
summary_zh: Numberphile 拜访 ACME Klein Bottles 的 Cliff Stoll，看他如何把一千个玻璃克莱因瓶存放在自家房子下的爬行空间里。一台遥控叉车负责取货。
why_zh: HN 评论者喜欢 Cliff Stoll 真诚而顽皮的性格，认为这是对他奇特仓库的愉快一瞥。
summary: Numberphile visits Cliff Stoll, the man behind ACME Klein Bottles, and sees how he stores a thousand glass Klein bottles in a crawlspace under his house. A remote-controlled forklift fetches them.
why_hn: HN commenters love Cliff Stoll's earnest, playful personality and point to this as a delightful look at his unusual warehouse.

title: David Heinemeier Hansson at Startup School 08
title_zh: David Heinemeier Hansson 在 Startup School 08
summary_zh: David Heinemeier Hansson 在 2008 年 Startup School 谈如何打造盈利的初创公司。他主张自力更生，建立小而经营良好的公司，而不是追逐投资和退出。
why_zh: 十多年来，HN 一直把它推荐给自力更生创业者和超大规模创业文化怀疑者，称其为有启发性、有影响力的演讲。
summary: David Heinemeier Hansson's talk at Startup School 2008 on building a profitable startup. He argues for bootstrapping and small, well-run companies instead of chasing investment and exits.
why_hn: For over a decade HN has pointed bootstrappers and skeptics of hyper-scale startup culture to it as a motivating, influential talk.

title: I bought 1000 meters of wire to settle a physics debate
title_zh: 我买了 1000 米电线来终结一场物理争论
summary_zh: AlphaPhoenix 用约一公里电线和示波器搭建了 Veritasium 电学思想实验的缩小版。他测量信号实际如何传播，并解释结果。
why_zh: HN 认为这是对 Veritasium 电线争论最好的实验反驳与澄清，有真实测量数据。
summary: AlphaPhoenix builds a scaled-down version of the Veritasium electricity thought experiment using about a kilometer of wire and an oscilloscope. He measures how the signal actually propagates and explains the result.
why_hn: HN considers it the best experimental rebuttal and clarification of the Veritasium wire debate, with real measurements.

title: Building a realistic artificial sun (for dark winter days)
title_zh: 打造一轮逼真的人造太阳（为了阴冷的冬日）
summary_zh: DIY Perks 用大功率水冷 LED、卫星天线反射盘和散射层做出了一轮接近真实阳光的人造太阳，并解释了为什么大多数灯具看起来都不像日光。视频还讲解了背后的光学原理以及最终效果。
why_zh: 每当 HN 讨论季节性情绪失调、近视或室内照明时，它都会被当作最可信、可复现的「人造阳光」范例推荐。
summary: DIY Perks builds a realistic artificial sun for dark winters, using a powerful water-cooled LED, a satellite dish reflector for near-parallel rays, and a scattering layer to mimic the blue sky. The video explains the optics behind why most lamps do not look like sunlight and shows the build and its results.
why_hn: Whenever HN discusses seasonal affective disorder, myopia, or bright home lighting, people point to this as the most convincing buildable example of sunlight-like illumination.

title: 1. How Buildings Learn - Stewart Brand - 1 of 6 - “Flow”
title_zh: 《建筑如何学习》第 1 集：Flow（Stewart Brand，共 6 集）
summary_zh: 这是 Stewart Brand 1997 年 BBC 系列纪录片的第一集，改编自他的同名著作，讲述建筑建成之后如何被不断改造。由 Brand 本人主持，Brian Eno 配乐。
why_zh: HN 推荐它是因为它把建筑看作动态系统，对软件架构和长期维护很有启发。
summary: The first episode of Stewart Brand's 1997 BBC series based on his book How Buildings Learn, covering how buildings change after they are built. Brand presents and the series has music by Brian Eno.
why_hn: HN recommends it as a view of buildings as dynamic systems, with lessons for software architecture and long-term maintenance.

title: America Keeps Rejecting an ID Card It Already Has
title_zh: 美国一直拒绝承认它早已拥有的身份证
summary_zh: CGP Grey 讲述了美国社会保障卡和社保号的历史，说明它本来并非身份证，却如何变成了事实上的国民身份标识，以及美国为何始终抗拒真正的身份证制度。
why_zh: 每逢身份盗用和数据泄露的讨论，HN 都会引用它作为「SSN 为何是糟糕标识符」最清晰、最好看的短片解释。
summary: CGP Grey explains the history of the US Social Security card and number, and why they became a de facto national ID despite never being meant for it. He also covers why America resists a proper identity card.
why_hn: HN reaches for it in every identity theft and data breach thread as the clearest, most enjoyable short explainer of why SSNs make bad identifiers.

title: DEF CON 25 - John Sotos - Genetic Diseases to Guide Digital Hacks of the Human Genome
title_zh: DEF CON 25：John Sotos——用遗传疾病指导人类基因组的数字攻击
summary_zh: 医生、英特尔前首席医疗官 John Sotos 在 DEF CON 25 上提出，遗传疾病就是基因组中可被利用的漏洞，并警告 CRISPR 等工具会让恶意基因编辑和定向生物武器成为可能。
why_zh: 每当 DNA 检测、CRISPR 或生物武器成为话题，它都会被推荐，常被评论者称为促使他们拒绝把 DNA 交给数据库的那场演讲。
summary: John Sotos, a physician and former Intel chief medical officer, argues at DEF CON 25 that genetic diseases are exploitable vulnerabilities in the genome. He warns that CRISPR and related tools will make malicious genome hacks and targeted bioweapons feasible.
why_hn: Recommended whenever DNA testing, CRISPR or bioweapons come up, often as the talk that made commenters decide to keep their DNA out of databases.

title: Why Heat Pumps are Immensely Important Right Now
title_zh: 热泵为何在当下至关重要
summary_zh: Technology Connections 讲解了热泵为何此刻如此重要，涵盖其效率、在寒冷气候下的表现，以及相比燃烧燃料能节省多少能源。本片接续他此前关于热泵工作原理的讲解。
why_zh: 凭借主讲人清晰而热情的讲解，它是 HN 上回答「热泵到底管不管用、为什么高效」的默认推荐。
summary: Technology Connections explains why heat pumps matter right now, covering their efficiency, how they hold up in cold weather and the energy savings over burning fuel. It follows his earlier explainer on how they work.
why_hn: HN's default link for anyone asking whether heat pumps work and why they're efficient, thanks to the presenter's clear and enthusiastic delivery.

title: Steve Jobs' 2005 Stanford Commencement Address
title_zh: Steve Jobs 2005 年斯坦福大学毕业典礼演讲
summary_zh: Steve Jobs 在 2005 年斯坦福毕业典礼上讲了三个故事：串连人生的点滴、爱与失去、以及死亡，其中提到书法课，并以「求知若饥，虚心若愚」结尾。
why_zh: HN 常回到它寻找激励与视角，并反复引用，尤其是「connect the dots」和「记住死亡」两段。
summary: Steve Jobs' 2005 Stanford commencement address, told through three stories: connecting the dots, love and loss, and death. It includes the calligraphy class and the 'stay hungry, stay foolish' close.
why_hn: HN returns to it for motivation and perspective, and quotes it constantly, especially the connect-the-dots and remembering-death passages.

title: Diffie-Hellman Key Exchange
title_zh: Diffie-Hellman 密钥交换
summary_zh: 一段短片介绍公钥密码学的历史与原理，以及 Diffie-Hellman 密钥交换，用「混合颜料」的比喻说明双方如何在公开信道上协商出共享密钥。
why_zh: 它是 Diffie-Hellman 的入门首选解释，颜料类比让人无需密码学基础也能一点就通。
summary: A short explainer on the history and mechanics of public key cryptography and the Diffie-Hellman key exchange. It uses a mixing-paint-colors analogy to show how two parties can agree on a shared secret in public.
why_hn: It is the go-to beginner explanation of Diffie-Hellman, recommended because the paint analogy makes the idea click without prior cryptography knowledge.

title: Jackie Chan - How to Do Action Comedy
title_zh: 成龙——如何拍动作喜剧
summary_zh: Every Frame a Painting 分析成龙如何设计动作喜剧，总结出从劣势开局、利用环境、镜头清晰、动作与反应同框等九条原则。
why_zh: HN 一再推荐它，认为它最清楚地解释了成龙的打斗场面为何胜过快速剪辑的好莱坞动作片。
summary: Every Frame a Painting analyzes how Jackie Chan stages action comedy, with nine principles such as starting from a disadvantage, using the environment, clear shots, and keeping action and reaction in the same frame.
why_hn: HN repeatedly recommends it as the clearest explanation of why Chan's fight scenes beat fast-cut Hollywood action.

title: Elevator Hacking: From the Pit to the Penthouse
title_zh: 电梯黑客：从井底到顶层公寓
summary_zh: Deviant Ollam 用两小时详细拆解电梯的构造，从底坑、缓冲器到轿顶、控制逻辑和门禁功能，并演示这些知识如何用于优化乘梯乃至绕过楼宇安防。
why_zh: HN 评论者称它是一场引人入胜的电梯安全深度讲解，每逢电梯话题必被翻出。
summary: Deviant Ollam's two-hour conference talk explains how elevators work, from the pit and buffers to the car top, controller logic and access-control features. It shows how this knowledge can be used for optimization and for bypassing building security.
why_hn: HN commenters call it an absorbing, entertaining deep dive on elevator security and the go-to link whenever elevators come up.

title: Bay Area Vision Meeting: Unsupervised Feature Learning and Deep Learning
title_zh: 湾区愿景会议：无监督特征学习与深度学习
summary_zh: Andrew Ng 讲解无监督特征学习与深度学习，展示算法如何从无标注数据中自动学到表示，而非依赖人工设计特征，并给出视觉与音频方面的例子，包括各层学到特征的可视化。
why_zh: HN 评论者多年来一直推荐它，作为对这一波深度学习浪潮简明又令人兴奋的概览。
summary: Andrew Ng presents unsupervised feature learning and deep learning, showing how algorithms can learn representations from unlabeled data instead of hand-designed features. He gives examples in vision and audio, including visualizations of features learned by successive layers.
why_hn: HN commenters recommended it for years as a simple, exciting overview of the deep learning wave.

title: Contrepreneurs: The Mikkelsen Twins
title_zh: Contrepreneurs：Mikkelsen 双胞胎
summary_zh: Folding Ideas 的 Dan Olson 调查 Mikkelsen 双胞胎和「代写有声书躺赚」课程生意，甚至亲身参与其中体验这套套路。这是一部长篇视频论文，讲的是快速致富式的出版骗局。
why_zh: 每当讨论图书垃圾信息、AI 生成的电子书或被动收入创业文化时，HN 都会贴上它。
summary: Dan Olson of Folding Ideas investigates the Mikkelsen Twins and the ghostwritten-audiobook passive-income course industry, even playing along with the scheme. It is a long video essay on get-rich-quick publishing grifts.
why_hn: HN links it whenever threads cover book spam, AI-written ebooks or passive-income hustle culture.

title: Invited Talk - Guy Steele
title_zh: 特邀演讲——Guy Steele
summary_zh: Guy Steele 在 Clojure/conj 的特邀演讲中，讨论计算机科学家在论文里描述语言时使用的那种非正式元记号，追溯它的演变，并解释它为何往往缺乏规范、晦涩难懂。
why_zh: 每当有人问起如何读懂论文里的类型系统或计算机科学记号，HN 评论者都会推荐它。
summary: Guy Steele's invited talk at Clojure/conj on the informal metanotation computer scientists use in papers to describe languages. He traces how this notation developed and why it is often unspecified and arcane.
why_hn: HN commenters recommend it whenever someone asks how to read type-system or CS notation in papers.

title: Literate Devops with Emacs
title_zh: 用 Emacs 实践 Literate DevOps
summary_zh: Howard Abrams 在 EmacsConf 2015 的演讲中演示如何用 org-mode 的 Babel 和 Tramp，从一份文档里配置和操作远程服务器。代码块、执行结果与说明文字都放在同一处。
why_zh: HN 用户称它是 literate devops 的最佳示范，把文档与执行真正编织在一起。
summary: Howard Abrams demonstrates, in an EmacsConf 2015 talk, how he uses org-mode's Babel and Tramp to configure and operate remote servers from a single document. Code blocks, their results and the explanatory text all live together.
why_hn: HN people point to it as the best demonstration of literate devops, showing documentation and execution woven together in Emacs.

title: SNES Code Injection -- Flappy Bird in SMW
title_zh: SNES 代码注入：在 SMW 中运行 Flappy Bird
summary_zh: SethBling 利用《超级马里奥世界》的漏洞，在一台未改装的 SNES 上注入并运行 Flappy Bird 代码，全程只靠手柄输入。这是首次由人类手工完成此类漏洞利用。
why_zh: 它常被引用为通过游戏操作实现任意代码执行的经典案例，也体现了速通玩家对系统的深入理解。
summary: SethBling uses Super Mario World glitches to inject and run Flappy Bird code on an unmodified SNES, entering it purely with controller inputs. It was the first time a human completed this kind of exploit by hand.
why_hn: Constantly cited as the canonical example of arbitrary code execution through gameplay and of deep system knowledge among speedrunners.

title: A Hackers' Guide to Language Models
title_zh: 面向黑客的语言模型指南
summary_zh: Jeremy Howard 用 90 分钟对语言模型做了实用导览，涵盖其工作原理、GPT-4 的能力与局限、OpenAI API 的使用、代码编写、数据分析与微调。
why_zh: 它被反复评为使用 LLM 的最佳实用教程，其中微调部分尤其受好评。
summary: Jeremy Howard's 90-minute practical tour of language models. It covers how they work, GPT-4's capabilities and limits, using the OpenAI API, code writing, data analysis and fine-tuning.
why_hn: Repeatedly named the best practical tutorial for using LLMs, with a well-liked fine-tuning section.

title: Essence of linear algebra preview
title_zh: 线性代数的本质：系列预览
summary_zh: 这是 3Blue1Brown《Essence of Linear Algebra》系列的五分钟预览，该系列用动画为标准线性代数课程中的主题建立几何直觉。
why_zh: HN 反复推荐该系列为最直观、最重直觉的线性代数入门，也是清晰讲解数学的标杆。
summary: A five-minute preview of 3Blue1Brown's Essence of Linear Algebra series, which uses animation to build geometric intuition for topics from a standard linear algebra course.
why_hn: HN repeatedly recommends the series as the best intuition-first, visual introduction to linear algebra and a benchmark for clear math explanation.

title: Analogy as the Core of Cognition
title_zh: 类比是认知的核心
summary_zh: Douglas Hofstadter 在斯坦福大学校长讲座中主张，类比是认知的核心，并说明概念、分类与思维如何从类比制造中产生。
why_zh: HN 常客把它视为讨论概念、类比与隐喻时必看的 Hofstadter 趣味演讲。
summary: Douglas Hofstadter's Stanford Presidential Lecture argues that analogy is the core of cognition, illustrating how concepts, categorization and thought arise from analogy-making.
why_hn: HN regulars treat it as an essential, fun Hofstadter talk for any discussion of concepts, analogy and metaphor.

title: Failing to Fail: The Spiderweb Software Way
title_zh: Failing to Fail：Spiderweb Software 的独立游戏生存之道
summary_zh: Spiderweb Software 的 Jeff Vogel 在 GDC 2018 回顾了自 1994 年以来作为独立游戏开发者的生存经历，从共享软件时代一路讲到 Steam。他谈到了商业现实、成本，以及如何在不追逐暴利的情况下维持舒适生活。
why_zh: HN 一直推荐它作为一场鼓舞人心又风趣的演讲，讲述如何长期经营独立工作室，以及 Steam 抽成 30% 到底提供了什么。
summary: Jeff Vogel of Spiderweb Software gives a GDC 2018 retrospective on surviving as an indie game maker since 1994, from shareware days through Steam. It covers business realities, costs and sustaining a comfortable living without chasing riches.
why_hn: HN keeps recommending it as an inspirational, funny talk on running a long-lived indie studio and what Steam provides for its 30% cut.

title: AT&T Archives: The UNIX Operating System
title_zh: AT&T 档案馆：UNIX 操作系统
summary_zh: 这是 1982 年由 Bell Labs 制作、Victor Vyssotsky 主持的影片，讲述 UNIX 操作系统的起源与设计哲学，Kernighan、Thompson 和 Ritchie 均有出镜。片中展示了管道、过滤器，以及用一行 shell 命令搭建拼写检查器的过程。
why_zh: HN 用户推荐它，因为这是来自创造者本人、对 Unix 管道与小工具哲学最清晰的一手解释。
summary: A 1982 Bell Labs film hosted by Victor Vyssotsky on the origins and design philosophy of the UNIX operating system, with appearances by Kernighan, Thompson and Ritchie. It shows pipes, filters and a shell one-liner spell checker being built.
why_hn: HN points people to it as the clearest primary-source explanation of Unix pipes and the small-tools philosophy, straight from the creators.

title: How to green the world's deserts and reverse climate change | Allan Savory
title_zh: 如何让世界沙漠变绿并逆转气候变化 | Allan Savory
summary_zh: Allan Savory 在 TED 演讲中主张，通过整体管理的放牧可以逆转草原荒漠化，并称这还有助于逆转气候变化。TED 也注明，其他科学家对他的说法提出了质疑。
why_zh: HN 评论者在气候与食品讨论中常提到它，认为这是一个关于放牧与土壤碳的乐观但仍有争议的想法。
summary: Allan Savory's TED talk arguing that desertification of grasslands can be reversed with holistic managed grazing, which he says would also help reverse climate change. TED notes that other scientists have challenged his claims.
why_hn: HN commenters bring it up in climate and food threads as a hopeful, if contested, idea about grazing and soil carbon.

title: Dan Abramov - Live React: Hot Reloading with Time Travel at react-europe 2015
title_zh: Dan Abramov — Live React：带时间旅行的热重载（react-europe 2015）
summary_zh: Dan Abramov 在 React Europe 2015 现场编写带时间旅行调试的热重载，并首次公开 Redux 及其开发者工具。连幻灯片本身都由应用状态驱动。
why_zh: 它被视为 Redux 的经典入门演讲，也是关于改进开发者工具的现场编程典范。
summary: Dan Abramov live-codes hot reloading with time-travel debugging at React Europe 2015, debuting Redux and its devtools. The slides themselves are driven by application state.
why_hn: Seen as the canonical Redux introduction and a model live-coding talk about better developer tools.

title: 34C3 -  The Ultimate Apollo Guidance Computer Talk
title_zh: 34C3：终极阿波罗导航计算机讲座
summary_zh: Michael Steil 与 Christian Hessmann 在 34C3 的演讲中端到端讲解阿波罗导航计算机：硬件设计、操作系统与任务软件。
why_zh: 它被反复称为最出色、最全面的 AGC 讲座，评论者会反复观看，并把它当作计算机体系结构的基础学习材料。
summary: Michael Steil and Christian Hessmann's 34C3 talk explaining the Apollo Guidance Computer end to end: hardware design, operating system, and mission software.
why_hn: Repeatedly called the best and most comprehensive AGC talk, with commenters rewatching it and treating it as foundational computer architecture learning.

title: Can YOU Fix Climate Change?
title_zh: 你能解决气候变化吗？
summary_zh: Kurzgesagt 探讨个人在气候变化上究竟能做什么，介绍了若干鲜为人知的碳排放来源，并说明为什么系统性与政治层面的变革比个人碳足迹更重要。
why_zh: 气候讨论帖中常被引用，用来论证个人行动远远不够、必须转向政治施压。
summary: Kurzgesagt examines what individuals can do about climate change, covering lesser-known carbon sources and why systemic and political change matter more than personal footprints.
why_hn: Cited in climate threads to argue that individual action is not enough and that political pressure is needed.

title: Powers of Ten™ (1977)
title_zh: 十的次方（Powers of Ten，1977）
summary_zh: Eames Office 1977 年的经典短片，从芝加哥湖畔的野餐场景出发，每十秒拉远十倍直到宇宙边缘，再一路向内推进到碳原子中的质子。
why_zh: 每当讨论涉及尺度或大小对比，HN 评论者都会推荐它作为建立尺度直觉的经典可视化作品。
summary: The Eames Office's 1977 film Powers of Ten starts at a picnic in Chicago and zooms out by a factor of ten every ten seconds to the edge of the universe. It then zooms inward to a proton in a carbon atom.
why_hn: HN commenters recommend it as the classic visualization for building intuition about scale, and it comes up whenever a thread concerns scale or size comparisons.

title: [Linux.conf.au 2013] - Git For Ages 4 And Up
title_zh: Git For Ages 4 And Up（Linux.conf.au 2013）
summary_zh: Linux.conf.au 2013 的一场演讲，用玩具和游戏化的方式讲解 Git 的内部模型，把各种 Git 操作呈现为对提交图的操作，专门面向那些觉得 Git 难以理解的人。
why_zh: 尽管标题古怪，HN 一再推荐它是让初学者终于搞懂 Git 数据模型的那场演讲。
summary: A Linux.conf.au 2013 talk that explains git's internal model using a playful, toy-based approach. It presents git operations as operations on a graph of commits, aimed at people who find git confusing.
why_hn: HN repeatedly recommends it as the talk that finally makes git's data model click for beginners, despite its odd title.

title: Sunlight: Optimize Health and Immunity (Light Therapy and Melatonin)
title_zh: 阳光：优化健康与免疫力（光疗与褪黑素）
summary_zh: MedCram 的 Roger Seheult 医生梳理阳光在维生素 D 之外的健康益处，涉及太阳光谱、昼夜节律、褪黑素与红外光。讲座近两小时，配有章节时间戳。
why_zh: HN 引用它作为由医生主讲、通俗易懂的综述，支持关于红外光、线粒体和晨间日照的说法。
summary: Dr. Roger Seheult of MedCram reviews the benefits of sunlight beyond vitamin D, covering the solar spectrum, circadian rhythm, melatonin and infrared light. The lecture runs nearly two hours with timestamps.
why_hn: HN cites it as an accessible physician-led review supporting claims about infrared light, mitochondria and morning sun.

title: A Swift Introduction to Geometric Algebra
title_zh: 几何代数简明入门
summary_zh: 一部用动画讲解几何代数的入门视频，把几何代数视为一种足以描述大部分物理学的语言，使用 manim 制作，涵盖多重向量以及它如何统一叉积、四元数等熟悉工具。
why_zh: HN 称其为关于几何代数最好的视频，能在约 40 分钟内让这个主题豁然开朗。
summary: An animated introduction to geometric algebra, presented as a language that can describe most of physics. It was made with manim and covers multivectors and how they generalize familiar tools like cross products and quaternions.
why_hn: HN calls it the best video on geometric algebra, one that makes the subject click in about 40 minutes.

title: Debt: The First 5,000 Years | David Graeber | Talks at Google
title_zh: 《债：第一个五千年》David Graeber 在 Google 的演讲
summary_zh: David Graeber 在 Talks at Google 介绍他的著作《债：第一个五千年》，讲述债务的历史、以物易物神话以及禧年豁免传统。
why_zh: HN 推荐它是用 80 分钟把握全书要点、并获得关于货币本质另一种视角的捷径。
summary: David Graeber's Talks at Google presentation on his book Debt: The First 5,000 Years, covering the history of debt, the myth of barter and the Jubilee tradition.
why_hn: HN recommends it as an 80-minute way to get the gist of the book and a different view of what money is.

title: 7 minutes of Pharo Smalltalk for Rubyists
title_zh: 给 Ruby 程序员的 7 分钟 Pharo Smalltalk 导览
summary_zh: Ruby 开发者 Avdi Grimm 用七分钟演示 Pharo Smalltalk 的开发环境，重点介绍按示例搜索等工具以及高度集成、实时编程的开发体验。
why_zh: HN 推荐它是快速感受 Smalltalk 工具链魅力的佳作，对 Ruby 程序员尤其有共鸣。
summary: Ruby developer Avdi Grimm gives a seven-minute tour of Pharo Smalltalk's development environment, focusing on tools like search-by-example and the integrated, live coding experience.
why_hn: HN recommends it as a quick, compelling look at what Smalltalk tooling feels like, especially for Ruby programmers.

title: Compiling C to printable x86, to make an executable research paper
title_zh: 把 C 编译成可打印 x86，做出一篇可执行的论文
summary_zh: Tom7 讲述他如何为 SIGBOVIK 2017 制作一篇只由可打印 ASCII 字节组成、同时又是合法 DOS 可执行文件的论文：他写了一个面向可打印 x86、且不使用自修改代码的 C 编译器，并逐一破解这一约束带来的难题。
why_zh: HN 爱好者称它是自己最爱的工程类视频，是 Tom7 大师级玩心十足的黑客作品展示。
summary: Tom7 explains how he built a SIGBOVIK 2017 paper made only of printable ASCII bytes that is also a valid DOS executable. He writes a C compiler targeting printable x86 without self-modifying code and solves the puzzles the constraint creates.
why_hn: HN fans call it a favorite engineering video and a showcase of Tom7's masterpiece-level, playful hacking.

title: How close is nuclear fusion power?
title_zh: 核聚变发电到底还有多远？
summary_zh: Sabine Hossenfelder 解释核聚变离能量收支平衡究竟还有多远，以及关于 ITER 和实验室里程碑的新闻标题为何具有误导性。她区分了等离子体增益（Q plasma）与全系统增益（Q total），并指出后者仍远低于 1。
why_zh: 几乎每篇聚变突破报道下，HN 评论者都会贴出它作为对 Q 值炒作的例行现实检验。
summary: Sabine Hossenfelder explains how close nuclear fusion really is to break-even, and why headlines about ITER and lab milestones are misleading. She distinguishes plasma gain (Q plasma) from whole-system gain (Q total) and shows the latter is still far below one.
why_hn: HN commenters post it under nearly every fusion breakthrough story as the standard reality check on Q-factor hype.

title: I messed up. You're using too much detergent.
title_zh: 我搞错了：你的洗碗粉用得太多了
summary_zh: Technology Connections 讲解洗碗机洗涤剂的使用，认为人们用量普遍过多，而且粉状产品优于凝珠和凝胶。这是此前洗碗机视频的续篇，内容涉及酶、漂白剂、漂洗助剂以及何时需要加软水盐。
why_zh: HN 视这系列洗碗机视频为必看的实用科普，凡涉及洗碗机、洗涤剂或凝珠的讨论必被引用。
summary: Technology Connections explains dishwasher detergent use, arguing people use too much and that powder beats pods and gels. It follows an earlier dishwasher video and covers enzymes, bleach, rinse aids and when salt is needed.
why_hn: HN regards the dishwasher videos as must-watch practical explainers, linked whenever dishwashers, detergents or pods come up.

title: The hardest problem on the hardest test
title_zh: 最难考试上最难的那道题
summary_zh: 3Blue1Brown 逐步拆解一道极难的 Putnam 竞赛题及其优雅解法，着重呈现背后的视觉直觉与解题思路的形成过程。
why_zh: HN 读者把它列为自己最爱的 3Blue1Brown 视频之一，因为它展示了数学解题的真实思维过程。
summary: 3Blue1Brown walks through a very hard Putnam competition problem and its elegant solution, emphasizing the visual intuition and the thought process behind solving it.
why_hn: HN fans list it among their favorite 3Blue1Brown videos for showing how mathematical problem solving actually unfolds.

title: Break Me00 The MoVfuscator Turning mov into a soul crushing RE nightmare Christopher Domas
title_zh: Break Me00：MoVfuscator——把 mov 变成逆向工程噩梦
summary_zh: Christopher Domas 在 Derbycon 2015 的演讲，介绍只生成 x86 mov 指令的编译器 M/o/Vfuscator，证明 mov 是图灵完备的。他解释了如何仅用 mov 搭建出一台完整机器，以及为何其输出对逆向工程而言是噩梦。
why_zh: 每逢讨论只用 mov 的计算或反反编译手段，HN 都会称它是讲解清晰、堪称传奇的黑客演讲。
summary: Christopher Domas's Derbycon 2015 talk on the M/o/Vfuscator, a compiler that emits only x86 mov instructions, showing mov is Turing complete. It explains how a full machine is built from mov and why the output is a nightmare to reverse engineer.
why_hn: HN calls it a legendary, clearly explained hacker talk whenever mov-only computing or anti-decompilation comes up.

title: Imaginary Numbers Are Real [Part 1: Introduction]
title_zh: 虚数并不虚幻（第一部分：导论）
summary_zh: Welch Labs 虚数系列的第一集，把虚数看作数轴向二维的自然延伸，结合历史与数学，并配以精良的可视化。
why_zh: HN 评论者认为它是讲解复数的最佳可视化教学系列之一，特别适合用来建立直觉。
summary: The first part of Welch Labs' series on imaginary numbers, presenting them as the natural extension of the number line into two dimensions. It covers the history and the math with strong visuals.
why_hn: HN commenters rate the series as some of the best visual teaching on complex numbers and recommend it for building intuition.

title: Bottom Up vs  Top Down Design in Clojure - Mark Bastian
title_zh: Clojure 中的自底向上与自顶向下设计 - Mark Bastian
summary_zh: Mark Bastian 对比了面向对象的自顶向下设计与 Clojure 面向数据的自底向上设计，用一个桌游为例，以纯数据加小型可组合函数实现出来，并与约 22 个类的 OOP 版本作对照。
why_zh: HN 多次推荐，称正是这场演讲让人一下子理解了面向数据、REPL 驱动的自底向上设计。
summary: Mark Bastian contrasts top-down object-oriented design with bottom-up, data-oriented design in Clojure. He models a board game as plain data plus small composable functions and compares it with a roughly 22-class OOP version.
why_hn: HN repeatedly recommends it as the talk that made data-oriented, REPL-driven bottom-up design click.

title: TempleOS | Down the Rabbit Hole
title_zh: TempleOS｜掉进兔子洞
summary_zh: Fredrik Knudsen 的 86 分钟纪录片，讲述 TempleOS 作者 Terry A. Davis 的工作、精神分裂症与人生衰败，依据他的公开帖子和视频按时间线梳理。
why_zh: 被视为关于 Terry Davis 与 TempleOS 最权威、也最令人心碎的记述。
summary: Fredrik Knudsen's 86-minute documentary on Terry A. Davis, creator of TempleOS, tracing his work, his schizophrenia and his decline. It is a chronological video essay built on his public posts and videos.
why_hn: Regarded as the definitive, if heartbreaking, account of Terry Davis and TempleOS.

title: Plover: Thought to Text at 240 WPM
title_zh: Plover：从思维到文字，240 WPM
summary_zh: Mirabai Knight 在 PyCon 2013 介绍 Plover——一个免费跨平台的速录引擎，让人能在普通硬件上以最高每分钟 240 词的速度输入，并现场演示用速录写代码。
why_zh: 每当 HN 讨论打字速度、人体工学或替代输入方式，它都是标准参考，因为这里有现场演示和开源速录生态。
