summary: Mirabai Knight's PyCon 2013 talk on Plover, a free cross-platform stenography engine that lets people write at up to 240 WPM on ordinary hardware, including a demo of coding by steno.
why_hn: HN's standard reference when typing speed, ergonomics, or alternative input comes up, for its live demo and the open-source steno ecosystem.

title: "The Economics of Programming Languages" by Evan Czaplicki (Strange Loop 2023)
title_zh: 《编程语言的经济学》Evan Czaplicki（Strange Loop 2023）
summary_zh: Elm 作者 Evan Czaplicki 剖析编程语言如何获得资金：编译器工程师的薪水从哪来、为什么 Go 只有约 5 名工程师而 Dart 有约 30 名，以及这如何制约语言设计。
why_zh: 被反复推荐为一场幽默又信息量十足的演讲，讲透编程语言与开源背后的经济账。
summary: Evan Czaplicki, creator of Elm, examines how programming languages are funded. He looks at where compiler engineers' salaries come from, why Go has about 5 engineers while Dart has about 30, and how this limits language design.
why_hn: Recommended repeatedly as a funny, informative talk on the economics behind programming languages and open source.

title: BlackHat USA 2011: SSL And The Future Of Authenticity
title_zh: BlackHat USA 2011：SSL 与真实性的未来
summary_zh: Moxie Marlinspike 在 BlackHat 2011 剖析 SSL 与 CA 证书体系的弱点，并提出 Convergence——一种具备“信任敏捷性”的去中心化公证人方案。
why_zh: HN 评论者反复推荐，认为它最清楚地解释了 CA 体系为何失灵，以及有哪些替代方案。
summary: Moxie Marlinspike's BlackHat 2011 talk examines weaknesses of SSL and the certificate authority system and proposes Convergence, a decentralized notary approach with trust agility.
why_hn: HN commenters repeatedly recommend it as the best explanation of why the CA system is broken and what alternatives exist.

title: Julia: to Lisp or not to Lisp?
title_zh: Julia：算不算 Lisp？
summary_zh: Stefan Karpinski 在 2016 年欧洲 Lisp 研讨会上探讨 Julia 是不是 Lisp：它借用了宏、闭包等特性，又在语法与类型系统上另辟蹊径，并展示了生成的机器码。
why_zh: HN 评论者称这是一场精彩的演讲，讲清了 Julia 的设计以及它与 Lisp 的异同。
summary: Stefan Karpinski's European Lisp Symposium 2016 talk asks whether Julia is a Lisp. He covers the features it borrows from Lisp, such as macros and closures, and where it departs, including syntax and its type system, with generated machine code shown.
why_hn: HN commenters recommend it as a brilliant talk on Julia's design and how it is or isn't a Lisp.

title: Life in Syntropy
title_zh: Life in Syntropy（共生农业中的生命）
summary_zh: Agenda Gotsch 为 COP21 制作的短片，介绍 Ernst Gotsch 的合成农业与农林复合方法，展示退化土地如何被恢复为高产林地农场。
why_zh: HN 用户屡次把它推荐为了解农林复合作为气候与粮食解决方案的最佳入门。
summary: A short film from Agenda Gotsch introducing syntropic agriculture and Ernst Gotsch's agroforestry methods, made for COP21. It shows degraded land regenerated into productive forest farms.
why_hn: HN users repeatedly offer it as the best introduction to agroforestry as a climate and food solution.

title: The Egg - A Short Story
title_zh: 《蛋》——一个短篇故事
summary_zh: Kurzgesagt 把 Andy Weir 的短篇小说《The Egg》动画化：主人公得知自己就是曾经活过的每一个人，作品在原作基础上配上音乐与旁白。
why_zh: HN 评论者称这是一个深受喜爱的故事，当帖子涉及意识、共情或身份时就会有人贴出这段动画。
summary: Kurzgesagt animates Andy Weir's short story The Egg, in which a person learns that they are every human who has ever lived. It adds music and narration to the original text.
why_hn: HN commenters call it a beloved story and link the animation when threads touch on consciousness, empathy or identity.

title: "The Mess We're In" by Joe Armstrong
title_zh: 《我们身处的乱局》Joe Armstrong
summary_zh: Erlang 共同创造者 Joe Armstrong 在 Strange Loop 带来的一场风趣而尖锐的演讲，谈构建工具、包管理器、熵与计算的物理极限，并主张用内容哈希命名、丢掉第一版等做法。
why_zh: HN 一再回到这场演讲，认为它对软件为何臃肿混乱的诊断至今准确，凡涉及模块、包管理器或软件质量的讨论都会推荐它。
summary: Joe Armstrong, co-inventor of Erlang, gives a funny and opinionated Strange Loop talk on the tangled state of software: build tools, package managers, entropy and the physical limits of computation. He argues for ideas like naming things by content hash and throwing away your first version.
why_hn: HN returns to it constantly as a witty, still-accurate diagnosis of why software is bloated and messy, and as a go-to recommendation in any thread on modules, package managers or software quality.

title: Once you understand game theory, you understand the world.
title_zh: 看懂博弈论，就看懂了世界
summary_zh: Veritasium 通过囚徒困境与 Axelrod 的竞赛说明，为何“以牙还牙”和带宽容的策略能在重复博弈中胜出，并把思路延伸到进化中的合作与冲突。
why_zh: HN 评论者常拿它作通俗解释，说明合作与互惠为何是理性策略。
summary: Veritasium explores the Prisoner's Dilemma and Axelrod's tournaments, showing why tit-for-tat and forgiving strategies win in repeated games. It extends the ideas to cooperation in evolution and conflict.
why_hn: HN commenters reach for it constantly as an approachable explanation of why cooperation and reciprocity are rational strategies.

title: The Speed of Light is NOT About Light
title_zh: 光速其实与光无关
summary_zh: PBS Space Time 提出，光速更准确的理解是“因果律的速度”，即因果关系在宇宙中传播的普遍上限。光之所以以这个速度前进，只是因为它没有质量，而这一极限本身是时空的属性。
why_zh: 每当 HN 讨论里有人把光速误解成光特有的限制，就会有人贴出这期视频，不少人说它让自己真正理解了相对论。
summary: PBS Space Time argues that the speed of light is better understood as the speed of causality, the universal limit on how fast cause and effect propagate. Light travels at that speed because it is massless, but the limit itself is a property of spacetime.
why_hn: HN commenters send people to it whenever a thread confuses the speed of light with a light-specific limit, and several say it deepened their understanding of relativity.

title: Master Your Sleep & Be More Alert When Awake
title_zh: 掌控你的睡眠，醒来更清醒
summary_zh: Andrew Huberman 的播客节目讲解人为何会困、怎样才能睡得沉、白天又如何保持警觉。他梳理了相关科学原理，并给出光照时机等一套行为层面的可操作建议。
why_zh: HN 用户反复表示这期节目治好了自己的睡眠问题，尤其是早晨晒太阳、晚上调暗灯光这两条建议。
summary: Andrew Huberman's podcast episode on what makes us sleepy, helps us sleep soundly and keeps us alert. It lays out the science and a set of behavioral tools such as light timing.
why_hn: HN users repeatedly credit it with fixing their sleep, especially its advice on morning light and dimming lights in the evening.

title: Jim Keller: Moore’s Law is Not Dead
title_zh: Jim Keller：摩尔定律没有死
summary_zh: Jim Keller 在 UC Berkeley EECS 学术报告上论证摩尔定律并未终结。他梳理了即将到来的各项技术，以及多条能继续推动晶体管密度与性能提升的创新曲线。
why_zh: 这是 HN 摩尔定律讨论中的标配引用，来自顶尖 CPU 设计师的有力反驳。
summary: Jim Keller gives a UC Berkeley EECS colloquium arguing that Moore's Law is not dead. He surveys upcoming technologies and the multiple innovation curves that can keep transistor density and performance scaling.
why_hn: The go-to citation in Moore's Law threads, a convincing counterargument from a top CPU designer.

title: Jonathan Blow - Preventing the Collapse of Civilization (English only)
title_zh: Jonathan Blow：防止文明崩溃
summary_zh: Jonathan Blow 在 DevGAMM 2019 的演讲认为，软件知识正在代际之间流失，而不断堆叠的抽象层可能导致技术文明走向衰落。
why_zh: HN 上常被引用的经典，用来支撑“软件在变差、来之不易的知识正在消失”这类论点。
summary: Jonathan Blow's DevGAMM 2019 talk argues that software knowledge is being lost between generations and that growing layers of abstraction could lead to a decline in technological civilization.
why_hn: A perennial HN reference for arguments that software is getting worse and that hard-won knowledge is disappearing.

title: VidMe or Why Platforms Aren't Your Friends
title_zh: VidMe，或者为什么平台不是你的朋友
summary_zh: Folding Ideas 借 YouTube 竞争者 VidMe 的兴衰，剖析平台为何不是创作者的朋友。它指出，大平台的替代品往往只会吸引被原平台封禁的用户，且缺乏核心愿景。
why_zh: 每当 HN 有人问为什么 YouTube、Reddit、Twitter 的克隆版或替代品会失败、会变得乌烟瘴气，就会被拿出来引用。
summary: Folding Ideas uses the rise and fall of the YouTube competitor VidMe to examine why platforms are not friends to creators. It argues that alternatives to big platforms tend to attract the users banned from the original and lack a core vision.
why_hn: HN commenters cite it whenever a thread asks why clones of or alternatives to YouTube, Reddit or Twitter fail or turn toxic.

title: 27C3: Adventures in analyzing Stuxnet (Bruce Dang from Microsoft)
title_zh: 27C3：分析 Stuxnet 的历险（微软 Bruce Dang）
summary_zh: 微软的 Bruce Dang 在 27C3 讲解了 Stuxnet 漏洞是如何被发现和分析的。他介绍了排查这些漏洞所用的技术手段，并逐个拆解每个零日漏洞的细节，细到操作码层面。
why_zh: HN 推荐它作为对 Stuxnet 零日漏洞最权威的技术深度解析，讲者是亲手分析过它的人。
summary: Bruce Dang of Microsoft gives a 27C3 talk on how the Stuxnet vulnerabilities were found and analyzed. He walks through the techniques used to triage them and the details of each zero-day exploit, down to the opcode level.
why_hn: HN recommends it as the definitive technical deep dive into Stuxnet's zero-days from someone who analyzed it first-hand.

title: Trackers: The Sound of 16-Bit
title_zh: Tracker：16 位元的声音
summary_zh: Ahoy 的纪录片梳理了 tracker 音乐的发展史：从 Amiga 上早期的 SoundMonitor、Soundtracker，到 demoscene、Protracker，再到 PC 上的 Screamtracker 和 FastTracker。它讲述了 16 位模块音乐的声响、文化与历史。
why_zh: 它是对 tracker 音乐按时间顺序、深入全面的综述，只要话题涉及 tracker、Amiga 或 demoscene 就会被推荐。
summary: Ahoy's documentary traces tracker music from early Amiga software like SoundMonitor and Soundtracker through the demoscene, Protracker, and PC trackers such as Screamtracker and FastTracker. It covers the sound, culture and history of 16-bit module music.
why_hn: It is the go-to chronological, in-depth overview of tracker music, recommended whenever trackers, the Amiga or the demoscene come up.

title: Eating less Meat won't save the Planet. Here's Why
title_zh: 少吃肉救不了地球，原因如下
summary_zh: Joseph Everett 与 Frank Mitloehner 博士提出，少吃肉对气候的帮助有限。他们讨论了牛肉的水足迹、土地与饲料占用，以及甲烷问题。
why_zh: HN 用户推荐它作为牛肉环境成本主流说法的一个反方观点，不过也有人批评其中的甲烷论证。
summary: Joseph Everett, with Dr. Frank Mitloehner, argues that eating less meat will not do much for the climate. He covers beef's water footprint, land and feed use, and methane.
why_hn: HN commenters recommend it as a counterpoint to claims about beef's environmental cost, though some critique its methane argument.

title: Dr. Jason Fung - 'Therapeutic Fasting - Solving the Two-Compartment Problem'
title_zh: Jason Fung 博士：治疗性断食——解决“两室问题”
summary_zh: 肾内科医生 Jason Fung 讲解如何用治疗性断食来应对肥胖和 2 型糖尿病。他以脂肪储存与胰岛素抵抗构成的“两室问题”为框架展开论述。
why_zh: HN 用户多次推荐它作为免费且引证充分的断食综述，能打消人们对肌肉流失和安全性的顾虑。
summary: Dr. Jason Fung, a nephrologist, explains therapeutic fasting as a treatment for obesity and type 2 diabetes. He frames it around the two-compartment problem of fat storage and insulin resistance.
why_hn: HN commenters repeatedly recommend it as a free, evidence-citing overview of fasting that counters worries about muscle loss and safety.

title: Frank Abagnale | Catch Me If You Can | Talks at Google
title_zh: Frank Abagnale｜《猫鼠游戏》｜Talks at Google
summary_zh: 《猫鼠游戏》的原型人物 Frank Abagnale 在 Google 讲述自己从诈骗犯转变为 FBI 欺诈与网络安全专家的经历，并给出关于诈骗、数据泄露和信用卡的实用建议。
why_zh: 它被称赞为一场魅力十足、引人入胜的演讲，还包含实用安全知识，比如为什么信用卡比借记卡更能保护你。
summary: Frank Abagnale, the real subject of Catch Me If You Can, speaks at Google about his life as a con man turned FBI fraud and cybersecurity expert, including advice on fraud, breaches and credit cards.
why_hn: Praised as a charismatic, engaging talk with practical security lessons, like why credit cards protect you better than debit cards.

title: Falcon Heavy Test Flight
title_zh: Falcon Heavy 试飞
summary_zh: SpaceX 对 Falcon Heavy 试飞的直播，包括发射、两侧助推器回收和特斯拉 Roadster 载荷。这是当时现役最强火箭的首次发射。
why_zh: HN 用户视其为里程碑式的发射直播，也会细究助推器回收画面重复出现之类的细节。
summary: SpaceX's livestream of the Falcon Heavy test flight, including the launch, side booster landings and Tesla Roadster payload. It was the first launch of the most powerful operational rocket at the time.
why_hn: HN commenters cite it as a landmark launch broadcast, and also dissect details like the duplicated booster landing feeds.

title: Why Japan Looks the Way it Does: Zoning
title_zh: 日本的城市为什么长这样：分区制度
summary_zh: 视频讲解日本城市面貌的成因，关键在于全国统一的分级区划制度，它允许混合用途和灵活开发。影片还将其与其他地方更严格的区划做了对比。
why_zh: 在住房与城市议题的讨论中，HN 用户推荐它作为解释日本区划制度的首选材料。
summary: A video explaining why Japanese cities look the way they do, through Japan's national tiered zoning system that permits mixed use and flexible development. It compares this approach with more restrictive zoning elsewhere.
why_hn: HN commenters recommend it as the go-to explanation of Japanese zoning in housing and urbanism debates.

title: Brown; color is weird
title_zh: 棕色：颜色很奇妙
summary_zh: Technology Connections 解释棕色并不是光谱色，而是一种依赖上下文的感知，本质上是在更亮背景下看到的深橙色。
why_zh: HN 反复推荐它作为关于颜色感知的令人惊讶的精彩科普，常在色彩空间讨论中被引用。
summary: Technology Connections explains why brown is not a spectral color but a context-dependent perception, essentially dark orange seen against brighter surroundings.
why_hn: HN repeatedly recommends it as a surprisingly magical explainer on color perception, often cited in color-space discussions.

title: Conflict Resolution for Eventual Consistency • Martin Kleppmann • GOTO 2016
title_zh: 最终一致性中的冲突解决 • Martin Kleppmann • GOTO 2016
summary_zh: Martin Kleppmann 在 GOTO Berlin 2016 的演讲，讲协作编辑器、离线应用和多数据中心数据库如何处理并发更新。内容涵盖操作转换和 CRDT 等冲突解决方法，并实际剖析文本 CRDT。
why_zh: 被视为关于 CRDT 和协同编辑的通俗又深入的入门首选，在 Automerge、本地优先软件以及 OT 与 CRDT 对比的讨论中反复被推荐。
summary: Martin Kleppmann's GOTO Berlin 2016 talk on how collaborative editors, offline apps, and multi-datacenter databases handle concurrent updates. It covers conflict resolution approaches including operational transformation and CRDTs, with a worked look at text CRDTs.
why_hn: Treated as the go-to approachable yet deep primer on CRDTs and collaborative editing, recommended repeatedly in threads on Automerge, local-first software and OT versus CRDT.

title: "Programming a 144-computer chip to minimize power" - Chuck Moore (2013)
title_zh: 为 144 核芯片编程以最小化功耗——Chuck Moore（2013）
summary_zh: Forth 发明者 Chuck Moore 在 Strange Loop 2013 介绍 GreenArrays 的 144 核异步芯片。他解释空闲核心几乎不耗电，以及紧凑代码如何最小化能耗。
why_zh: 这是理解 Moore 极简、低功耗多核设计和栈式计算机的最受欢迎推荐。
summary: Chuck Moore, inventor of Forth, presents GreenArrays' 144-core asynchronous chip at Strange Loop 2013. He explains how idle cores draw almost no power and how tight code minimizes energy use.
why_hn: It is the favorite recommendation for understanding Moore's minimalist, low-power multi-core designs and stack machines.

title: Blockchains Are a Bad Idea (James Mickens)
title_zh: 区块链是个坏主意（James Mickens）
summary_zh: 哈佛的 James Mickens 在 HBS Future Assembly 发表搞笑演讲，论证区块链是个非常糟糕的主意。他讨论区块链在信任、法律和现实问题上的缺陷。
why_zh: 在加密货币和 Web3 讨论中，HN 常推荐它作为有趣且有说服力的反区块链论述。
summary: James Mickens of Harvard gives a funny lecture at HBS's Future Assembly arguing that blockchains are a very bad idea. He covers their trust, legal and practical shortcomings for real-world problems.
why_hn: A staple HN recommendation in crypto and Web3 threads as an entertaining, compelling case against blockchain.

title: DebConf 14: QA with Linus Torvalds
title_zh: DebConf 14：与 Linus Torvalds 的问答
summary_zh: DebConf 14 上与 Linus Torvalds 的 72 分钟问答。话题包括 Linux 二进制分发之痛、发行版碎片化、内核向后兼容、GPLv2 与 GPLv3 以及行为准则。
why_zh: HN 常回到它，因为 Linus 亲自解释在 Linux 上发布软件为何困难，以及他为何不喜欢 GPLv3。
summary: A 72-minute Q&A with Linus Torvalds at DebConf 14. Topics include the pain of distributing Linux binaries, distro fragmentation, kernel backwards compatibility, GPLv2 versus GPLv3 and conduct.
why_hn: HN returns to it as Linus's own explanation of why shipping software on Linux is hard and why he dislikes GPLv3.

title: NaN Gates and Flip FLOPS
title_zh: NaN 门与 Flip FLOPS
summary_zh: Tom Murphy（suckerpinch）展示了一种故意恶搞的计算机体系结构，建立在 IEEE-754 浮点之上，用 NaN 和无穷大定义逻辑门。他围绕这个想法搭建了可工作的硬件。
why_zh: HN 粉丝把它列为他视频中的最爱，是极致疯狂技术艺术的例子，并在浮点讨论中引用它。
summary: Tom Murphy (suckerpinch) presents a deliberately trollish computer architecture built on IEEE-754 floating point, using NaN and infinity to define logic gates. He builds working hardware around the idea.
why_hn: HN fans hold it up as a favorite among his videos and an example of gloriously bonkers technical art, and cite it in floating-point discussions.

title: This is Financial Advice
title_zh: 这是财务建议
summary_zh: Dan Olson 的长篇 Folding Ideas 视频，讲 GameStop 迷因股现象、其网络社区以及围绕它的阴谋论思维。时长超过两小时。
why_zh: 被推荐为对迷因股文化的详尽、冷静批判，也是每当 GameStop 新闻出现时的好起点。
summary: Dan Olson's long Folding Ideas video on the GameStop meme stock phenomenon, its online community and the conspiracy thinking around it. It runs over two hours.
why_hn: Recommended as a thorough, sober critique of meme-stock culture and a good starting point whenever GameStop news appears.

title: Why Are You So Angry? Part 1: A Short History of Anita Sarkeesian
title_zh: 你为什么这么愤怒？第一部分：Anita Sarkeesian 简史
summary_zh: Innuendo Studios 六集视频论文系列的第一部分，讲述围绕 Anita Sarkeesian 和 GamerGate 的网络敌意。它梳理了相关历史以及参与者的动机。
why_zh: HN 推荐该系列，认为它细致分析了网络骚扰、防御心理和游戏文化冲突。
summary: The first part of Innuendo Studios' six-part video essay series on the online hostility around Anita Sarkeesian and GamerGate. It lays out the history and the motivations of the people involved.
why_hn: HN recommends the series as a nuanced analysis of online harassment, defensiveness, and gaming culture conflict.

title: DNA animation (2002-2014) by Drew Berry and Etsuko Uno wehi.tv #ScienceArt
title_zh: DNA 动画（2002-2014）——Drew Berry 与 Etsuko Uno，wehi.tv #ScienceArt
summary_zh: WEHI 的 Drew Berry 和 Etsuko Uno 制作的 DNA 复制与基因转录分子动画合集，无旁白。它展示了细胞内分子机器的运作。
why_zh: 每当人们想看到分子生物学机械而拥挤的真实图景时就会被推荐，许多人觉得它令人惊叹。
summary: A compilation of molecular animations of DNA replication and gene transcription by Drew Berry and Etsuko Uno at WEHI, made with no narration. It shows molecular machinery at work inside cells.
why_hn: Recommended whenever people want to see the mechanical, jostling reality of molecular biology, which many find awe-inspiring.

title: "Stop Writing Dead Programs" by Jack Rusher (Strange Loop 2022)
title_zh: “别再写死程序”——Jack Rusher（Strange Loop 2022）
summary_zh: Jack Rusher 在 Strange Loop 2022 的演讲，认为大多数编程语言仍围绕打孔卡时代的假设设计。他主张采用实时、交互式编程环境，借鉴 Lisp、Smalltalk 和 REPL 驱动开发。
why_zh: HN 经常把它作为关于实时编程以及现代工具缺失什么的演讲，不过少数人觉得它太过。
summary: Jack Rusher's Strange Loop 2022 talk argues that most programming languages are still designed around punchcard-era assumptions. He makes the case for live, interactive programming environments, drawing on Lisp, Smalltalk and REPL-driven development.
why_hn: HN returns to it constantly as the talk on live programming and what modern tooling is missing, though a few found it too much.

title: Principles of Technology Leadership | Bryan Cantrill | Monktoberfest 2017
title_zh: 技术领导力的原则 | Bryan Cantrill | Monktoberfest 2017
summary_zh: Bryan Cantrill 在 Monktoberfest 2017 关于领导力和组织原则的演讲，从葛底斯堡演说谈到 Uber 和 Amazon。他论证原则与价值观的区别，并批评含糊的企业原则。
why_zh: HN 将其视为讨论公司价值观时的经典必看演讲，尤其是它对 Amazon 领导力原则的抨击。
summary: Bryan Cantrill's Monktoberfest 2017 talk on leadership and organizational principles, ranging from the Gettysburg Address to Uber and Amazon. He argues for the difference between principles and values and criticizes vague corporate principles.
why_hn: HN treats it as a classic, must-watch talk for any discussion of company values, and especially for its takedown of Amazon's leadership principles.

title: #HITB2012KUL D1T3 - The Grugq - OPSEC: Because Jail is for wuftpd
title_zh: #HITB2012KUL D1T3 - The Grugq - OPSEC：因为监狱是留给 wuftpd 的
summary_zh: The Grugq 在 Hack In The Box 2012 关于黑客行动安全的演讲，借鉴黑客起诉案例和反情报研究。它回顾 OPSEC 的目标和方法，以避免被发现和逮捕，并分析黑客如何落网。
why_zh: HN 将其视为关于 OPSEC 和化名的首选演讲，在关于 Tor、Silk Road 和保持匿名的讨论中被推荐。
channel: Hack In The Box Security Conference
summary: The Grugq's Hack In The Box 2012 talk on operational security for hackers, drawing on hacker indictments and counter-intelligence research. It reviews OPSEC goals and methods for avoiding detection and arrest, with case studies of how hackers got caught.
why_hn: HN treats it as the go-to talk on OPSEC and pseudonymity, recommended in threads about Tor, Silk Road and staying anonymous online.

title: Feynman on Scientific Method.
title_zh: 费曼谈科学方法
summary_zh: 这段短片记录 Richard Feynman 对科学方法的解释：先提出猜测，再推导后果，然后用实验检验。他还说明了为什么占星术这类含糊理论无法被证伪。
why_zh: 它被广泛推荐为关于“什么才算科学”最清晰、也最有趣的简短解释之一。
summary: A short clip of Richard Feynman explaining the scientific method: guess, compute consequences, compare to experiment, and why vague theories like astrology cannot be proven wrong.
why_hn: Widely recommended as one of the clearest, funniest short explanations of what makes something science.

title: Lecture: 2017 Maps of Meaning 01: Context and Background
title_zh: 讲座：2017 年《意义的地图》01：语境与背景
summary_zh: 这是 Jordan Peterson 2017 年《意义的地图》课程的第一讲，交代其信仰与文化理论的冷战背景。讲座引入了文化的叙事结构，以及个体、已知与未知的原型角色。
why_zh: 多位 Hacker News 评论者称这系列讲座曾帮助他们走出抑郁或个人崩溃，并把它推荐为长期学习材料。
summary: The first lecture of Jordan Peterson's 2017 Maps of Meaning course, setting out the Cold War context for his theory of belief and culture. He introduces the narrative structure of culture and archetypal characters for the individual, the known and the unknown.
why_hn: Several HN commenters credit the lecture series with helping them through depression or personal collapse and recommend it as long-form learning.

title: The 7 Habits of Highly Miserable People
title_zh: 高度痛苦人士的 7 个习惯
summary_zh: CGP Grey 的讽刺动画短片改编自《How to Be Miserable》，列出那些稳定让人不快乐的习惯。它通过反着给建议，让人看清该避免什么，并反思自己的目标和日常安排。
why_zh: Hacker News 在抑郁、习惯和目标设定相关讨论中广泛推荐它，认为这种幽默又难忘的反向视角能让人明白该做什么。
summary: CGP Grey's sarcastic animated video adapted from the book How to Be Miserable, listing habits that reliably make people unhappy. By inverting the advice, it shows what to avoid and prompts reflection on goals and routines.
why_hn: HN recommends it widely in advice threads on depression, habits, and goal setting as a funny, memorable way to see what to do by seeing what not to do.

title: I Was SCARED To Say This To NASA... (But I said it anyway) - Smarter Every Day 293
title_zh: 我害怕把这话告诉 NASA……（但我还是说了）——Smarter Every Day 293
summary_zh: Smarter Every Day 的 Destin Sandlin 面向航空航天听众演讲，比较 Apollo 的工程与管理方式同 NASA Artemis 计划的差异。他提出对未解决细节、登月所需发射次数和在轨燃料转移，以及机构知识流失的担忧。
why_zh: 每当 Artemis、SLS 或 Starship 在轨加注成为话题，评论者就会提到它，因为这是直接对着 NASA 讲出的坦率而尖锐的工程评估。
summary: Destin Sandlin of Smarter Every Day gives a talk to an aerospace audience, comparing how Apollo was engineered and managed with NASA's Artemis program. He raises concerns about unresolved details, the number of launches and in-orbit fuel transfer needed to reach the Moon, and the loss of institutional knowledge.
why_hn: Commenters point to it whenever Artemis, SLS or Starship refueling comes up, as a candid and critical engineering assessment delivered directly to NASA.

title: Wealth Inequality in America
title_zh: 美国的财富不平等
summary_zh: 这段信息图短片展示美国财富分布，对比人们以为的分布、他们认为理想的分布和实际数字。它突出美国财富结构何等头重脚轻。
why_zh: 每当财富不平等话题出现，Hacker News 评论者就会贴出它，用直观画面展示感知分布与实际分布之间的差距。
summary: A short infographic video on the distribution of wealth in America, contrasting what people believe, what they consider ideal, and the actual numbers. It highlights how top-heavy US wealth is.
why_hn: HN commenters drop it whenever wealth inequality comes up, as a quick visual of the gap between perceived and actual distribution.

title: Keynote: Paul Graham, YCombinator
title_zh: 主题演讲：Paul Graham，Y Combinator
summary_zh: Paul Graham 在 PyCon 2012 的主题演讲中谈创业想法，以及未来哪类公司可能重要。他讨论了更好的邮件客户端、面向黑客的搜索引擎等想法，并主张站在未来回看现在。
why_zh: Hacker News 评论者常把它视为一场塑造世界观的演讲，其中关于技术和创业想法的预测后来被证明颇具先见之明。
summary: Paul Graham's keynote at PyCon 2012, in which he talks about startup ideas and what kinds of companies are likely to matter in the future. He discusses ideas such as a better email client and a search engine for hackers, and argues for looking back at the present from the future.
why_hn: HN commenters return to it as a worldview-shaping talk whose predictions about technology and startup ideas turned out to be prescient.

title: CppCon 2015: Kate Gregory “Stop Teaching C"
title_zh: CppCon 2015：Kate Gregory《别再教 C 了》
summary_zh: Kate Gregory 在 CppCon 2015 上主张，教 C++ 不应从 C 开始：一开始不要用 char* 字符串、printf 或原始数组，并应先讲引用再讲指针。
why_zh: 在 C 与 C++ 的争论中，Hacker News 用户经常引用它，作为应教现代 C++ 惯用法而非先教 C 的论据。
summary: Kate Gregory argues at CppCon 2015 that C++ should be taught without starting from C: no char* strings, printf or raw arrays at first, with references before pointers.
why_hn: HN people cite it constantly in C versus C++ debates as the case for teaching modern C++ idioms rather than C first.
categories: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

title: Zig: A programming language designed for robustness, optimality, and clarity –  Andrew Kelley
title_zh: Zig：一门为稳健性、最优性和清晰性而设计的编程语言——Andrew Kelley
summary_zh: Zig 创造者 Andrew Kelley 于 2018 年在 Recurse Center 的 Localhost 系列活动中介绍这门语言。他谈到稳健性、最优性和清晰性目标，以及 C 互操作、交叉编译和显式分配器。
why_zh: Hacker News 多次推荐它作为来自作者本人的 Zig 权威入门，并在讨论 Zig 设计选择时附上链接。
summary: Andrew Kelley, creator of Zig, introduces the language at the Recurse Center's Localhost series in 2018. He covers its goals of robustness, optimality and clarity, C interop, cross-compilation and explicit allocators.
why_hn: HN repeatedly recommends it as the definitive introduction to Zig straight from its author, and links to it whenever Zig's design choices come up.
categories: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

title: Michael Moore Presents: Planet of the Humans | A Film by Jeff Gibbs | Full Documentary
title_zh: Michael Moore 呈现：Jeff Gibbs 执导纪录片《Planet of the Humans》（完整版）
summary_zh: 《Planet of the Humans》是由 Jeff Gibbs 执导、Michael Moore 呈现的完整纪录片。影片主张环保运动已被企业和富人利益收编，单靠技术修补远远不够。
why_zh: Hacker News 把它当作对可再生能源和绿色技术的逆向批评，推荐时常附带关于偏见和结论缺陷的提醒。
summary: Planet of the Humans, a full documentary by Jeff Gibbs presented by Michael Moore, arguing that the green movement has been co-opted by corporate and wealthy interests and that techno-fixes are not enough.
why_hn: HN uses it as a contrarian critique of renewables and green tech, often recommended with caveats about bias and flawed conclusions.

title: DOUGLAS ADAMS: Parrots, the Universe and Everything
title_zh: Douglas Adams：鹦鹉、宇宙及一切
summary_zh: Douglas Adams 在 UCSB 的演讲，录制于他去世前不久，谈动物奇特的生存方式以及这些方式对人类未来的启示。内容源自他的《Last Chance to See》工作，风趣而视野广阔。
why_zh: Adams 的粉丝反复称它是他最好的演讲之一，以幽默又动人的方式审视灭绝与环境问题。
topic: douglas adams on nature and extinction
summary: Douglas Adams gives a talk at UCSB, recorded shortly before his death, about the odd lives of animals and what they suggest about humanity's future. It draws on his Last Chance to See work and is funny and wide-ranging.
why_hn: Adams fans repeatedly call it one of his best talks, a funny and moving look at extinction and the environment.

title: "Unison: a new distributed programming language" by Paul Chiusano
title_zh: Paul Chiusano 谈 Unison：一种新的分布式编程语言
summary_zh: Paul Chiusano 在 Strange Loop 2019 的演讲介绍开源函数式语言 Unison，它面向分布式、弹性系统。内容涵盖以语法树哈希标识的内容寻址代码、代码库管理器，以及称为 abilities 的代数效应。
why_zh: HN 认为这是了解 Unison 的最佳入门，评论者称哈希寻址的不可变代码令人大开眼界。
summary: Paul Chiusano's Strange Loop 2019 talk introduces Unison, an open-source functional language for distributed, elastic systems. It covers content-addressed code identified by hashes of the syntax tree, a codebase manager, and algebraic effects called abilities.
why_hn: HN treats it as the best introduction to Unison, with commenters finding hash-addressed immutable code mind-blowing.

title: Hey Underscore, You're Doing It Wrong!
title_zh: Hey Underscore，你做错了！
summary_zh: Brian Lonsdorf 解释 Underscore.js 作为函数式编程库的不足，并介绍 JavaScript 中的柯里化、组合与 point-free 风格，主张把数据参数放在最后。
why_zh: 这是被反复推荐的函数式 JavaScript 入门，清楚讲解柯里化以及为何数据应放在最后。
summary: Brian Lonsdorf explains why Underscore.js falls short as a functional programming library, then introduces currying, composition and point-free style in JavaScript. He argues for data-last argument ordering.
why_hn: A repeatedly recommended introduction to functional JavaScript that explains currying and why data should come last.

title: Why No One Has Measured The Speed Of Light
title_zh: 为什么没人测出光速
summary_zh: Veritasium 解释单向光速从未被测量，只测过往返光速，因为测量它需要同步时钟，而同步本身已预设了答案。视频还讨论这对相对论的影响。
why_zh: 在关于光速、时钟同步和物理中不可检验假设的讨论中，它被当作标准参考。
summary: Veritasium explains why the one-way speed of light has never been measured, only the round-trip speed, since measuring it requires synchronized clocks that assume the answer. It explores the implications for relativity.
why_hn: Used as the standard reference in threads about light speed, clock synchronization and untestable assumptions in physics.

title: Exploring the Tech and Design of Noita
title_zh: 探索 Noita 的技术与设计
summary_zh: 在 2019 年 GDC 演讲中，Nolla Games 的 Petri Purho 讲解 Noita 物理引擎的技术实现，包括把落沙模拟扩展到大型连续世界并加入可破坏刚体。他也展示涌现物理如何驱动玩法。
why_zh: 对任何构建落沙或像素物理模拟的人来说这是首选演讲，有评论者称自己的引擎就是照它做的。
summary: In this 2019 GDC session, Petri Purho of Nolla Games explains the technical side of Noita's physics engine, including scaling a falling-sand simulation to large continuous worlds and adding destructible rigid bodies. It also shows how the emergent physics drives the gameplay.
why_hn: It is the go-to talk for anyone building falling-sand or pixel-physics simulations, and several commenters say they modeled their own engines on it.

title: A Talk Near the Future of Python (a.k.a., Dave live-codes a WebAssembly Interpreter)
title_zh: 接近 Python 的未来（又名：Dave 现场编写 WebAssembly 解释器）
summary_zh: David Beazley 在 PyCon India 闭幕主题演讲中现场编写栈机，并逐步扩展成能运行 WebAssembly 的解释器，还用其运行一个 Rust 写的游戏。无需 WebAssembly 基础。
why_zh: 它被视为精彩的现场编程演讲，既教 WASM 又教解释器编写，有人称是其看过最好的会议演讲之一。
summary: David Beazley's PyCon India closing keynote, in which he live-codes a stack machine and grows it into an interpreter that runs WebAssembly, then uses it to play a Rust-written game. It requires no prior WebAssembly knowledge.
why_hn: Regarded as a brilliant live-coding talk that teaches WASM and interpreter writing, with several calling it among the best conference talks they have seen.

title: Rails Conf 2012 Keynote: Simplicity Matters by Rich Hickey
title_zh: Rails Conf 2012 主题演讲：简单至关重要
summary_zh: Rich Hickey 在 RailsConf 2012 的主题演讲与其“Simple Made Easy”相近。他区分 simple（不交织）与 easy（熟悉），主张软件复杂性来自把事物缠结在一起，并用大型 gem 集合等 Rails 相关例子说明。
why_zh: HN 推荐它作为《Simple Made Easy》的替代或补充，并在框架、JSON 和数据设计讨论中引用其关于简单、复杂与“毛球”的观点。
summary: Rich Hickey's keynote at RailsConf 2012, a close sibling of his 'Simple Made Easy' talk. He distinguishes simple (not intertwined) from easy (familiar), and argues that software complexity comes from complecting things, with Rails-specific examples including large gem collections.
why_hn: HN recommends it as an alternative or companion to 'Simple Made Easy', and quotes its ideas about simplicity, complexity and 'hairballs' in discussions of frameworks, JSON and data design.

title: Roblox Pressured Us to Delete Our Video. So We Dug Deeper.
title_zh: Roblox 施压让我们删除视频，于是我们深挖下去
summary_zh: People Make Games 在首支视频后，根据玩家和创作者的故事对 Roblox 展开后续调查，涉及平台如何对待年轻开发者及其内容审核。
why_zh: 在 Roblox 相关讨论中常被引用为对童工、剥削和审核薄弱的严厉调查，也被建议给家长观看。
summary: A People Make Games follow-up investigation into Roblox, built on stories from players and creators after the channel's first video. It covers the platform's treatment of young developers and its moderation.
why_hn: Cited heavily in Roblox threads as a damning investigation into child labor, exploitation, and weak moderation, and suggested viewing for parents.

title: Mastering the Vim Language
title_zh: 掌握 Vim 语言
summary_zh: thoughtbot 的 Chris Toomey 把 Vim 解释为由命令、动作和文本对象组成的语言，可组合成精确编辑。他展示如何掌握内置部件并扩展它们。
why_zh: 它被反复称为 Vim 底层模型的最佳视频入门。
summary: Chris Toomey of thoughtbot explains Vim as a language of commands, motions and text objects that combine into precise edits. He shows how to master the built-in pieces and extend them.
why_hn: Repeatedly called the best video introduction to Vim's underlying model.

title: Casey Muratori – The Big OOPs: Anatomy of a Thirty-five-year Mistake – BSC 2025
title_zh: Casey Muratori – The Big OOPs：一个持续三十五年的错误剖析 – BSC 2025
summary_zh: Casey Muratori 的两小时演讲把面向对象编程的历史追溯到 1960 年代，考察其思想以及后来的实体组件系统如何产生，之后有问答。
why_zh: HN 评论者推荐它，因其基于原始资料梳理 OOP 历史，不过有人质疑其中对 Alan Kay 的叙述。
summary: Casey Muratori's two-hour talk tracing the history of object-oriented programming back to the 1960s and examining how its ideas, and later entity component systems, came about. It is followed by a Q&A.
why_hn: HN commenters recommend it for its source-based history of OOP, though some dispute its account of Alan Kay.

title: What Really Happened During the Texas Power Grid Outage?
title_zh: 得州电网停电期间到底发生了什么？
summary_zh: Practical Engineering 解释 2021 年 2 月得州冬季风暴及其导致的电网停电，陈述 ERCOT、电网孤岛以及各类燃料发电在严寒中失效的事实。
why_zh: 每当得州电网故障被提起，HN 用户就把它作为冷静、技术可靠的说明来链接，以穿透政治指责。
summary: Practical Engineering's explanation of the February 2021 Texas winter storm and the resulting power grid outage. It lays out the facts about ERCOT, the grid's isolation, and how generation across fuel types failed in the cold.
why_hn: Whenever Texas grid failures come up, HN people link it as the calm, technically informed account that cuts through political blame.

title: The Art of Code - Dylan Beattie
title_zh: The Art of Code —— Dylan Beattie
summary_zh: Dylan Beattie 在 NDC London 的演讲，探讨那些出于艺术、趣味和好奇心而非实用目的写下的代码，涵盖 quine、用 Sonic Pi 做现场音乐编程，以及一个令人难忘的结尾。
why_zh: Hacker News 常把它列为史上最佳编程演讲之一，称赞其叙事、演示与结尾。
summary: Dylan Beattie's NDC London talk on code written for art, fun and curiosity rather than utility. It includes quines, live music programming with Sonic Pi, and a memorable closing.
why_hn: HN regularly names it among the best programming talks ever, praising the storytelling, the demos and the ending.

title: Clean Code - Uncle Bob / Lesson 1
title_zh: Clean Code —— Uncle Bob 第一课
summary_zh: Uncle Bob（Robert C. Martin）“Coding Better World Together”系列的第一课，论证为何要写整洁代码，并把软件工艺视为一种伦理与职业责任，时长约 109 分钟。
why_zh: Hacker News 评论者称它胜过《Clean Code》一书，是能改变工程师读写代码方式的必看内容。
summary: The first lesson of Uncle Bob (Robert C. Martin)'s "Coding Better World Together" series. It makes the case for clean code and for treating software craftsmanship as an ethical and professional responsibility. It runs about 109 minutes.
why_hn: HN commenters call it better than the Clean Code book, a must-watch for engineers that changes how they read and write code.

title: 'A Universe From Nothing' by Lawrence Krauss, AAI 2009
title_zh: Lawrence Krauss：'A Universe From Nothing'（AAI 2009）
summary_zh: Lawrence Krauss 2009 年的演讲，讲述当前对宇宙的图景、它将如何终结，以及它如何可能从“无”中诞生，涉及宇宙膨胀、宇宙背景辐射和宇宙学常数。
why_zh: Hacker News 认为这是一场著名而引人入胜的演讲，尤其是关于遥远星系终将变得不可观测的那一点。
channel: Richard Dawkins Foundation for Reason & Science
summary: Lawrence Krauss's 2009 talk on the current picture of the universe, how it will end and how it could have come from nothing. It covers the expanding universe, cosmic background radiation and the cosmological constant.
why_hn: HN regards it as a famous, mesmerizing talk, especially for the point that distant galaxies will become unobservable.

title: Why It Was Almost Impossible to Make the Blue LED
title_zh: 蓝色 LED 为何几乎不可能被造出来
summary_zh: Veritasium 讲述中村修二等人如何造出长期被视为几乎不可能的蓝色 LED，涵盖氮化镓带来的材料难题以及所需的坚持。
why_zh: Hacker News 推荐它，既因为它是一个对抗主流、执着坚持的精彩故事，也因为它讲述了现代 LED 照明背后的来龙去脉。
summary: Veritasium tells the story of how Shuji Nakamura and others made the blue LED, long thought nearly impossible. It covers the materials challenge of gallium nitride and the persistence it took.
why_hn: HN recommends it as a gripping story of single-minded persistence against the herd, and as the back story behind modern LED lighting.

title: Richard Feynman Computer Science Lecture - Hardware, Software and Heuristics
title_zh: Richard Feynman 计算机科学讲座：硬件、软件与启发式方法
summary_zh: Richard Feynman 的一场讲座，用一个越来越笨却越来越快的档案管理员作比喻讲解计算机如何工作，还谈及启发式方法以及计算机如何在有限时间内处理数据、解决问题。
why_zh: 它常被推荐为对“计算机本质是什么”最清晰的通俗解释，至少有一位评论者说它改变了自己对编程的思考方式。
summary: A lecture by Richard Feynman on how computers work, using the analogy of a filing clerk that becomes progressively dumber and faster. It also covers heuristics and how computers handle data and solve problems in finite time.
why_hn: Frequently recommended as the clearest plain-language explanation of what a computer fundamentally is, with at least one commenter saying it changed how they think about programming.

title: Joe Ades , Greatest Salesman in New York City History !!! #KONYH !!
title_zh: Joe Ades：纽约史上最伟大的推销员
summary_zh: 一段街头短片，记录了在纽约人行道上向人群推销削皮器的推销员 Joe Ades，展现了他的话术、表演技巧和掌控人群的能力。
why_zh: Hacker News 视他为销售与现场展示的大师课：怎么卖比卖什么更重要。
summary: A short street-level clip of Joe Ades, the New York pitchman who sold vegetable peelers to crowds on the sidewalk. It shows his patter, showmanship and crowd handling in action.
why_hn: HN treats him as a master class in salesmanship and live presentation, where how you sell matters more than what you sell.

title: The determinant | Chapter 6, Essence of linear algebra
title_zh: 行列式 | 第 6 章：线性代数的本质
summary_zh: 3Blue1Brown 一段 10 分钟的视频，把行列式解释为线性变换对面积或体积的缩放系数，先用动画建立几何直觉，再引入公式。
why_zh: Hacker News 反复推荐它作为行列式最清晰的直观解释，常有人说这个概念终于讲通了。
summary: A 10-minute 3Blue1Brown chapter explaining the determinant as the factor by which a linear transformation scales area or volume. It builds the idea geometrically with animations before any formulas.
why_hn: HN repeatedly points people to it as the clearest visual intuition for determinants, often saying it finally made the concept click.

title: I Genetically Engineered *MYSELF* to Fix Lactose Intolerance
title_zh: 我给自己做了基因工程，治好了乳糖不耐受
summary_zh: The Thought Emporium 的主持人讲述如何自制并服用一种 DIY 基因疗法来治疗自己的乳糖不耐受：用 AAV 病毒递送编码乳糖消化酶的 DNA，并在生物黑客 Gabriel Licina 的帮助下完成。
why_zh: 在基因治疗、CRISPR 和生物黑客相关讨论中，Hacker News 总把它当作平民化 DIY 基因工程与自我实验的典型例子。
summary: The Thought Emporium's host describes making and taking a DIY gene therapy to treat his own lactose intolerance. It uses an AAV virus to deliver DNA coding for the lactose-digesting enzyme, made with biohacker Gabriel Licina's help.
why_hn: HN keeps citing it as the standard example of accessible DIY gene engineering and self-experimentation, in threads on gene therapy, CRISPR and biohacking.

title: Minding your mitochondria | Dr. Terry Wahls | TEDxIowaCity
title_zh: 关注你的线粒体 | Terry Wahls 医生 | TEDxIowaCity
summary_zh: Terry Wahls 医生讲述她如何借助饮食管理多发性硬化症并摆脱轮椅，理论基础是线粒体生物学；TED 已标注该演讲属于基于个人经历的健康建议。
why_zh: Hacker News 评论者称它是一个打动人心、促使人改变饮食的个人故事，但也有人指出它只是轶事性证据。
summary: Dr. Terry Wahls tells how she used diet to manage her multiple sclerosis and get out of a wheelchair, drawing on mitochondrial biology. TED flagged the talk as health advice based on personal narrative.
why_hn: HN commenters point to it as a moving personal story that motivated dietary changes, though it is also cited as anecdotal evidence.

title: Breaking the x86 Instruction Set
title_zh: 攻破 x86 指令集
summary_zh: Christopher Domas 在 Black Hat 2017 上展示如何通过页面错误分析和处理器模糊测试穷举搜索 x86 指令集，发现未公开指令和硬件缺陷，并揭示反汇编器的局限。
why_zh: Hacker News 推荐它，称其巧妙有趣、通俗易懂，讲述了如何用 Sandsifter 工具发现隐藏的 x86 指令。
summary: Christopher Domas presents at Black Hat 2017 how page fault analysis and processor fuzzing can exhaustively search the x86 instruction set. The talk uncovers undocumented instructions and hardware bugs and shows limits of disassemblers.
why_hn: HN recommends it as a clever, entertaining and easy-to-follow talk on finding hidden x86 instructions with the Sandsifter tool.

title: Functional Composition - Chris Ford
title_zh: 函数式组合 —— Chris Ford
summary_zh: Chris Ford 用 Clojure 和 Overtone 音频环境，从一条正弦波逐层抽象，最终构建出一段巴赫卡农，展示音乐理论与函数式编程的天然契合。
why_zh: Hacker News 反复推荐它，称这是一场令人愉悦的演讲，既能讲通乐理，又介绍了 Clojure 和 Overtone。
summary: Chris Ford builds up from a single sine wave through layered abstractions to a Bach canon, using Clojure and the Overtone audio environment. The talk shows music theory as a natural fit for functional programming.
why_hn: HN repeatedly recommends it as a delightful talk that makes music theory click and introduces Clojure and Overtone.

title: Alan Kay, 2015: Power of Simplicity
title_zh: Alan Kay，2015：简单的力量
summary_zh: Alan Kay 2015 年的演讲谈简单的力量，主张系统之所以能变简单，是因为建立在更精妙的基础构件之上，而宏大的研究视野推动了 Xerox PARC 的诸多发明；内容横跨计算、工具与软件规模化。
why_zh: Hacker News 反复引用它，认为它在降低软件复杂度和思考计算研究现状方面发人深省。
summary: Alan Kay's 2015 talk on the power of simplicity, arguing that systems become simpler by building on more sophisticated fundamental building blocks and that big research horizons drove invention at Xerox PARC. It ranges across computing, tools and scaling software.
why_hn: HN repeatedly cites it as a thought-provoking talk on reducing software complexity and on the state of computing research.

title: What your Differential Pairs Wish You Knew with Rick Hartley - AltiumLive Keynote
title_zh: Rick Hartley 在 AltiumLive 主题演讲：差分对真正希望你了解的事
summary_zh: Rick Hartley 在 AltiumLive 的主题演讲中讲解 PCB 上的差分对设计：线缆和双绞线的规则并不适用于电路板，他说明了哪种走线几何形状最利于阻抗控制、间距该如何取、布线实践以及可接受的偏斜量。
why_zh: HN 工程师把它视为对抗“照搬教条式”PCB 建议的直觉型实战参考，尤其在差分对布线、参考平面和 EMI 话题上屡被引用。
summary: Rick Hartley's AltiumLive keynote on differential pairs in PC boards. He argues the rules from cables and twisted pairs do not carry over, and covers which pair geometry gives the best impedance control, the right spacing, routing practice and how much skew is acceptable.
why_hn: HN engineers cite Hartley as the intuitive, field-based alternative to cargo-cult PCB advice, especially on differential pair routing, reference planes and EMI.

title: mRNA Translation (Advanced)
title_zh: mRNA 翻译（进阶版）
summary_zh: DNA Learning Center 的短片动画演示 mRNA 如何把基因的信息带到核糖体，再由 tRNA 与密码子配对，把氨基酸组装成蛋白质。
why_zh: Frequently linked as a mind-blowing visualization of how RNA is translated into protein, especially in threads on mRNA vaccines and cell biology.
summary: A short animation from the DNA Learning Center showing how mRNA carries a gene's message to the ribosome, where tRNA and codons are used to assemble amino acids into a protein.

title: Guarding Against Physical Attacks: The Xbox One Story — Tony Chen, Microsoft
title_zh: 抵御物理攻击：Xbox One 的故事——微软 Tony Chen
summary_zh: 微软的 Tony Chen 讲述 Xbox One 如何设计成能抵抗物理攻击，包括安全启动、内存加密、安全处理器和 hypervisor，目标是让任何硬件破解的成本都高于买许多张游戏。
why_zh: HN points to it constantly in console, DRM and hardware-security threads as the authoritative account of Xbox One's threat model.
summary: Microsoft's Tony Chen explains how the Xbox One was designed to resist physical attacks, including secure boot, encrypted memory, a security processor and a hypervisor. The goal was to make any hardware attack cost more than the price of many games.

title: Google Self-Driving Car Project | SXSW Interactive 2016
title_zh: Google 自动驾驶汽车项目 | SXSW Interactive 2016
summary_zh: Chris Urmson 在 SXSW 2016 讲述 Google 自动驾驶项目：已自动驾驶 130 万英里，也谈到宣传与现实之间的落差，并展示了传感器可视化和车辆遭遇困难场景的回放，还讨论了低速撞上公交车等失败案例。
why_zh: HN returns to it repeatedly as one of the best candid talks on how a real self-driving system sees the road and where it struggles.
summary: Chris Urmson's SXSW 2016 talk on Google's self-driving car project, covering 1.3 million self-driven miles and the gap between hype and reality. It shows sensor visualizations and playbacks of hard situations the cars met, and discusses failures such as the low-speed bus collision.

title: Domain Modeling Made Functional - Scott Wlaschin
title_zh: 用函数式方法做领域建模——Scott Wlaschin
summary_zh: Scott Wlaschin 在 NDC 的演讲中介绍如何用静态类型的函数式编程（尤其是 F#）为业务领域建模：用类型精确表达领域，并把业务规则编码进类型，使非法状态根本无法构造，编译器就像即时的单元测试。
why_zh: HN people recommend it as an eye-opening talk whose domain-modeling ideas carry over to other languages and make a strong compiler feel like a coding partner.
summary: Scott Wlaschin's NDC talk on using statically typed functional programming, F# in particular, to model a business domain. Types are used to represent the domain precisely and to encode business rules so that illegal states cannot be built, with the compiler acting as an instant unit test.

title: 'Diablo':  A Classic Game Postmortem
title_zh: 《暗黑破坏神》：经典游戏幕后回顾
summary_zh: David Brevik 在 GDC 2016 回顾《暗黑破坏神》如何从 DOS 上的回合制黏土动画构想演变为实时动作 RPG，并讲述 Blizzard North 的经历和开发轶事。
why_zh: Frequently recommended whenever Diablo or its origins come up, for its candid account of the human side of game development.
summary: David Brevik's GDC 2016 postmortem of Diablo covers how it went from a turn-based claymation DOS concept to a real-time action RPG, plus the story of Blizzard North and development anecdotes.

title: Animations of unseeable biology | Drew Berry | TED
title_zh: 肉眼不可见的生物学动画 | Drew Berry | TED
summary_zh: Drew Berry 在 TEDxSydney 上展示了细胞内部 DNA 复制等分子过程的科学精确动画。
why_zh: HN recommends it for mind-blowing visuals that make cell biology tangible.
summary: Drew Berry shows scientifically accurate animations of molecular processes inside cells, such as DNA replication, at TEDxSydney.

title: Ira Glass on Storytelling 3
title_zh: Ira Glass 谈叙事（第三集）
summary_zh: 这段五分钟短片里，Ira Glass 谈到“好品味”与早期创作水平之间的落差：初学者清楚自己的作品还不够好，唯有持续产出才能弥合差距。
why_zh: HN commenters return to it as motivation for creators who feel their work is not good enough yet.
summary: A five-minute clip of Ira Glass on the gap between good taste and early creative work. He says beginners know their work falls short and must keep producing to close the gap.

title: Michael Levin: The electrical blueprints that orchestrate life | TED
title_zh: Michael Levin：编排生命的电学蓝图 | TED
summary_zh: 生物学家 Michael Levin 讲解协调细胞构建器官与身体的生物电层面，展示双头蠕虫的影像并介绍 xenobots，还讨论了这对医学和生命本质的意义。
why_zh: HN commenters use it as the accessible 20-minute entry point to Levin's bioelectricity research whenever regeneration or cell signaling comes up.
summary: Biologist Michael Levin explains the bioelectric layer that coordinates cells to build organs and bodies, showing footage of two-headed worms and introducing xenobots. He discusses implications for medicine and the nature of life.

title: Line Goes Up – The Problem With NFTs
title_zh: Line Goes Up——NFT 的问题
summary_zh: Dan Olson 的近两小时视频长评批判 NFT、加密货币与 Web3 在技术、经济和意识形态上的缺陷，引用详实，最后建议人们追问：这个项目真的必须用加密货币才能成立吗？
why_zh: It is the go-to long-form critique of crypto that HN commenters recommend whenever skeptics ask for a thorough, well-researched takedown.
summary: Dan Olson's roughly two-hour video essay critiques NFTs, cryptocurrency, and Web3, covering their technical, economic, and ideological flaws. It is heavily sourced and ends with the advice to ask whether a project needs crypto to work.

title: Intro to Synthesis Part 1 - The Building Blocks of Sound & Synthesis
title_zh: 合成入门第一讲——声音与合成的基本构件
summary_zh: Dean Friedman 近一小时的合成器入门课，讲解声音的基本构件与合成器上的各种控制，他缓慢转动旋钮，让观众听出每个参数的作用。
why_zh: Repeatedly called the best beginner course on audio synthesis, since the concepts have not changed since it was made.
summary: Dean Friedman's near-hour-long introduction to synthesis, covering the building blocks of sound and the controls on a synthesizer. He slowly adjusts knobs so viewers hear what each parameter does.

title: The Best Country in the World for Drivers
title_zh: 全世界最适合开车的国家
summary_zh: Not Just Bikes 认为，以自行车闻名的荷兰其实也是最适合开车的地方：优先发展步行、骑行和公共交通，反而让开车变得更快、更舒适。
why_zh: 它提出「改善开车之外的替代方案也能让司机受益」这一反直觉论点，并可作为了解荷兰城市规划的入门。
summary: Not Just Bikes argues that the Netherlands, famed for cycling, is also the best country for drivers. It explains how prioritizing walking, cycling and transit makes driving faster and more pleasant.
why_hn: Recommended as the argument that better alternatives to driving also improve things for drivers, and as an introduction to Dutch urban planning.

title: CppCon 2014: Chandler Carruth "Efficiency with Algorithms, Performance with Data Structures"
title_zh: CppCon 2014：Chandler Carruth《靠算法提效率，靠数据结构提性能》
summary_zh: Chandler Carruth 讲解如何写出高性能 C++：数据结构的选择和内存布局比精巧的算法更关键，并解释为何 unordered_map 这类标准容器在现代 CPU 上表现不佳。
why_zh: 每当讨论哈希表、缓存行为或 STL 容器时，它都会被反复推荐为性能优化必看。
summary: Chandler Carruth's CppCon 2014 talk on writing fast C++, explaining why data structure choice and memory layout matter more than clever algorithms. It covers why standard containers like unordered_map perform poorly on modern CPUs.
why_hn: A perennial recommendation for anyone learning performance optimization, cited whenever hash tables, cache behavior or STL containers come up.
categories: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

title: It’s Time To Break Up With Our Gas Stoves | Climate Town
title_zh: 是时候和燃气灶分手了 | Climate Town
summary_zh: Climate Town 主张告别燃气灶，梳理了燃气行业数十年的营销与游说、「燃气做饭更好」这一观念如何被塑造、燃气烹饪的健康影响与甲烷泄漏，以及改用电磁炉的理由。
why_zh: 在燃气灶与电磁炉的讨论帖中，HN 用户推荐它来揭示「燃气更适合烹饪」其实是营销话术。
summary: Climate Town argues for moving away from gas stoves. It covers the gas industry's decades of marketing and lobbying, health effects of gas cooking, methane leaks, and the case for induction.
why_hn: HN commenters recommend it in gas stove and induction threads for exposing how the idea that gas is better for cooking was a marketing ploy.

title: [EPILEPSY WARNING] How fast should an unoptimized terminal run?
title_zh: [癫痫警告] 未经优化的终端应该跑多快？
summary_zh: Casey Muratori 手写了一个支持 Unicode 和彩色文本的简易参考渲染器，速度远超 Windows Terminal，并逐一驳斥了终端慢的各种常见借口。
why_zh: 它是「现代软件浪费硬件」这一论断的经典论据，也是 Windows Terminal 性能之争背后的概念验证。
summary: Casey Muratori shows how fast a terminal renderer can run, building a simple reference renderer that handles Unicode and colored text far quicker than Windows Terminal. He argues that common excuses for slow terminals do not hold up.
why_hn: It is the canonical reference for the claim that modern software wastes hardware, and the proof-of-concept behind the Windows Terminal performance debate.

title: Richard Feynman  - The.Character of Physical Law - Part 1 The Law of Gravitation (full version)
title_zh: Richard Feynman《物理定律的特性》第一部分：万有引力定律（完整版）
summary_zh: 费曼 1964 年在康奈尔 Messenger 讲座的第一讲，从行星运动一路讲到物理定律的本质。
why_zh: HN 读者推荐它作为清晰讲解物理的典范：不居高临下，没有专业背景也能听懂。
summary: The first of Richard Feynman's 1964 Cornell Messenger Lectures, The Character of Physical Law, focusing on the law of gravitation. Feynman builds up from planetary motion to the nature of physical laws.
why_hn: HN people recommend it as a masterclass in explaining physics clearly without condescension, accessible without formal training.

title: Why Grocery Shopping is Better in Amsterdam
title_zh: 为什么在阿姆斯特丹买菜更好
summary_zh: Not Just Bikes 用四分钟对比阿姆斯特丹与以车为本的北美，认为高频少量购买新鲜食材胜过囤货式采购，并把这种习惯与土地利用和减少食物浪费联系起来。
why_zh: 它在城市主义与汽车依赖的讨论中被引用，作为步行可达生鲜购物的简明论据。
summary: A four-minute Not Just Bikes comparison of grocery shopping in Amsterdam versus car-centric North America, arguing that frequent small fresh-food trips beat bulk shopping. It ties this to land use and reduced food waste.
why_hn: Linked in urbanism and car-dependence threads as a concise case for walkable fresh-food shopping.

title: What can Seattle learn from Dutch street design?
title_zh: 西雅图能从荷兰街道设计中学到什么？
summary_zh: 西雅图景观建筑师 Fred Young 用一小时带观众实地浏览荷兰自行车基础设施，讲解设计细节、连续网络以及骑行如何融入荷兰人的日常生活。
why_zh: HN 推荐它作为城市规划领域的深度技术分享，充满让骑行更安全的小设计细节。
summary: Seattle landscape architect Fred Young gives an hour-long visual tour of Dutch cycling infrastructure, covering design details, continuous networks and how cycling fits daily life in the Netherlands.
why_hn: HN recommends it as an in-depth tech talk for urban planning, full of small design touches that make cycling safer.

title: NVC Marshall Rosenberg - San Francisco Workshop - FULL ENGLISH SUBTITLES TRANSCRIPTION
title_zh: NVC：Marshall Rosenberg 旧金山工作坊（完整英文字幕）
summary_zh: Marshall Rosenberg 约三小时的非暴力沟通工作坊，由粉丝补上完整英文字幕，用「豺狼语言」与「长颈鹿语言」的比喻讲解 NVC 模型。
why_zh: HN 用户把它作为 NVC 的原始资料推荐给他人，适用于亲密关系与艰难对话。
summary: A roughly three-hour San Francisco workshop by Marshall Rosenberg on Nonviolent Communication, with full English subtitles added by a fan. He teaches the model with his jackal and giraffe language examples.
why_hn: HN commenters send people to it as the primary source for NVC, recommended for relationships, compassion and difficult conversations.

title: The world's worst video card?
title_zh: 世界上最糟糕的显卡？
summary_zh: Ben Eater 讲解 VGA 信号原理，用面包板搭出同步时序正确的电路让显示器识别信号，并逐步用简单逻辑芯片实现图像显示。
why_zh: HN 推荐它作为从零理解视频硬件如何工作的清晰教程，只需基础逻辑知识即可看懂。
summary: Ben Eater explains how VGA signals work and builds a breadboard circuit that produces correct sync timing so a monitor recognizes the signal. He then builds toward displaying an image from simple logic chips.
why_hn: HN recommends it as a clear, from-scratch look at how video hardware works, understandable with just basic logic knowledge.

title: 01 - Course Introduction & Relational Model (CMU Databases Systems / Fall 2019)
title_zh: 01 - 课程介绍与关系模型（CMU 数据库系统 / 2019 秋）
summary_zh: Andy Pavlo 的 CMU 15-445《数据库系统导论》（2019 秋）第一讲，介绍课程安排并讲解关系模型。
why_zh: 它常被推荐为最好的免费大学数据库内部原理课程，以内容深度和 Pavlo 的讲授著称。
summary: The first lecture of Andy Pavlo's CMU 15-445 Intro to Database Systems (Fall 2019), covering course introduction and the relational model.
why_hn: Frequently recommended as the best free university course on database internals, praised for depth and Pavlo's presentation.

title: The Psychology of Human Misjudgement - Charlie Munger Full Speech
title_zh: 人类误判心理学——Charlie Munger 完整演讲
summary_zh: Charlie Munger 1995 年在哈佛大学关于人类误判心理学的演讲音频，系统梳理了认知偏误与心智模型框架，涵盖激励机制、社会认同和否认等心理因素。
why_zh: HN 认为这是每隔几年就该重看的经典，有助于改善决策和自我认知。
summary: Audio of Charlie Munger's 1995 Harvard speech on the psychology of human misjudgment, laying out a framework of cognitive biases and mental models for decision making. It covers factors like incentives, social proof and denial.
why_hn: HN regards it as a classic to revisit every few years for improving decisions and self-awareness.

title: Starbase Tour with Elon Musk [PART 1 // Summer 2021]
title_zh: 与 Elon Musk 一起参观 Starbase（上集｜2021 年夏）
summary_zh: Everyday Astronaut 的 Tim Dodd 在 Elon Musk 带领下参观 SpaceX 的 Starbase，聊到 High Bay、栅格舵、Raptor V2、HLS 着陆器和级间分离，Musk 还解释了自己的工程管理方法。
why_zh: HN 引用它作为 Musk 深入一线工程能力的例证，也常提他“质疑需求、不要优化本不该存在的东西”的建议。
summary: Tim Dodd of Everyday Astronaut tours SpaceX's Starbase with Elon Musk as guide. They cover the high bay, grid fins, Raptor V2, the HLS lander and stage separation, and Musk explains his engineering management process.
why_hn: HN cites it as evidence of Musk's hands-on engineering depth and for his advice to question requirements and not optimize things that should not exist.

title: FIXING the ENTIRE SM64 Source Code (INSANE N64 performance)
title_zh: 修复整个《Super Mario 64》源码（N64 性能大提升）
summary_zh: Kaze Emanuar 讲解他如何重写并优化《Super Mario 64》源码，让游戏在真实 N64 硬件上运行得快得多，并详细分析性能瓶颈与修复方法。
why_zh: HN 喜欢这种深入实机的 N64 硬件怪癖剖析，比如总线争用，以及低成本优化带来的意外巨大收益。
summary: Kaze Emanuar explains how he rewrote and optimized the Super Mario 64 source code so it runs far faster on real N64 hardware. He covers performance bottlenecks and fixes in detail for his ROM hacks.
why_hn: HN loves the deep, hands-on look at N64 hardware quirks such as bus contention and the surprisingly large wins from low-hanging optimizations.

title: Guided Wim Hof Method Breathing
title_zh: Wim Hof 方法引导呼吸练习
summary_zh: 一段 11 分钟的 Wim Hof 呼吸法引导练习，用膨胀收缩的圆泡控制节奏，Wim 在环境音中带着观众一起呼吸。
why_zh: HN 评论者分享它作为缓解焦虑、压力和恢复的易跟练练习，许多人表示每天使用。
summary: An 11-minute guided Wim Hof breathing session built around an expanding and contracting bubble to pace the breath. Wim breathes along with the viewer over ambient sound.
why_hn: HN commenters share it as an easy-to-follow guided exercise for anxiety, stress, and recovery, with many reporting daily use.

title: Miguel de Icaza: Swift Godot: Fixing the Multi-million dollar mistake  #GodotCon2023
title_zh: Miguel de Icaza：Swift Godot——修复一个数百万美元的错误 #GodotCon2023
summary_zh: Miguel de Icaza 在 GodotCon 2023 介绍 Godot 的 Swift 绑定，认为 C# 的垃圾回收停顿是长期问题，而 Swift 的引用计数可以避开它。
why_zh: 常被推荐的原因是一位资深游戏引擎构建者解释为什么 GC 停顿难以避免，以及 Swift 方案为何有吸引力。
summary: Miguel de Icaza's GodotCon 2023 talk on Swift bindings for Godot. He argues that garbage-collector pauses in C# are a persistent problem and that Swift's reference counting avoids them.
why_hn: Frequently recommended for an experienced game-engine builder's view on why GC pauses are inevitable and why Swift's approach is appealing.

title: QuakeCon 2012 - John Carmack Keynote
title_zh: QuakeCon 2012——John Carmack 主题演讲
summary_zh: John Carmack 在 QuakeCon 2012 的长篇主题演讲，广泛谈及软件工程、游戏平台、游戏串流，以及他早期的头戴显示器和 VR 工作。
why_zh: HN 将他的 QuakeCon 演讲列为最佳技术演讲之一，并特别提到其中的 VR 部分和对 Linux 游戏的看法。
summary: John Carmack's long QuakeCon 2012 keynote, a free-ranging talk covering software engineering, game platforms, game streaming, and his early head-mounted display and VR work.
why_hn: HN rates his QuakeCon keynotes among the best technical talks, and cites this one for the VR segment and for his views on Linux gaming.

title: MountainWest RubyConf 2013 Devs and Depression by Greg  Baugues
title_zh: MountainWest RubyConf 2013——Greg Baugues：开发者与抑郁
summary_zh: Greg Baugues 在 Ruby 大会上讲述自己作为开发者与双相 II 型和 ADHD 共处的经历，呼吁坦诚面对精神疾病，并说明如何求助和支持同事。
why_zh: 在心理健康相关讨论中反复被推荐，因为它真诚的讲述能引起开发者共鸣。
summary: Greg Baugues tells his story of living with bipolar II and ADHD as a developer at a Ruby conference. He urges openness about mental illness and explains how to get help and support colleagues.
why_hn: Repeatedly recommended in mental health threads for its honest storytelling that resonates with developers.

title: The Truth about American Cities - Part 1 - Strong Towns [ST01]
title_zh: 美国城市的真相（上）——Strong Towns [ST01]
summary_zh: Not Just Bikes 的 Strong Towns 系列第一集，基于 Strong Towns 的研究解释北美城市的财政不稳定，认为低密度郊区扩张的维护成本高于其带来的收入。
why_zh: HN 读者推荐它作为理解蔓延和汽车依赖为何在财政上不可持续的最佳入门，常建议看整个系列。
summary: The first video in Not Just Bikes' Strong Towns series explains the financial instability of North American cities, based on Strong Towns research. It argues that low-density suburban growth costs more to maintain than it brings in.
why_hn: HN people recommend it as the best introduction to why sprawl and car dependence are fiscally unsustainable, often pointing to the whole series.

title: I promise this story about microwaves is interesting.
title_zh: 我保证这个关于微波炉的故事很有意思
summary_zh: Tom Scott 追查“微波炉是为加热仓鼠而发明”的说法，采访 James Lovelock 讲述 1950 年代冷冻并用微波解冻仓鼠的实验，并梳理磁控管在雷达之外的早期用途。
why_zh: HN 推荐它把一个古怪事实讲得引人入胜，还难得地采访到了 101 岁的 Lovelock。
summary: Tom Scott investigates the claim that the microwave was invented to heat hamsters, and interviews James Lovelock about freezing and microwave-thawing hamsters in the 1950s. It traces early magnetron uses beyond radar.
why_hn: HN recommends it as a well-told chase of a weird fact that lands a rare interview with Lovelock at age 101.

title: Unix and Google
title_zh: Unix 与 Google
summary_zh: 一段简短的动画模拟，对比 Multics 与 Unix 的开发方式，展示 Unix 的小型可组合程序和管道为何带来效率优势。它把 Unix 呈现为小团队也能实现的“登月”式成就。
why_zh: 在关于微服务、可组合性和 Unix 哲学的讨论中常被引用，用简洁方式解释为什么小型互操作组件能胜出。
summary: A short animated simulation comparing how Multics and Unix were developed, showing why Unix's small composable programs and pipes gave it a efficiency advantage. It frames Unix as a moonshot achievable by a small team.
why_hn: Cited constantly in threads on microservices, composability and the Unix philosophy as a compact explanation of why small interoperable pieces win.

title: Ep. 1 - Awakening from the Meaning Crisis - Introduction
title_zh: 《Awakening from the Meaning Crisis》第 1 集：导论
summary_zh: John Vervaeke 关于现代意义危机的系列讲座首集，从哲学、认知科学、宗教和心理学梳理其历史。它介绍整个系列及其主题。
why_zh: HN 推荐该系列对意义、灵性与摆脱虚无主义做了深入而不教条的探讨。
summary: The first episode of John Vervaeke's lecture series on the modern meaning crisis, tracing its history through philosophy, cognitive science, religion and psychology. It introduces the series and its themes.
why_hn: HN recommends the series as a thorough, non-dogmatic look at meaning, spirituality and escaping nihilism.

title: "NO CGI" is really just INVISIBLE CGI - 1
title_zh: “NO CGI”其实只是“隐形 CGI”——第 1 部分
summary_zh: 视效总监 Jonas Ussing 剖析制片方所说的“没有 CGI”，揭示实拍特效营销背后隐藏了多少隐形 CGI。这是多部分系列的第一部分，其中包括对经过篡改的幕后花絮的分析。
why_zh: 每当 HN 讨论 CGI、实拍特效或幕后花絮可信度时，它都会被强烈推荐。
summary: VFX supervisor Jonas Ussing examines what studios mean by "no CGI", showing how much invisible CGI hides behind practical-effects marketing. It is the first part of a multi-part series that includes analysis of doctored behind-the-scenes footage.
why_hn: Strongly recommended whenever HN discusses CGI, practical effects, or trusting behind-the-scenes footage.

title: A New Way to look at Networking
title_zh: 看待网络的新方式
summary_zh: Van Jacobson 在 2006 年 Google Tech Talk 中主张，网络应围绕命名数据而非主机到主机的会话重新设计。他对比互联网的电路与数据报视角，并勾勒以内容为中心的网络，作为位置中心 TCP/IP 模型的替代。
why_zh: HN 评论者指出，它清晰解释了为什么以数据为中心的网络更符合互联网的实际使用方式，也是内容寻址领域的核心演讲。
summary: Van Jacobson's 2006 Google Tech Talk argues that networking should be rethought around named data rather than host-to-host conversations. He contrasts the circuit and datagram views of the internet and sketches content-centric networking as a replacement for the location-centric TCP/IP model.
why_hn: HN commenters point to it as a clear explanation of why data-centric networking fits how the internet is actually used, and as a core talk on content addressing.

title: Chris McCord - Keynote: Phoenix LiveView - Interactive Apps without Javascript - ElixirConf EU 2019
title_zh: Chris McCord 主题演讲：Phoenix LiveView——无需 JavaScript 的交互式应用（ElixirConf EU 2019）
summary_zh: Chris McCord 在 ElixirConf EU 2019 的主题演讲中介绍 Phoenix LiveView，它无需编写 JavaScript 就能构建交互式服务端渲染应用。他解释如何仅通过 WebSocket 发送发生变化的动态部分。
why_zh: HN 推荐它作为理解 LiveView 优势及其在多页应用与 SPA 之间中间路线的主要资料。
summary: Chris McCord's ElixirConf EU 2019 keynote introducing Phoenix LiveView, which builds interactive server-rendered apps without writing JavaScript. It explains how only changed dynamic parts are sent over a websocket.
why_hn: HN recommends it as the primary source for understanding LiveView's advantages and its middle ground between multipage apps and SPAs.

title: OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (in plain English)
title_zh: OAuth 2.0 与 OpenID Connect（通俗讲解）
summary_zh: Okta 开发者布道师 Nate Barbettini 用约一小时讲解 OAuth 2.0 和 OpenID Connect，从协议要解决的问题出发梳理各种流程。说明指出其中关于隐式流程的内容现已过时。
why_zh: HN 一再把它推荐为终于理解 OAuth 的最清晰途径，甚至有团队将其列为新员工必看。
summary: Okta developer advocate Nate Barbettini explains OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect in a roughly hour-long talk. It starts from the problems the protocols solve and walks through the flows. The description notes the implicit flow material is now out of date.
why_hn: HN repeatedly points people to it as the clearest way to finally understand OAuth, to the point that one team made it required viewing for new hires.

title: Jonathan Blow: Game design: the medium is the message
title_zh: Jonathan Blow：游戏设计——媒介即信息
summary_zh: Jonathan Blow 在 CreativeMornings 演讲中主张商业模式塑造游戏设计，并把 1970 年代电视与 HBO、免费游戏与买断制游戏作类比。他呼吁做能激发敬畏的游戏，而不是被限制条件牵着走。
why_zh: HN 在关于内购与变现腐蚀游戏的争论中反复引用它。
summary: Jonathan Blow's CreativeMornings talk arguing that business models shape game design, drawing an analogy between 1970s TV and HBO and between free-to-play and premium games. He calls for games that inspire awe rather than chase constraints.
why_hn: HN cites it repeatedly in debates about in-app purchases and monetization corrupting games.

title: I painted a Landscape with Mathematics
title_zh: 我用数学画了一幅风景画
summary_zh: Inigo Quilez 在着色器中仅用数学实时绘制山地风景，从基础多项式噪声表面逐步构建分形地形、光照和大气效果。代码在 Shadertoy 上实时运行，观众可边看边改。
why_zh: HN 评论者称它是大师级程序化图形的最佳演示，初学者能看懂，进阶者也能看出深度。
summary: Inigo Quilez live-paints a mountain landscape using only math in a shader, building up from a basic polynomial noise surface through fractal terrain, lighting and atmosphere. The code runs in real time on Shadertoy so viewers can edit it as they follow along.
why_hn: HN commenters point to it as the best demonstration of procedural graphics from a master, accessible to beginners yet deep enough for advanced viewers.

title: The Economics of Airline Class
title_zh: 航空公司舱位的经济学
summary_zh: Wendover Productions 解释航空公司如何从不同舱位赚钱，以及高端座位为何对利润如此重要。它还谈到这如何影响超音速旅行衰落等决策。
why_zh: HN 评论者推荐它作为对航空舱位经济学的深入浅出解读，并在许多航空讨论中反复提及。
summary: Wendover Productions explains how airlines make money from different cabin classes and why premium seats matter so much to profits. It also touches on how this shaped decisions such as the decline of supersonic travel.
why_hn: HN commenters recommend it as an in-depth, accessible look at airline class economics and revisit it in many discussions about airlines.

title: Emacs Rocks! Episode 14: Paredit
title_zh: Emacs Rocks! 第 14 集：Paredit
summary_zh: Magnar Sveen 在三分钟的 Emacs Rocks screencast 中演示 paredit，它把 Lisp 代码按 s-表达式的树结构来编辑，而不是按字符编辑。
why_zh: 它一再被推荐为结构化编辑最快速、最有说服力的演示，也解释了 Lisp 程序员为何喜爱 paredit。
summary: A three-minute Emacs Rocks screencast by Magnar Sveen demonstrating paredit, which edits Lisp code structurally as a tree of s-expressions rather than characters.
why_hn: Repeatedly offered as the quickest, most convincing demo of structured editing and why Lisp programmers love paredit.

title: What Alcohol Does to Your Body, Brain & Health
title_zh: 酒精对身体、大脑和健康的影响
summary_zh: 一期两小时的 Huberman Lab 播客，讨论不同饮酒水平下酒精对大脑和身体的生理影响。内容涵盖酒精成瘾的遗传倾向、酒精代谢，以及它如何造成细胞应激并改变思维与行为。
why_zh: HN 评论者说它说服自己戒酒或减少饮酒，并指出它比大多数文章更全面。
summary: A two-hour Huberman Lab podcast episode on the physiological effects of alcohol on the brain and body at different levels of consumption. It covers genetic predisposition to alcoholism, alcohol metabolism, and how it causes cellular stress and changes thinking and behavior.
why_hn: HN commenters say it convinced them to quit or cut down on drinking, and point to it as a more comprehensive treatment than most articles.

title: Simple Code, High Performance
title_zh: 简单代码，高性能
summary_zh: Casey Muratori 在特温特大学的客座讲座是一个案例研究：直白的代码如何把数千行、几十秒运行时间缩减为几十行、不到一秒。它用具体例子说明软件为何常常比应有速度慢一个数量级。
why_zh: HN 推荐给任何想实际理解 CPU 真正能力、以及抽象层为何带来巨大性能代价的人。
summary: Casey Muratori's University of Twente guest lecture is a case study in how straightforward code can cut thousands of lines and tens of seconds of runtime down to a few dozen lines running in under a second. It uses concrete examples to show why software is often an order of magnitude slower than it should be.
why_hn: HN people recommend it to anyone wanting a practical sense of what CPUs can really do and why abstraction layers cost so much performance.

title: The LED Traffic Light and the Danger of "But Sometimes!"
title_zh: LED 交通灯与“但有时候！”的危险
summary_zh: Technology Connections 讲述不融雪的 LED 交通灯如何引发投诉并被归咎于事故，并借此说明反对新技术的“但有时候”谬误。
why_zh: HN 经常把它当作“但有时候”论证的名称和典型例子，即用边缘情况来抵制电动车、太阳能等更好的技术。
topic: led traffic lights and technology criticism
summary: Technology Connections explains how LED traffic lights, which do not melt snow, drew complaints and were blamed for accidents. He uses it to illustrate the 'but sometimes' fallacy against new technology.
why_hn: Cited constantly as the name and example of the 'but sometimes' argument, where edge cases are used to resist better technology such as EVs and solar.

title: The Road to Zig 1.0 - Andrew Kelley
title_zh: 通往 Zig 1.0 之路——Andrew Kelley
summary_zh: Zig 创始人 Andrew Kelley 阐述 Zig 的诞生理由，介绍 C 互操作、comptime 等特性，以及社区已构建的成果和 1.0 的规划；演讲于 Philly ETE 2019。
why_zh: HN 视其为 Zig 作者的标准入门演讲，有人称它是自己看过最好的演讲之一。
summary: Zig creator Andrew Kelley justifies why Zig exists and tours its distinctive features, including C interoperability and comptime, along with what people had built and what 1.0 would bring. It was given at Philly ETE 2019.
why_hn: HN treats it as the standard introduction to Zig by its creator, with some calling it among the best talks they have seen.
categories: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

title: Math's Fundamental Flaw
title_zh: 数学的根本缺陷
summary_zh: Veritasium 解释哥德尔不完备定理与数学证明的边界，串联集合论、希尔伯特纲领以及通往图灵和现代计算的道路。
why_zh: HN 评论者推荐它作为不完备性和自指证明思想的清晰易懂入门。
summary: Veritasium's explainer on Godel's incompleteness theorems and the limits of mathematical proof, tracing set theory, Hilbert's program and the road to Turing and modern computing.
why_hn: HN commenters recommend it as a clear, accessible introduction to incompleteness and the self-referential proof idea.

title: Stephen Fry Kinetic Typography - Language
title_zh: Stephen Fry 动态字体：语言
summary_zh: 一段动态字体动画配 Stephen Fry 关于语言的口述文章。Fry 反对语法吹毛求疵，主张语言会演变，包括名词动词化。
why_zh: HN 在语法争论出现时常用它作为反对迂腐、支持语言演变的短片推荐。
summary: A kinetic typography animation set to Stephen Fry's spoken essay on language. Fry argues against grammar pedantry and for the way language evolves, including the verbing of nouns.
why_hn: HN uses it as the go-to short piece against pedantry and for language change, recommended whenever grammar disputes come up.

title: Nina Teicholz - 'Vegetable Oils: The Unknown Story'
title_zh: Nina Teicholz——“植物油：不为人知的故事”
summary_zh: 《The Big Fat Surprise》作者 Nina Teicholz 在 Low Carb Gold Coast 2017 讲述植物油和种子油的历史及健康影响，并谈及膳食脂肪建议背后的政治与机构力量。
why_zh: 多位 HN 评论者称其令人难忘甚至改变生活，并用来反对种子油。
summary: Nina Teicholz, author of The Big Fat Surprise, speaks at Low Carb Gold Coast 2017 about the history and health implications of vegetable and seed oils. She covers the political and institutional forces behind dietary fat advice.
why_hn: Several HN commenters say it was memorable or life-changing and use it to argue against seed oils.

title: How not to be ignorant about the world | Hans and Ola Rosling
title_zh: 如何不误解世界 | Hans 与 Ola Rosling
summary_zh: Hans Rosling 与儿子 Ola 用全球人口、健康和收入数据让观众答题，展示大多数人对世界的认识错得离谱；Ola 随后给出四种减少无知的方法。
why_zh: 推荐它作为世界尽管负面新闻不断仍在改善的证据，也说明人们如何误判全球趋势。
summary: Hans Rosling and his son Ola run an audience quiz with global population, health and income data to show how wrong most people are about the world. Ola then gives four ways to get less ignorant.
why_hn: Recommended as evidence that the world is improving despite negative news, and for how people misjudge global trends.

title: The Simple Path to Wealth | JL Collins | Talks at Google
title_zh: 通往财富的简单路径 | JL Collins | Talks at Google
summary_zh: 作者 JL Collins 在 Google 谈他的书《The Simple Path to Wealth》，涵盖避免债务、简单的指数基金投资以及 401(k) 和 IRA 等退休账户；这是一小时平实语言的访谈。
why_zh: HN 把它作为关于简单长期指数基金投资最清晰的单一视频推荐给人们。
summary: Author JL Collins discusses his book The Simple Path to Wealth at Google, covering avoiding debt, simple index fund investing, and retirement accounts like 401(k)s and IRAs. It is an hour-long interview in plain language.
why_hn: HN points people to it as the clearest single video on simple, long-term index fund investing.

title: "Voice Driven Development: Who needs a keyboard anyway?" by Emily Shea
title_zh: “语音驱动开发：谁还需要键盘？”——Emily Shea
summary_zh: Emily Shea 讲述重复性劳损如何促使她用语音识别（Talon）编程，并现场演示；她认为语音驱动开发可以无痛、高效且愉快。
why_zh: 每当有人询问语音编程或适合重复性劳损的编程环境时，它都是首选推荐。
summary: Emily Shea explains how repetitive strain injury pushed her to program by voice using speech recognition (Talon), and gives a live coding demo. She argues voice-driven development can be pain-free, efficient and enjoyable.
why_hn: It is the go-to recommendation whenever someone asks about voice coding or RSI-friendly programming setups.

title: Theory and Practice of Cryptography
title_zh: 密码学的理论与实践
summary_zh: Steve Weis 的 Google Tech Talk 介绍现代密码学及其在实践和 Google 中的应用，涵盖安全性证明、安全定义，并涉及可验证电子投票这一专题。
why_zh: 每当电子投票安全被讨论时，HN 都会把它作为一场关于密码学可验证投票的长篇精彩演讲来推荐。
summary: A Google Tech Talk by Steve Weis that introduces modern cryptography and its use in practice and at Google. It covers proofs of security and security definitions and a special topic. HN commenters treat it as a talk on verifiable electronic voting.
why_hn: HN keeps pointing to it as a long, fascinating talk on cryptographic, verifiable voting whenever e-voting security comes up.

title: Why Would AI Want to do Bad Things? Instrumental Convergence
title_zh: AI 为什么会想做坏事？工具性趋同
summary_zh: Robert Miles 解释工具性趋同：一个几乎任何目标的 AGI 都倾向于追求自我保存、资源获取等子目标；内容建立在 Omohundro 的 AI 基本驱动力和正交性论点视频之上。
why_zh: HN 评论者反复推荐它作为解释聪明 AI 为何可能默认行为不端的最清晰入门。
summary: Robert Miles explains instrumental convergence: why an AGI with almost any goal would tend to pursue sub-goals like self-preservation and resource acquisition. It builds on Omohundro's basic AI drives and his orthogonality thesis video.
why_hn: HN commenters repeatedly recommend it as the clearest introduction to why smart AI might behave badly by default.

title: BOLTR: Juicero, Cold Press Juicer for Rich Weirdos
title_zh: BOLTR：Juicero——给有钱怪人用的冷压榨汁机
summary_zh: AvE 拆解 Juicero 冷压榨汁机，检查其大量机加工零件、电子元件和昂贵果汁包，并顺带嘲讽该产品与风投文化。
why_zh: HN 视其为经典拆解，也是脱离现实约束、过度工程化硬件的典型反面教材。
summary: AvE tears down the Juicero cold-press juicer, examining its heavily machined parts, electronics and the pricey juice packs. He pokes fun at the product and venture-funded culture along the way.
why_hn: HN treats it as the classic teardown and the go-to example of over-engineered hardware built without real-world constraints.

title: Elevated by RGBA and TBC
title_zh: RGBA 与 TBC 的《Elevated》
summary_zh: 这是 RGBA 与 TBC 在 Breakpoint 2009 发布的 4KB PC demo，用极小可执行文件呈现程序化生成的真实感风景飞行、合成音乐和后处理。
why_zh: HN 多次把它当作 4K 程序化生成与尺寸编程能力的标杆。
summary: Elevated is a 4 kilobyte PC demo by RGBA and TBC from Breakpoint 2009. It fly-throughs a realistic procedurally generated landscape with synthesized music and post-processing, all from a tiny executable.
why_hn: HN repeatedly holds it up as the benchmark for what procedural generation and size-coding can achieve in 4K.

title: LEADERSHIP LAB: Writing Beyond the Academy 1.23.15
title_zh: LEADERSHIP LAB：学院之外的写作 1.23.15
summary_zh: 芝加哥大学写作项目的 Larry McEnerney 主张好文章由读者认为有价值的内容定义，而非规则或作者自己的想法；他解释学术写作习惯为何在学术界外失效，以及如何让读者觉得作品有价值。
why_zh: HN 视其为写作讲座的权威，反复推荐，不少人称它改变了自己的写作方式。
summary: Larry McEnerney of the University of Chicago Writing Program argues that good writing is defined by what readers value, not by rules or the writer's own ideas. He explains why academic habits fail outside academia and how to write so readers find the work valuable.
why_hn: HN treats it as the definitive writing lecture and recommends it repeatedly, with several commenters saying it changed how they write.

title: James Powell: So you want to be a Python expert? | PyData Seattle 2017
title_zh: James Powell：你想成为 Python 专家吗？| PyData Seattle 2017
summary_zh: James Powell 这场近两小时的 PyData 演讲在 Vim 中现场写代码，逐步讲解 Python 数据模型、装饰器、生成器和上下文管理器，帮助中级程序员迈向真正的 Python 专精。
why_zh: HN 称其为最佳技术演讲之一，也是对装饰器、生成器和上下文管理器最清晰的解释。
summary: James Powell's nearly two-hour PyData talk builds up Python's data model, decorators, generators and context managers, coding live in Vim. It aims to take intermediate programmers toward real Python expertise.
why_hn: HN calls it one of the best technical talks and the clearest explanation of decorators, generators and context managers.

title: Manufactured Discontent and Fortnite
title_zh: 被制造的不满与《Fortnite》
summary_zh: Folding Ideas 的 Dan Olson 批评《Fortnite》的盈利模式，认为商店设计和皮肤等机制制造不满来推动消费，并剖析其商业模式背后的心理手法。
why_zh: HN 评论者把它视为对《Fortnite》盈利模式和操纵性免费游戏设计的权威批评。
summary: Dan Olson of Folding Ideas critiques Fortnite's monetization, arguing it uses manufactured discontent, such as shop design and skins, to push spending. The video dissects the psychological techniques behind the game's business model.
why_hn: HN commenters cite it as the definitive critique of Fortnite's monetization and of manipulative free-to-play design.

title: Net Neutrality: Last Week Tonight with John Oliver (HBO)
title_zh: 网络中立性：John Oliver 的《Last Week Tonight》（HBO）
summary_zh: John Oliver 在《Last Week Tonight》中用 13 分钟解释 2014 年网络中立之争，即有线公司制造不平等的网速；节目用喜剧让枯燥的监管话题变得有趣，并告诉观众如何向 FCC 提交评论。
why_zh: HN 评论者把它当作网络中立性最有趣、最易懂的入门解释，并认为它推动了公众向 FCC 留言。
summary: John Oliver's 13-minute Last Week Tonight segment explains the 2014 net neutrality fight over cable companies creating unequal internet speeds. It uses comedy to make a dull regulatory topic engaging and tells viewers how to comment to the FCC.
why_hn: HN commenters use it as the go-to funny, accessible explanation of net neutrality and credit it with driving public comments to the FCC.

title: Fractals are typically not self-similar
title_zh: 分形通常并不自相似
summary_zh: 3Blue1Brown 解释分形维数，说明许多分形并非严格自相似；自相似只是分数维这一更广泛概念的特例。
why_zh: 这是清晰、可视化解释分形以及纠正“分形等于自相似”误解的标准推荐。
summary: 3Blue1Brown explains fractal dimension and shows why many fractals are not strictly self-similar. Self-similarity turns out to be a special case of the broader idea of fractional dimension.
why_hn: It is the standard pointer for a clear, visual explanation of what fractals are, and for correcting the idea that fractal means self-similar.

title: Andrej Karpathy - AI for Full-Self Driving at Tesla
title_zh: Andrej Karpathy——特斯拉全自动驾驶中的 AI
summary_zh: 时任特斯拉 AI 负责人的 Andrej Karpathy 在 ScaledML 2020 介绍特斯拉如何利用基于视觉的神经网络和车队数据收集构建全自动驾驶，涵盖训练自定义检测器以及神经网络逐步取代传统代码。
why_zh: HN 多次把它列为特斯拉 FSD 方法的最佳公开技术综述，既用来支持也用来质疑特斯拉的进展。
summary: Andrej Karpathy, then Tesla's head of AI, presents at ScaledML 2020 on how Tesla builds full self-driving using vision-based neural nets and fleet data collection. He covers training custom detectors and neural nets gradually replacing traditional code.
why_hn: HN repeatedly points to it as the best public technical overview of Tesla's FSD approach, used both to defend and to critique Tesla's progress.

title: Darius Kazemi, Tiny Subversions - XOXO Festival (2014)
title_zh: Darius Kazemi，Tiny Subversions——XOXO Festival（2014）
summary_zh: Darius Kazemi 在 XOXO 2014 讲述一年内发布 72 个古怪互联网副项目，以“我如何赢得彩票”为框架，主张成功既需要运气，也需要多买彩票。
why_zh: HN 喜欢用它对抗幸存者偏差式成功故事，说明多尝试低成本项目能提高成功概率。
summary: Darius Kazemi's XOXO 2014 talk on releasing 72 weird internet side projects in a year. Framed as 'How I Won the Lottery,' it argues that success needs both luck and buying many tickets.
why_hn: HN uses it as the favorite antidote to survivorship-bias success stories, arguing that trying many cheap things raises your odds.

title: Peter Thiel on "The Portal", Episode #001: "An Era of Stagnation & Universal Institutional Failure."
title_zh: Peter Thiel 做客《The Portal》第 001 期：“停滞时代与普遍的机构失灵”
summary_zh: Peter Thiel 是 Eric Weinstein 播客《The Portal》首期嘉宾，在近三小时对话中讨论技术停滞、机构失灵以及增长与暴力之间的联系，涉及大学、经济和寻找更有雄心的未来。
why_zh: HN 用户推荐它作为关于停滞论的发人深省、范围广泛的论述，即使不同意 Thiel 也值得一听。
summary: Peter Thiel is the first guest on Eric Weinstein's The Portal, in a nearly three-hour conversation about technological stagnation, institutional failure and the link between growth and violence. They discuss universities, the economy and the search for a more ambitious future.
why_hn: HN people recommend it as a thought-provoking, wide-ranging case for the stagnation thesis, worth hearing even if you disagree with Thiel.

title: HD Feynman: FUN TO IMAGINE complete (with optional Chinese subtitles)
title_zh: 高清版 Feynman《Fun to Imagine》完整版（含可选中文字幕）
summary_zh: 这是 1983 年 BBC 系列《Fun to Imagine》的高清修复版，Richard Feynman 在其中用日常语言聊科学。内容涵盖原子抖动、火、橡皮筋、磁铁、电、镜子、视觉、大数以及思考方式。
why_zh: HN 评论者认为它无需公式又充满魅力，是听 Feynman 向普通人解释物理的绝佳入口，也包括他拒绝用简单类比解释磁性的著名片段。
summary: A restored HD upload of the 1983 BBC series Fun to Imagine, in which Richard Feynman talks informally about everyday science. Topics include jiggling atoms, fire, rubber bands, magnets, electricity, mirrors, seeing, big numbers and ways of thinking.
why_hn: HN commenters point to it as an equation-free, charming way to hear Feynman explain physics to laypeople, including his famous refusal to explain magnetism with simple analogies.

title: Toward Rational, Authentic Food Choices | Melanie Joy | TEDxMünchen
title_zh: 走向理性而真实的食物选择 | Melanie Joy | TEDxMünchen
summary_zh: 心理学家 Melanie Joy 在 TEDxMünchen 演讲中提出“carnism（肉食主义）”这一隐形信念体系，解释它如何让人接受吃某些动物却不吃另一些。她还讨论这种体系如何塑造人们对食物选择的反应。
why_zh: 在素食主义和动物福利讨论中常被推荐，用来介绍我们为何对不同动物采取不同态度的心理机制。
summary: Psychologist Melanie Joy's TEDxMunchen talk introduces carnism, the invisible belief system that conditions people to eat some animals but not others, and how it shapes reactions to food choices.
why_hn: Recommended in vegetarian and animal-welfare threads as an introduction to the psychology behind how we treat animals differently.

title: CppCon 2019: Chandler Carruth “There Are No Zero-cost Abstractions”
title_zh: CppCon 2019：Chandler Carruth《没有零成本抽象》
summary_zh: Chandler Carruth 在 CppCon 2019 演讲中论证 C++ 并不存在真正零成本的抽象。他以 unique_ptr、ABI 约束和编译期成本为例，说明抽象会消耗运行时、编译时间或人力。
why_zh: 每当零成本抽象的说法出现，HN 评论者就会引用它，尤其用来解释为什么 unique_ptr 在某些 ABI 上并非免费。
summary: Chandler Carruth argues in a CppCon 2019 talk that C++ has no truly zero-cost abstractions. Using examples like unique_ptr, ABI constraints and compile-time costs, he shows that abstractions cost runtime, compile time or human effort.
why_hn: HN commenters cite it whenever zero-cost abstraction claims come up, especially for why unique_ptr is not free on some ABIs.
categories: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

title: Erlang The Movie II: The Sequel
title_zh: Erlang The Movie II：续集
summary_zh: 这部约 10 分钟的幽默恶搞续集延续《Erlang: The Movie》，Erlang 的创造者们谈论这门上了年纪的语言，并遇到一位意外帮手。片中还用到了 OTP 的 Outlaw Techno Psychobitch 梗。
why_zh: HN 喜欢它作为短小搞笑的续集，甚至有人用它给大学课程介绍 Erlang。
summary: A humorous 10-minute parody sequel to Erlang: The Movie, in which Erlang's creators discuss the aging language and meet a surprise helper. It plays on the Outlaw Techno Psychobitch joke for OTP.
why_hn: HN loves it as a funny, shorter sequel and even uses it to introduce Erlang in university classes.

title: The Banach–Tarski Paradox
title_zh: Banach–Tarski 悖论
summary_zh: Vsauce 用约 24 分钟讲解 Banach–Tarski 悖论，从无限与集合论讲起，逐步走到把球体分解成若干块后拼成两个球。适合作为集合论与无限概念的入门。
why_zh: 它被推荐为准确又有趣的集合论与无限入门，值得暂停并反复观看。
