summary: Vsauce's roughly 24 minute explainer on the Banach-Tarski paradox, building from infinity and set theory to the decomposition of a sphere into pieces that form two spheres.
why_hn: Recommended as an accurate, entertaining on-ramp to set theory and infinity, worth pausing and rewatching.

title: CppCon 2017: Juan Pedro Bolivar Puente “Postmodern immutable data structures”
title_zh: CppCon 2017：Juan Pedro Bolivar Puente《后现代不可变数据结构》
summary_zh: Juan Pedro Bolivar Puente 讲解 C++ 中的不可变与持久化数据结构，以及它们如何支持值语义。他介绍 Immer 库、rrb-trees，并展示一个能瞬间打开超大文件的文本编辑器原型。
why_zh: HN 用户常因 rrb-trees、文本编辑器数据结构和把 Clojure 风格持久化结构引入 C++ 而推荐它。
summary: Juan Pedro Bolivar Puente explains immutable and persistent data structures in C++ and how they support value semantics. He presents the Immer library, rrb-trees, and a prototype text editor that opens a huge file instantly.
why_hn: HN people point to it for rrb-trees, text editor data structures and bringing Clojure-style persistent structures to C++.
categories: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

title: On The Turing Completeness of PowerPoint (SIGBOVIK)
title_zh: 论 PowerPoint 的图灵完备性（SIGBOVIK）
summary_zh: Tom Wildenhain 在 SIGBOVIK 2017 的短演讲中证明 PowerPoint 动画是图灵完备的，并在幻灯片里搭出一台可运行的图灵机。整个演讲一本正经，仿佛在报告严肃研究成果。
why_zh: HN 多次把它列为最搞笑、最精彩的演讲之一，是荒诞计算的经典例子。
summary: A short SIGBOVIK 2017 presentation by Tom Wildenhain showing that PowerPoint animations are Turing complete, with a working Turing machine built in slides. The talk is delivered deadpan as a serious research result.
why_hn: HN repeatedly names it as one of the funniest and best talks, a favorite example of absurd computation.

title: Why Electronic Voting is a BAD Idea - Computerphile
title_zh: 为什么电子投票是个坏主意——Computerphile
summary_zh: Tom Scott 在 Computerphile 视频中解释电子投票为何不可取，认为纸质选票透明、可审计且难以大规模篡改。他还说明把投票搬到手机、平板或电脑上为何会损害信任与可验证性。
why_zh: 每当电子投票、投票机或在线投票成为话题，HN 评论者都会链接这个简短说明。
summary: Tom Scott explains for Computerphile why electronic voting is a bad idea, arguing that paper ballots are transparent, auditable and hard to tamper with at scale. He covers why moving voting to phones, tablets or computers undermines trust and verifiability.
why_hn: It is the go-to short explainer HN commenters link whenever e-voting, voting machines or online voting come up.

title: You Actually Share Your Brain With a Silent Stranger
title_zh: 你其实和一个沉默的陌生人共享大脑
summary_zh: CGP Grey 讲解裂脑患者：切断胼胝体后，两个半球可以独立行动。他借此探讨一个脑袋里存在两个心智的想法。
why_zh: 在意识和决策相关讨论中，HN 经常引用它作为对裂脑清晰又有趣的解释。
summary: CGP Grey explains split-brain patients, where severing the corpus callosum lets the two hemispheres act independently. He uses this to explore the idea of two minds in one head.
why_hn: HN returns to it constantly in consciousness and decision-making threads as a clear, entertaining explanation of split-brain.

title: A new way to visualize General Relativity
title_zh: 可视化广义相对论的新方式
summary_zh: ScienceClic 解释为什么用“橡胶布”类比广义相对论会误导人，并提供一种新的可视化方式，把时间弯曲也纳入其中，展示引力是物体在弯曲时空中的运动。
why_zh: 许多评论者称它是广义相对论的最佳可视化，帮助他们厘清长期以来的引力误解。
summary: ScienceClic explains why the rubber sheet analogy for general relativity is misleading and offers a new visualization that includes the curvature of time and shows gravity as motion through curved spacetime.
why_hn: Called the best visualization of general relativity by many commenters, who say it cleared up long-held misunderstandings of gravity.

title: Carl Sagan - Pale Blue Dot
title_zh: Carl Sagan——暗淡蓝点
summary_zh: Carl Sagan 朗诵《暗淡蓝点》段落，回望 Voyager 拍下的地球照片——太空中一个微小的点。这是一段关于人类渺小与共同家园的简短沉思。
why_zh: HN 评论者常回到它那里寻找视角与慰藉，也喜欢 Sagan 抚慰人心的声音，并建议定期观看。
summary: Carl Sagan's narration of the Pale Blue Dot passage, reflecting on the Voyager photograph of Earth as a tiny speck in space. It is a short meditation on humanity's smallness and shared home.
why_hn: HN commenters return to it for perspective, comfort and Sagan's soothing voice, and suggest watching it periodically.

title: The Art of Making a Nixie Tube
title_zh: 制作 Nixie 管的艺术
summary_zh: Dalibor Farny 记录 Nixie 管的手工制造过程，从吹玻璃到抽真空，以文字注释而非旁白呈现。他复兴了这门失传的 Nixie 管制作手艺。
why_zh: HN 评论者称它令人着迷，是观察专注匠人如何真正制造东西的绝佳窗口。
summary: Dalibor Farny documents the hand manufacture of a nixie tube, from glassblowing to evacuation, with text notes rather than narration. He revived the lost craft of nixie tube making.
why_hn: HN commenters call it mesmerizing and a great look at how things are actually made by a dedicated craftsman.

title: Casey Muratori | Smart-Pointers, RAII, ZII? Becoming an N+2 programmer
title_zh: Casey Muratori：智能指针、RAII、ZII？成为 N+2 程序员
summary_zh: Casey Muratori 反对智能指针和 RAII，主张按组处理元素、零初始化（ZII）和存根（stubs）来组织内存与处理错误。
why_zh: HN 评论者在内存管理和语言设计讨论中称其最好地解释了组生命周期与逐对象所有权之别。
summary: Casey Muratori argues against smart pointers and RAII, advocating grouped-element thinking, zero-is-initialization and stubs as better ways to structure memory and handle errors.
why_hn: HN commenters in memory management and language design threads cite it as the best explanation of group lifetimes versus per-object ownership.
categories: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

title: Chicken chicken chicken
title_zh: Chicken chicken chicken
summary_zh: Doug Zongker 在 2007 年 AAAS 幽默环节上，以一本正经的方式演讲他那篇著名的“鸡”论文，讽刺学术报告并展示糟糕演示的陷阱。
why_zh: 被奉为幽默经典，常被当作学术演讲反面教材的必看视频。
summary: Doug Zongker's deadpan conference presentation of his famously chicken-filled paper, given at the 2007 AAAS humor session. It satirizes academic talks while showing the pitfalls of bad presentation.
why_hn: Beloved as a humor masterpiece and often cited as required viewing on what not to do in an academic talk.

title: Quantum Fields: The Real Building Blocks of the Universe - with David Tong
title_zh: 量子场：宇宙的真正基本构件——David Tong
summary_zh: 剑桥理论物理学家 David Tong 在皇家学会讲解，自然的基本构件是量子场而非粒子；他介绍我们对这些场的已知认识及其在标准模型中的位置。
why_zh: 评论者称其为最清晰通俗的解释：场中只有波，以及物理学仍未解之谜。
summary: David Tong, a Cambridge theoretical physicist, explains at the Royal Institution that the fundamental building blocks of nature are quantum fields rather than particles. He covers what we know about these fields and how they fit into the Standard Model.
why_hn: Called a favorite and a masterpiece by commenters as the clearest accessible explanation that there are only waves in fields, and what physics still doesn't know.

title: Longer-lasting light bulbs: it was complicated
title_zh: 更长寿的灯泡：事情很复杂
summary_zh: Technology Connections 探讨灯泡寿命为何如此，包括 Phoebus 卡特尔的历史；他指出寿命与亮度、效率之间存在权衡，而非简单的计划性淘汰。
why_zh: HN 用来纠正灯泡阴谋论的常引链接，从工程师视角解释寿命与效率的权衡。
summary: Technology Connections examines why light bulbs have the lifespans they do, including the real history of the Phoebus cartel. He shows that bulb life trades off against brightness and efficiency rather than being simple planned obsolescence.
why_hn: HN's go-to link for correcting the lightbulb conspiracy myth, giving an engineer's view of the lifespan versus efficiency tradeoff.

title: [1hr Talk] Intro to Large Language Models
title_zh: 【一小时讲座】大语言模型入门
summary_zh: Andrej Karpathy 用一小时向大众介绍大语言模型：它们是什么、如何训练、与操作系统的类比，以及越狱等安全挑战。
why_zh: HN 推荐为理解 LLM 高密度又平易近人的起点，常被引用于缩放与训练的具体论断。
summary: Andrej Karpathy gives a one-hour general-audience introduction to large language models, covering what they are, how they are trained, comparisons to operating systems, and security challenges such as jailbreaks.
why_hn: HN recommends it as the dense, approachable starting point for understanding LLMs and often cites it for specific claims about scaling and training.

title: Thinking outside the 10-dimensional box
title_zh: 跳出 10 维盒子思考
summary_zh: 3Blue1Brown 可视化高维球体，解释维度增长时球体如何放入盒子的反直觉谜题，帮助建立高维空间几何直觉。
why_zh: HN 推荐为高维几何的直观可视化首选，与机器学习、优化和球填充相关。
summary: 3Blue1Brown visualizes high-dimensional spheres to explain a surprising puzzle about how a sphere fits in a box as dimensions grow. It builds geometric intuition for counterintuitive properties of high-dimensional space.
why_hn: HN recommends it as the go-to intuitive visualization of high-dimensional geometry, relevant to machine learning, optimization and sphere packing.

title: The Physics and Philosophy of Time - with Carlo Rovelli
title_zh: 时间的物理与哲学——Carlo Rovelli
summary_zh: 物理学家 Carlo Rovelli 在皇家学会公开讲座，讲述从 Boltzmann、Einstein 到量子理论和圈量子引力，我们对时间的理解如何改变；他融合物理、哲学与艺术，论证时间比日常直觉更奇特。
why_zh: HN 评论者称其为清晰面向大众的讲座，展示常见时间观念有多错误，常出现在熵与时间之箭的讨论中。
summary: Physicist Carlo Rovelli gives a public lecture at the Royal Institution on how our understanding of time has changed, from Boltzmann and Einstein to quantum theory and loop quantum gravity. He blends physics, philosophy and art to argue that time is stranger than everyday intuition suggests.
why_hn: HN commenters point to it as a lucid, general-audience lecture that shows how wrong common conceptions of time are, often in threads on entropy and the arrow of time.

title: Veritasium: What Everyone Gets Wrong About AI and Learning – Derek Muller Explains
title_zh: Veritasium：关于 AI 与学习，人人都搞错了什么——Derek Muller 的解释
summary_zh: Veritasium 的 Derek Muller 在 Perimeter Institute 直播中谈 AI 可能如何改变教与学；他借鉴过去技术变革和认知科学，论证学习需要费力的重复。
why_zh: 推荐为对 AI 与教育的平衡观点，指出学习需要付出，没有技术能替你完成。
summary: Veritasium's Derek Muller gives a Perimeter Institute livestream on how AI might change teaching and learning. He draws on past technology shifts and cognitive science to argue that learning requires effortful repetition.
why_hn: Recommended as a balanced take on AI and education, with the point that learning takes work that no technology can do for you.

title: How Special Relativity Makes Magnets Work
title_zh: 狭义相对论如何让磁铁工作
summary_zh: Veritasium 解释磁性是狭义相对论的后果：运动电荷的长度收缩使导线中的电流吸引或排斥附近的运动电荷。
why_zh: HN 评论者推荐为简短清晰的解释：为何运动电荷会产生磁场。
summary: Veritasium explains magnetism as a consequence of special relativity. Length contraction of moving charges makes a current in a wire attract or repel a nearby moving charge.
why_hn: HN commenters recommend it as a short, clear explanation of why moving charges create magnetic fields.

title: Apollo Guidance Computer Part 1: Restoring the computer that put man on the Moon
title_zh: 阿波罗导航计算机 第一部：修复把人送上月球的计算机
summary_zh: CuriousMarc 系列第一集，在 AGC 专家 Mike Stewart 带领下修复一台真实的阿波罗导航计算机；他们在休斯顿酒店房间搭起临时实验室，打开私人收藏家拥有的罕见机器。
why_zh: HN 推荐整个 AGC 修复系列，深入极客地观察真实的阿波罗时代硬件，包括核心 rope memory。
summary: The first episode of CuriousMarc's series restoring a real Apollo Guidance Computer, led by AGC expert Mike Stewart. They set up a makeshift lab in a Houston hotel room to open up a rare machine owned by a private collector.
why_hn: HN people recommend the whole AGC restoration series as a deeply nerdy look at real Apollo-era hardware, including core rope memory.

title: Debate Noam Chomsky & Michel Foucault - On human nature [Subtitled]
title_zh: Noam Chomsky 与 Michel Foucault 辩论人性（带字幕）
summary_zh: 1971 年荷兰电视台播出的 Chomsky 与 Foucault 完整辩论，配有字幕，两人围绕人性、创造性、知识与权力政治展开交锋。
why_zh: HN 推荐它，因为这是两位思想家之间著名而富有启发的碰撞，尽管也有人指出双方其实各说各话。
summary: The full 1971 Dutch television debate between Noam Chomsky and Michel Foucault on human nature, with subtitles. They discuss creativity, knowledge, power and politics.
why_hn: HN recommends it as a famous, revealing clash between two thinkers, though some note they largely talk past each other.

title: Monktoberfest 2016: Bryan Cantrill - Oral Tradition in Software Engineering
title_zh: Bryan Cantrill：软件工程中的口述传统（Monktoberfest 2016）
summary_zh: 演讲讲述软件工程师如何靠口述传统把知识传给后人，从顺口溜到程序员掌故，例如 C 语言为何没有逻辑异或；他主张写代码时要为未来的读者着想。
why_zh: HN 认为它风趣、讲得精彩、故事丰富，展现了历史背景与详尽注释的价值。
summary: Bryan Cantrill's Monktoberfest 2016 talk on how software engineers pass knowledge down through oral tradition, from folk rhymes to programmer lore and stories like why C lacks a logical XOR. He argues for writing software with future generations in mind.
why_hn: HN recommends it as an entertaining, well-delivered talk full of stories that shows the value of historical context and long comments in code.

title: Dani DaOrtiz at Fool US 2022 (the act that Penn and Teller didn’t even try to figure out.)
title_zh: Dani DaOrtiz 在 Penn & Teller: Fool Us 2022 的表演（连 Penn 和 Teller 都放弃破解的魔术）
summary_zh: 一段十分钟的纸牌魔术表演，全靠时机、错误引导与心理操控，其手法让节目主持人也放弃破解。
why_zh: HN 评论者反复称它为史上最佳魔术表演之一，认为即使知道手法依然精彩，是表演与技艺的典范。
summary: A ten-minute card-magic act by Dani DaOrtiz performed on Penn & Teller: Fool Us in 2022. It is built on timing, misdirection and psychology, and the method defeated the show's hosts.
why_hn: HN commenters repeatedly call it among the best magic performances ever, valuing it as acting and craft that stays impressive even once you know the method.

title: I don't like notebooks.- Joel Grus (Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence)
title_zh: Joel Grus：我不喜欢 notebook
summary_zh: Joel Grus 在 JupyterCon 上解释他为何不喜欢 Jupyter notebook：隐藏状态、难以复现与测试、给教学添麻烦，并展示自己偏好的工作流。
why_zh: 这是对 notebook 最有趣又最不客气的经典批评，HN 每次辩论 notebook 与可测试代码时都会引用。
summary: Joel Grus's JupyterCon talk explaining why he dislikes Jupyter notebooks. He covers hidden state, trouble with reproducibility and testing, and how notebooks frustrate teaching. He shows his preferred workflow and what Jupyter could change.
why_hn: It is the go-to funny, irreverent critique of notebooks, linked whenever HN debates notebooks versus testable code.

title: The Marvel Symphonic Universe
title_zh: 漫威的交响乐宇宙
summary_zh: Every Frame a Painting 的视频论文，追问漫威电影为何缺少令人难忘的配乐主题，并将其归因于临时参考音乐和导演按填充音乐来配乐。
why_zh: HN 推荐它，因为它犀利地解释了现代电影配乐为何听起来千篇一律，启示远超漫威本身。
summary: An Every Frame a Painting video essay asking why Marvel films lack memorable musical themes. It blames temp tracks and directors scoring to filler music.
why_hn: HN recommends it as an insightful explanation of why modern film scores sound alike, with lessons beyond Marvel.

title: Ground Source / Geothermal Heat Pumps and Other Info
title_zh: 地源热泵及其他相关知识
summary_zh: Technology Connections 讲解地源（地热）热泵的原理，以及它为什么在冬季依然高效，并顺带介绍其他热泵知识（视频说明提到空气源热泵此后已有改进）。
why_zh: 它是一套出色又通俗的住宅热泵系列视频之一，因此被推荐。
summary: A Technology Connections video on how ground-source (geothermal) heat pumps work and why they hold efficiency in winter. It also covers related heat pump information, and the description notes air-source heat pumps have since improved.
why_hn: Recommended as part of an excellent, approachable series explaining residential heat pumps.

title: C++ and Beyond 2012: Herb Sutter - atomic Weapons 1 of 2
title_zh: Herb Sutter：atomic 武器（C++ and Beyond 2012，第 1 部分）
summary_zh: Herb Sutter 深入讲解 atomics 与 C++ 内存模型，说明追求极致性能的程序员为何必须理解硬件层面的内存序。这是两部分中的第一部分。
why_zh: HN 视其为学习 atomics 与内存序的经典首选，甚至比读书更值得推荐。
summary: Herb Sutter's deep C++ and Beyond 2012 talk on atomics and the C++ memory model, covering why programmers chasing top performance need to understand hardware ordering. This is part one of two.
why_hn: HN treats it as the classic go-to for learning atomics and memory ordering, recommended over books.
categories: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

title: What People Get Wrong About Dense Urban Living
title_zh: 人们对高密度城市生活的误解
summary_zh: Oh The Urbanity! 指出大多数城市居民其实住在市中心之外的高密度住宅区，那里可以安静而宜居，并以多伦多和蒙特利尔较老的高密度街区为例。
why_zh: HN 用户常引用它来反驳“城市生活就等于曼哈顿或香港式高楼”的成见。
summary: Oh The Urbanity! argues that most city dwellers live in dense residential neighbourhoods outside downtown, which can be calm and peaceful. It draws on older, denser parts of Toronto and Montreal.
why_hn: HN users repeatedly post it to rebut the idea that urban living means Manhattan or Hong Kong apartment blocks.

title: The Future of Mathematics?
title_zh: 数学的未来？
summary_zh: 数学家 Kevin Buzzard 解释他为何相信 Lean 定理证明器将塑造数学的未来，并讲述他带本科生把大学课程形式化到 Lean 中的经历以及遇到的文化阻力。
why_zh: 它被视为数学家谈形式化证明助手、以及数学为何应当形式化的最清晰论述。
summary: Mathematician Kevin Buzzard explains why he believes the Lean theorem prover will shape the future of mathematics, and describes digitizing his university curriculum in Lean with undergraduates, plus the cultural challenges.
why_hn: Recommended as the clearest mathematician's perspective on formal proof assistants and why mathematics should be formalized.

title: All-In Summit: Bill Gurley presents 2,851 Miles
title_zh: All-In Summit：Bill Gurley 演讲《2,851 英里》
summary_zh: Bill Gurley 在 All-In Summit 2023 的演讲，标题取自华盛顿与旧金山之间的距离。他讲述在位企业如何借助游说和监管巩固自身地位，随后与主持人展开对谈。
why_zh: HN 读者反复推荐它，认为这是对“监管俘获”最清晰的解释，并在 AI 监管、GDPR 和电信等话题中引用。
summary: Bill Gurley's talk at the All-In Summit 2023, titled 2,851 Miles after the distance between Washington and San Francisco. He describes how incumbents use lobbying and regulation to entrench themselves, followed by a conversation with the hosts.
why_hn: HN commenters repeatedly recommend it as the clearest explanation of regulatory capture, and cite it in threads on AI regulation, GDPR and telecom.

title: Sorting Algorithms: Speed Is Found In The Minds of People - Andrei Alexandrescu - CppCon 2019
title_zh: 排序算法：速度藏在人的头脑里——Andrei Alexandrescu（CppCon 2019）
summary_zh: Andrei Alexandrescu 在 CppCon 2019 重新审视排序，展示无分支技巧、混合策略和一种成本度量如何让 std::sort 风格的算法在现代硬件上更快。
why_zh: HN recommends it as an entertaining talk that starts simple and goes deep on practical performance optimization.
summary: Andrei Alexandrescu's CppCon 2019 talk revisits sorting, showing how branchless tricks, hybrid strategies and a cost metric can speed up std::sort-style algorithms on modern hardware.
categories: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

title: !!Con 2016 - How I Code and Use a Computer at 1,000 WPM!! By Sina Bahram
title_zh: !!Con 2016：我如何以每分钟 1,000 词的速度写代码和用电脑——Sina Bahram
summary_zh: 盲人开发者 Sina Bahram 在 !!Con 2016 的简短演讲，讲他如何借助屏幕阅读器以约每分钟 1,000 词的速度使用电脑和写代码。他演示常见界面的实际听感，并挑战观众只用键盘生活一天。
why_zh: HN commenters repeatedly share it because it is an eye-opening look at screen-reader use, and because at about 6:30 it addresses how inaccessible Hacker News itself is.
summary: A short !!Con 2016 talk by blind developer Sina Bahram on how he uses a computer and writes code with a screen reader at about 1,000 words per minute. He plays how common interfaces sound and challenges the audience to go a day using only the keyboard.

title: Kurt Vonnegut, Shape of Stories (subtitulos castellano)
title_zh: Kurt Vonnegut：故事的形状（西班牙语字幕）
summary_zh: Kurt Vonnegut 2004 年在 Case College 的讲座，带西班牙语字幕。他在黑板上勾勒故事的形状，把好运与坏运随时间的变化画成故事弧线。
why_zh: Frequently recommended as a delightful, influential way to think about story structure.
summary: Kurt Vonnegut's 2004 Case College lecture, with Spanish subtitles, in which he sketches the shapes of stories on a blackboard. He plots story arcs as good and bad fortune against time.

title: "Production Prolog" by Michael Hendricks
title_zh: 《生产环境中的 Prolog》——Michael Hendricks
summary_zh: PriceCharting 的 Michael Hendricks 在 Strange Loop 分享在生产环境运行 Prolog 18 个月的技巧与痛点。他认为 Prolog 是超越逻辑谜题的现代高效语言，并演示了在运行中修改代码。
why_zh: It is the go-to answer to whether Prolog is used for real-world work, praised as a survey of its uses, advantages and drawbacks.
summary: Michael Hendricks of PriceCharting shares tricks and pain points from running Prolog in production for 18 months at Strange Loop. It argues Prolog is a productive modern language beyond logic puzzles, and includes a demo of changing code mid-execution.

title: The Biggest Ideas in the Universe: Introduction
title_zh: 《宇宙中最大的那些想法》：引言
summary_zh: Sean Carroll 介绍他关于物理学核心概念的系列视频，涵盖对称性、空间和物质等主题，采用非正式讲解加问答视频的形式。这是该系列简短的开场视频。
why_zh: HN commenters recommend the series as engaging, substantial physics with just enough math for non-specialists.
summary: Sean Carroll introduces his video series on the biggest ideas in physics, such as symmetry, space and matter, as informal discussions with follow-up Q&A videos. This is the short opening video of the series.

title: Creating a Doom-style 3D engine in C
title_zh: 用 C 写一个 Doom 风格的 3D 引擎
summary_zh: Bisqwit 从零开始用 C 构建一个 Doom 或 Duke Nukem 3D 风格的软件渲染 3D 引擎，并支持非欧几里得几何。内容涵盖向量旋转和传送门渲染，编码过程以加速、工具辅助的形式呈现。
why_zh: A favorite on Ask HN lists of programming YouTube channels, praised for mind-blowing systems and graphics programming and a watchable coding style.
summary: Bisqwit builds a Doom or Duke Nukem 3D style software-rendered 3D engine in C from scratch, supporting non-Euclidean geometry. It covers vector rotation and portal rendering with sped-up, tool-assisted coding.
categories: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

title: 28c3: The coming war on general computation
title_zh: 28c3：即将到来的通用计算之战
summary_zh: Cory Doctorow 在 28c3 的主题演讲中提出，版权战争只是前哨战，真正的战斗将针对通用计算机。他解释为何锁定设备、DRM 和监控工具都依赖于剥夺通用计算能力。
why_zh: HN returns to it constantly as a prescient talk, cited whenever threads cover DRM, locked-down devices, app verification or restrictions on running your own software.
summary: Cory Doctorow's 28c3 keynote argues that the copyright wars were just a skirmish and that the real fight will be a war on the general-purpose computer. He explains why locked-down devices, DRM and surveillance tools all depend on removing general computation.

title: DEF CON 22 - Zoz - Don't Fuck It Up!
title_zh: DEF CON 22：Zoz——别搞砸了！
summary_zh: Zoz 在 DEF CON 22 谈无处不在的监控时代下的行动安全（OPSEC）。他展示即使是对此理应熟知的人，也难以避免失误。
why_zh: It is the usual cite for why good OPSEC is so hard, including entry and exit point correlation and digital exhaust.
summary: Zoz's DEF CON 22 talk on operational security in the age of pervasive surveillance. He shows how hard it is to avoid mistakes even for people who should know better.

title: Paxos lecture (Raft user study)
title_zh: Paxos 讲座（Raft 用户研究）
summary_zh: John Ousterhout 以幻灯片加旁白的形式讲解 Paxos，该讲座为比较学生学习 Raft 与 Paxos 的 Raft 用户研究而制作。它是对 Paxos 共识算法的完整入门。
why_zh: Recommended as a clear, lucid way to learn Paxos and Multi-Paxos, ideally alongside the companion Raft video.
summary: John Ousterhout's slides-and-voiceover lecture on Paxos, made for the Raft user study comparing how students learn Raft and Paxos. It is a full introduction to the Paxos consensus algorithm.

title: Demystifying the Higgs Boson with Leonard Susskind
title_zh: Leonard Susskind 揭开希格斯玻色子的面纱
summary_zh: 斯坦福物理学家 Leonard Susskind 解释希格斯机制是什么，以及“赋予粒子质量”意味着什么。他还谈到这对物理学和宇宙学的意义。
why_zh: HN repeatedly recommends it as an approachable, math-light route to understanding mass and the Higgs field.
summary: Stanford physicist Leonard Susskind explains what the Higgs mechanism is and what it means to give mass to particles. He also covers what is at stake for physics and cosmology.

title: Why We Get Fat: And What to Do About It | Gary Taubes | Talks at Google
title_zh: 我们为什么会发胖：以及该怎么办 | Gary Taubes | Talks at Google
summary_zh: Gary Taubes 在 2011 年向 Google 员工阐述其著作《我们为什么会发胖》的论点。他声称热量的种类比数量更重要，质疑“热量摄入-消耗”模型，并批评低脂饮食的主流共识。
why_zh: Recommended in diet and weight-loss threads as the accessible case for the carbohydrate-insulin view of obesity.
summary: Gary Taubes presents the argument of his book Why We Get Fat to Googlers in 2011. He claims the type of calories matters more than the count, challenges calories-in-calories-out thinking and criticizes the low-fat dietary consensus.

title: Optimistic Nihilism
title_zh: 乐观虚无主义
summary_zh: Kurzgesagt 的动画短片解释乐观虚无主义：宇宙没有固有意义，因此我们可以自由创造自己的意义并享受生活。
why_zh: HN 用户推荐它作为面对焦虑、中年困惑和人生落后感时，对虚无主义清晰而令人安慰的入门。
summary: Kurzgesagt's short animated take on optimistic nihilism. It argues the universe has no inherent meaning, so we are free to create our own and enjoy life.
why_hn: HN users recommend it as a comforting, clear introduction to nihilism for anxiety, mid-life doubts and feeling behind in life.

title: George Carlin Talks About "Stuff"
title_zh: George Carlin 谈“Stuff”
summary_zh: George Carlin 1986 年 Comic Relief 的经典段子，讽刺人们一生忙于积累和存放“东西”，以及美国消费主义。
why_zh: HN 在杂物、仓储、房地产和消费主义讨论中反复引用，认为它是最贴切的喜剧解读。
summary: George Carlin's classic stand-up routine about 'stuff' and how much of life is spent accumulating and storing it, from Comic Relief 1986. It satirizes American consumerism and possessions.
why_hn: HN keeps linking it in threads on clutter, storage units, real estate and consumerism as a perfectly apt comic take.

title: VisiData Lightning Demo at PyCascades 2018
title_zh: PyCascades 2018 上的 VisiData 闪电演示
summary_zh: 五分钟演示终端数据探索工具 VisiData，用纽约市两个月 311 投诉数据展示下钻、在虚拟地图上标点和保存选中行。
why_zh: HN 推荐它是了解 VisiData 能力的最快方式，因为看演示比读介绍更清楚。
summary: A five-minute lightning demo of VisiData, a terminal tool for exploring and manipulating data. It uses two months of NYC 311 complaint data to drill down, plot points on a virtual map and save selected rows.
why_hn: HN recommends it as the fastest way to understand what VisiData can do, since seeing it work is clearer than reading about it.

title: (1/4) Intro/History: Introducing a 100-year-old mechanical computer
title_zh: （1/4）导论/历史：介绍一台百年前的机械计算机
summary_zh: Bill Hammack（engineerguy）四集短片的第一集，介绍百年历史机械计算机 Michelson 谐波分析仪的由来与历史；系列后续讲解傅里叶合成、分析和机器操作。
why_zh: 每当傅里叶分析或模拟计算被提起，评论者就推荐这个系列，称赞 Hammack 讲解清晰、单集短小。
summary: The first of four short videos from Bill Hammack (engineerguy) introducing and giving the history of a 100-year-old mechanical computer, Michelson's harmonic analyzer. The series goes on to explain Fourier synthesis, analysis and operation of the machine.
why_hn: Commenters recommend the series whenever Fourier analysis or analog computing comes up, praising Hammack's clear explanations and the short episodes.

title: Gtk to Qt - a strange journey [linux.conf.au 2014]
title_zh: 从 Gtk 到 Qt：一段奇怪的旅程 [linux.conf.au 2014]
summary_zh: Dirk Hohndel 讲述 Subsurface 潜水日志项目为何从 Gtk 迁移到 Qt、遇到哪些障碍，并给受困于 Gtk 的其他应用提建议。
why_zh: 它是 GTK 与 Qt 争论中的常用参考，因经验丰富开发者的坦诚讲述而受重视。
summary: Dirk Hohndel explains why the Subsurface dive log project migrated from Gtk to Qt, the obstacles encountered, and advice for other applications frustrated with Gtk. It is a linux.conf.au 2014 talk.
why_hn: Go-to reference in GTK versus Qt debates, valued for a candid account from experienced developers who tried both toolkits.

title: Joscha Bach: Artificial Consciousness and the Nature of Reality | Lex Fridman Podcast #101
title_zh: Joscha Bach：人工意识与现实的本质 | Lex Fridman Podcast #101
summary_zh: Lex Fridman 与 Joscha Bach 进行三小时对话，讨论人工意识、心智运作、智能以及现实可能是模拟的。
why_zh: 被赞为漫长但值得的对话，评论者尤其喜欢 Bach 对建模作为一种技能的强调，以及他在心智与计算之间搭桥。
summary: Lex Fridman has a three-hour conversation with Joscha Bach about artificial consciousness, the workings of the mind, intelligence and the possibly simulated nature of reality.
why_hn: Praised as a long but rewarding conversation, with commenters especially liking Bach's emphasis on modelling as a skill and his bridge between mind and computation.

title: Eigenvectors and eigenvalues | Chapter 14, Essence of linear algebra
title_zh: 特征向量与特征值 | 线性代数的本质 第14章
summary_zh: 3Blue1Brown《线性代数的本质》系列第14章，用可视化建立特征向量和特征值的直觉，说明特征基为何有用，并以一个谜题结尾。
why_zh: HN 多次称其为特征值最直观、最好的解释，也是进入整个线性代数系列的入口。
summary: 3Blue1Brown's chapter on eigenvectors and eigenvalues in the Essence of Linear Algebra series. It builds a visual intuition for what they mean, why an eigenbasis is useful, and ends with a puzzle.
why_hn: HN repeatedly names it the best, most intuitive explanation of eigenvalues, and a gateway to the whole linear algebra series.

title: The Hyperloop: BUSTED!
title_zh: Hyperloop：BUSTED！
summary_zh: 物理学家 Thunderf00t 批判性分析 Hyperloop 概念，讨论真空、压力、安全和成本问题，认为媒体未加质疑就接受了相关说法。
why_zh: HN 多次引用它作为说明 Hyperloop 为何不切实际的最佳怀疑性工程分析。
summary: Thunderf00t, a physicist, critically assesses the Hyperloop concept, covering the vacuum, pressure, safety, and cost problems of high-speed tube travel. He argues the media accepted the claims uncritically.
why_hn: HN repeatedly cites it as the best skeptical engineering analysis of why Hyperloop is impractical.

title: Fasting For Survival Lecture by Dr Pradip Jamnadas
title_zh: Dr Pradip Jamnadas 的《为生存而禁食》讲座
summary_zh: 心脏病学家 Dr. Pradip Jamnadas 在约81分钟讲座中阐述饮食限制和禁食的原理，涉及胰岛素抵抗、葡萄糖不耐受和低碳水饮食。
why_zh: 多位 HN 评论者称它是对禁食和胰岛素最好的解释之一，并在饮食与减重讨论中推荐。
summary: Cardiologist Dr. Pradip Jamnadas lectures on the rationale for dietary restriction and fasting, covering insulin resistance, glucose intolerance, and low-carb eating over about 81 minutes.
why_hn: Several HN commenters call it one of the best explanations of fasting and insulin and recommend it in diet and weight loss threads.

title: Jonathan Blow: Video Games and the Human Condition
title_zh: Jonathan Blow：电子游戏与人类境况
summary_zh: Jonathan Blow 2010 年在 Rice University 的演讲，认为游戏设计师改进技巧的方式可能操纵玩家，如 A/B 测试的社交游戏；他讨论设计者的伦理责任以及游戏除成瘾之外能提供什么。
why_zh: 推荐它作为对成瘾性游戏设计和设计师在构建伦理游戏中的角色的深思批判。
summary: Jonathan Blow's 2010 Rice University talk argues that game designers refine their techniques in ways that can manipulate players, as with A/B-tested social games. He discusses the ethical responsibility of designers and what games can offer beyond addiction.
why_hn: Recommended as a thoughtful critique of addictive game design and the designer's role in building ethical games.

title: Functional architecture - The pits of success - Mark Seemann
title_zh: 函数式架构：成功的坑 - Mark Seemann
summary_zh: Mark Seemann 认为函数式编程天然带来许多面向对象开发者痛苦习得的最佳实践，并展示函数式架构如何以纯核心加不纯外壳把人引入“成功的坑”。
why_zh: 推荐它作为实际演示，说明函数式思维如何改善设计而不会走火入魔。
summary: Mark Seemann argues that functional programming naturally yields many of the best practices object-oriented developers learn painfully. He shows how functional architecture leads to a pit of success, with a pure core and impure shell.
why_hn: Recommended as a practical demonstration of how functional thinking improves design without going off the deep end.

title: Why Is It So Hard to Do Something That Should Be Easy? (Wall of Awful pt. 1)
title_zh: 为什么做一件本该容易的事这么难？（Wall of Awful 第1部分）
summary_zh: How to ADHD 的短片，Brendan Mahan 解释为何简单任务对 ADHD 人群可能像不可能完成，介绍由过往失败、羞耻和焦虑堆积而成的“Wall of Awful”如何挡住行动。
why_zh: HN 评论者把它当作任务瘫痪和拖延的常用名称与解释，并说它帮助自己理解为何回避任务。
summary: A short How to ADHD explainer, featuring Brendan Mahan, on why simple tasks can feel impossible for people with ADHD. It introduces the 'wall of awful', a pile of past failures, shame and anxiety that builds up in front of a task and blocks starting it.
why_hn: HN commenters use it as the go-to name and explanation for task paralysis and procrastination, and say it helped them see why they avoid tasks.

title: Secret History of Silicon Valley
title_zh: 硅谷秘史
summary_zh: Steve Blank 在计算机历史博物馆的演讲认为，硅谷的根源在于二战雷达与电子战、斯坦福的 Fred Terman 以及冷战时期的军方资助，而非仅靠半导体。
why_zh: HN 评论者称它是了解硅谷历史的最佳入门，并在讨论政府对科技的资助时频繁引用。
summary: Steve Blank's Computer History Museum lecture argues that Silicon Valley's roots lie in WWII radar and electronic warfare work, Stanford's Fred Terman and Cold War military funding rather than the semiconductor alone.
why_hn: HN commenters call it a favorite introduction to Valley history and cite it whenever government and military funding of tech comes up.

title: How we fit an NES game into 40 Kilobytes
title_zh: 我们如何把一款 NES 游戏塞进 40 KB
summary_zh: Morphcat Games 讲述如何将内容完整的 NES 游戏 Micro Mages 装进 40 KB，涵盖精灵图、关卡布局压缩等省空间技巧。
why_zh: HN 在讨论老游戏为何那么小时常引用它，视其为 8 位优化与硬件限制下创意的清晰讲解。
summary: Morphcat Games explains how they fit Micro Mages, a full-featured NES game, into 40 kilobytes. It covers compression of sprites and level layouts and other space-saving tricks.
why_hn: HN points to it whenever discussion turns to how old games were so small, as a clear tour of 8-bit optimization and creative work under hardware limits.

title: The Biggest Misconception About Electricity
title_zh: 关于电的最大误解
summary_zh: Veritasium 用一个大型电路思想实验论证，电能由导线周围的场携带，而非由电子在导线中流动输送。
why_zh: 常被推荐为令人大开眼界的场论式电学解释，不过也引发争议，被批评过于咬文嚼字。
summary: Veritasium argues that electric energy is carried by fields around the wires rather than by electrons moving through them, using a thought experiment with a large circuit.
why_hn: Often recommended as an eye-opening field-based explanation of electricity, though it was also controversial and criticized as pedantic.

title: CppCon 2017: Matt Godbolt “What Has My Compiler Done for Me Lately? Unbolting the Compiler's Lid”
title_zh: CppCon 2017：Matt Godbolt《What Has My Compiler Done for Me Lately? Unbolting the Compiler's Lid》
summary_zh: Matt Godbolt 在 CppCon 2017 展示现代编译器如何处理 C++ 代码，借 Compiler Explorer 查看生成的汇编，并介绍出人意料的优化和工具原理。
why_zh: HN 推荐它作为一场有趣又令人惊叹的编译器智慧展示，讲者水平很高。
summary: Matt Godbolt's CppCon 2017 talk shows what modern compilers do with your C++ code, using Compiler Explorer to inspect generated assembly. It covers surprising optimizations and how the tool works.
why_hn: HN recommends it as an entertaining, mind-blowing look at compiler cleverness from a great speaker.
categories: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

title: Jake Archibald on the web browser event loop, setTimeout, micro tasks, requestAnimationFrame, ...
title_zh: Jake Archibald 谈浏览器事件循环、setTimeout、微任务、requestAnimationFrame……
summary_zh: Jake Archibald 的 JSConf.Asia 2018 演讲《In the Loop》讲解浏览器事件循环，涵盖任务、微任务、requestAnimationFrame 以及渲染与 JavaScript 的交错。它用可视化演示说明代码为何以意外顺序执行，以及为何 setTimeout 的修复并不可靠。
why_zh: HN 视其为事件循环的最佳入门，称赞其有趣且易懂的可视化解释。
summary: Jake Archibald's JSConf.Asia 2018 talk "In the Loop" explains the browser event loop, covering tasks, microtasks, requestAnimationFrame, and how rendering interleaves with JavaScript. It uses visual walkthroughs to show why code runs in surprising orders and why setTimeout fixes are unreliable.
why_hn: HN treats it as the best primer on the event loop, praising its entertaining, easy-to-grasp visual explanations.

title: RiftSketch: Live coding in VR with the Oculus Rift, Firefox WebVR, JavaScript and Three.js
title_zh: RiftSketch：用 Oculus Rift、Firefox WebVR、JavaScript 和 Three.js 在 VR 中现场编程
summary_zh: Brian Peiris 演示 RiftSketch：戴上 Oculus Rift，用 JavaScript 和 Three.js 写代码，周围世界会实时变化；它运行在支持 WebVR 的 Firefox 版本上。
why_zh: 屡次被引用为 VR 编程可能形态的激励性演示，有评论者因此买了头显。
summary: Brian Peiris demonstrates RiftSketch, a web app where you write JavaScript with Three.js while wearing an Oculus Rift and watch the world around you change live. It runs on Firefox builds with WebVR.
why_hn: Repeatedly cited as an inspiring demo of what programming in VR could look like, which led some commenters to buy headsets.

title: Joe Armstrong & Alan Kay - Joe Armstrong interviews Alan Kay
title_zh: Joe Armstrong 与 Alan Kay：Joe Armstrong 采访 Alan Kay
summary_zh: Erlang 创造者 Joe Armstrong 在 Code Mesh 采访 Alan Kay，讨论面向对象的含义、消息传递、META II 论文以及计算机科学现状。
why_zh: HN 在讨论 OOP 原意时引用它，因为 Kay 的消息传递观与 Erlang 的进程模型相呼应。
summary: Joe Armstrong, creator of Erlang, interviews Alan Kay at Code Mesh. They discuss the meaning of object orientation, message passing, the META II paper, and the state of computer science.
why_hn: HN uses it in debates about what OOP originally meant, since Kay's message-passing view lines up with Erlang's processes.

title: Co-dfns Live Stream: Compiler Design and Architecture
title_zh: Co-dfns 直播：编译器设计与架构
summary_zh: 两小时直播中，Aaron Hsu 讲解其并行 APL 编译器 Co-dfns 的架构、设计历史与美学，并逐段走查代码及其密集风格背后的思路。
why_zh: HN 读者称它改变了自己对 APL 和数组语言的看法，清晰展示了如何用这种风格编写编译器。
summary: A two-hour live stream in which Aaron Hsu explains the architecture, design history and aesthetic of Co-dfns, his parallel APL compiler. He walks through the code and the reasoning behind its dense style.
why_hn: HN readers say it changed their view of APL and array languages, with a clear walkthrough of how a compiler can be written in this style.

title: Intelligence and Stupidity: The Orthogonality Thesis
title_zh: 智能与愚蠢：正交性论点
summary_zh: Robert Miles 解释正交性论点：一个智能体可以高度智能，却追求在人类看来愚蠢或异质的目标；他把智能与目标分开，并提到集邮者例子。
why_zh: HN 常把它当作解释 AI 为何能理解人类伦理却不认同的标准短讲，也常推荐整个频道。
summary: Robert Miles explains the orthogonality thesis: how an agent can be highly intelligent while pursuing goals that seem stupid or alien to humans. He separates intelligence from goals and touches on the stamp-collector example.
why_hn: HN people use it as the standard short explanation for why AI can understand human ethics without sharing them, and often recommend the whole channel.

title: The best stats you've ever seen | Hans Rosling
title_zh: 你见过的最棒统计数据 | Hans Rosling
summary_zh: Hans Rosling 用 Gapminder 动态数据工具破除关于世界发展的迷思，以体育解说般的激情展示各国健康、收入与儿童存活率的趋势。
why_zh: HN 将其作为世界确实在进步、人们却常误判的经典证据，也是优秀数据呈现的范例。
summary: Hans Rosling uses the Gapminder animated-data tool to debunk myths about world development, with sportscaster-like energy. It shows trends in health, income and child survival across countries.
why_hn: HN invokes it as the classic evidence that the world has improved and that people misjudge it, and as an example of great data presentation.

title: Bryan Cantrill on Jails and Solaris Zones
title_zh: Bryan Cantrill 谈 Jails 与 Solaris Zones
summary_zh: Bryan Cantrill 在 Papers We Love 的演讲梳理 FreeBSD Jails 和 Solaris Zones，追溯操作系统级虚拟化如何从 chroot 和传统 UNIX 安全模型的局限中发展而来。
why_zh: 被反复推荐为讲述容器历史以及 Zones 如何继承并超越 Jails 的最佳材料。
summary: Bryan Cantrill's Papers We Love talk on FreeBSD Jails and Solaris Zones, tracing how OS-level virtualization grew out of chroot and the limits of the traditional UNIX security model.
why_hn: Recommended repeatedly as the best account of container history and how Zones built on and went beyond Jails.

title: Moleman 2 - Demoscene - The Art of the Algorithms (2012)
title_zh: Moleman 2 - Demoscene - 算法的艺术（2012）
summary_zh: Moleman 2 是一部长篇纪录片，讲述 demoscene 从 1980 年代 Commodore 64 文化到现代实时艺术的兴起，并解释 demo 与 intro 背后的算法和创作过程。
why_zh: 每当谈到 demoscene，人们就推荐它作为制作精良、通俗易懂的历史与艺术导览。
summary: Moleman 2 is a feature-length documentary about the demoscene, tracing its rise from 1980s Commodore 64 culture to modern real-time art. It explains the algorithms and creative process behind demos and intros.
why_hn: Recommended whenever the demoscene comes up as a well-made, accessible history and tour of the art form.

title: How to Invent the Future I - Stanford CS183F: Startup School
title_zh: 如何发明未来 I - 斯坦福 CS183F：Startup School
summary_zh: Alan Kay 在斯坦福 Startup School 的讲座回顾他在 Xerox PARC 的职业生涯，谈如何思考发明未来，并梳理 PARC 产出的成果以及公司为何未能利用这些想法。
why_zh: 它是 HN 回答创造力、发现问题与 PARC 历史相关提问时的标准答案，价值在于 Kay 对思考本身的思考。
summary: Alan Kay's Stanford Startup School lecture covers his career at Xerox PARC and how to think about inventing the future. He goes through what came out of PARC and why companies fail to capitalize on such ideas.
why_hn: It is HN's standard answer to questions on creativity, finding problems and PARC history, valued for Kay's thinking about thinking.

title: Dr. Robert Zubrin with a brilliant answer to "Why Should We Go To Mars?"
title_zh: Robert Zubrin 博士精彩回答“我们为什么要去火星？”
summary_zh: 短片剪辑中，《The Case for Mars》作者 Robert Zubrin 博士回答人类为何应去火星。他认为社会通过挑战自我而成长，探索能激励年轻人。
why_zh: HN 评论者反复引用它，作为在地球仍有问题之际为何要去火星的最佳简洁回答。
summary: A short clip of Dr. Robert Zubrin, author of The Case for Mars, answering why humanity should go to Mars. He argues that societies grow by challenging themselves and that exploration inspires young people.
why_hn: HN commenters repeatedly link it as the best concise answer to the question of why go to Mars when problems remain on Earth.

title: Steve Jobs Secrets of Life
title_zh: Steve Jobs 谈人生的秘密
summary_zh: 这是 Steve Jobs 1994 年一段采访的节选。他在其中说，我们周围的一切都是由并不比你更聪明的人创造的，因此你也可以改变并塑造世界。
why_zh: Hacker News 在讨论动力、主观能动性和遗憾的帖子中常引用它，用它提醒人们世界是可以改变的。
summary: A short excerpt from a 1994 interview of Steve Jobs in which he says everything around us was made up by people no smarter than you, and that you can change and shape the world.
why_hn: Quoted in threads on motivation, agency and regret as an encouraging reminder that the world can be changed.

title: OOPSLA Conference: Growing a Language
title_zh: OOPSLA 演讲：让语言成长
summary_zh: 这是 Guy Steele 在 1998 年 OOPSLA 上的经典主题演讲，讲编程语言必须随用户社区一起成长。他采用一种俏皮的方式：一开始只用单音节词，随后边讲边定义新术语。
why_zh: Hacker News 视其为语言设计者的必看演讲，每当讨论语言可扩展性和规模时都会被引用。
summary: Guy Steele's classic 1998 OOPSLA keynote on how a programming language must grow with its user community. He delivers it in a playful style, starting with only monosyllabic words and defining new terms as he goes.
why_hn: Treated as a must-watch for language designers, and cited whenever extensibility and language size are debated.

title: The Fastest Way to Board a Plane Feels Like the Slowest
title_zh: 最快的登机方式，感觉却像是最慢的
summary_zh: CGP Grey 根据一篇 arXiv 论文比较了各种飞机登机方式，说明为什么直觉上的“后排先上”反而最慢，而随机登机或由外向内登机效果更好。
why_zh: 在任何关于登机或下机顺序的讨论中，Hacker News 都默认会引用它，称赞其讲解清晰出色。
summary: CGP Grey compares airplane boarding methods, based on an arXiv paper, and shows why the intuitive back-to-front approach is slow while random or outside-in boarding does better.
why_hn: It is the default link in any thread about boarding or deplaning order, praised as an excellent, clear treatment.

title: DEF CON 22 - Deviant Ollam & Howard Payne - Elevator Hacking - From the Pit to the Penthouse
title_zh: DEF CON 22：Deviant Ollam 与 Howard Payne 讲电梯黑客——从底坑到顶层
summary_zh: Deviant Ollam 和 Howard Payne 在 DEF CON 22 上深入讲解电梯的工作原理，从底坑讲到顶层，涵盖各种控制模式，以及渗透测试人员如何利用电梯绕过楼宇安保。
why_zh: Hacker News 在任何关于电梯或物理安全的讨论中都会提到它，称其是一次既有趣又引人入胜的深度探索。
summary: Deviant Ollam and Howard Payne give an in-depth DEF CON 22 explanation of how elevators work, from the pit to the penthouse. It covers their control modes and how pen testers use elevators to bypass building security.
why_hn: HN brings it up in any thread about elevators or physical security as a fascinating, entertaining deep dive.

title: Why We Won't Raise Our Kids in Suburbia
title_zh: 我们为什么不会在郊区养孩子
summary_zh: Not Just Bikes 认为，依赖汽车的郊区剥夺了孩子的独立性，并将其与荷兰城市中孩子可以独自步行和骑行的环境作了对比。这是作者对早前同主题视频的重制版。
why_zh: 在讨论儿童自主性、直升机式育儿和以汽车为中心的城市规划时，Hacker News 常引用它作为标准参考。
summary: Not Just Bikes argues that car-dependent suburbs rob children of independence, contrasting North American suburbia with Dutch cities where kids walk and bike on their own. It is the creator's remake of an earlier video on the topic.
why_hn: The standard link in threads about child autonomy, helicopter parenting and car-centric planning.

title: "The Hard Parts of Open Source" by Evan Czaplicki
title_zh: Evan Czaplicki 谈“开源中的难题”
summary_zh: Elm 的创造者 Evan Czaplicki 讨论维护开源项目中的难题：线上社区的冲突、这些冲突模式为何出现，以及开源的文化史。他还提出了一些让沟通更文明、更高效的想法。
why_zh: Hacker News 推荐它，认为它深刻揭示了开源维护中人的一面，尤其是在讨论 Elm 和维护者倦怠的帖子中。
summary: Evan Czaplicki, creator of Elm, discusses the hard parts of running an open source project: online community conflict, why its patterns arise, and a cultural history of open source. He offers ideas for more civil, productive communication.
why_hn: HN recommends it as an insightful look at the people side of open source maintenance, especially in Elm and maintainer-burnout threads.

title: 7 Habits For Effective Text Editing 2.0
title_zh: 高效文本编辑的 7 个习惯 2.0
summary_zh: Vim 创造者 Bram Moolenaar 在 2007 年 Google Tech Talk 上讲解高效文本编辑的习惯。他说明如何发现重复和低效的操作，然后利用编辑器功能加以改进。
why_zh: Hacker News 推荐它，认为它提供了一套持续改进编辑流程的持久理念；Moolenaar 去世后，这段演讲被广泛缅怀。
summary: Vim creator Bram Moolenaar's 2007 Google Tech Talk on habits for efficient text editing. He explains how to spot repetition and inefficiency, then use editor features to fix it.
why_hn: HN recommends it as a lasting philosophy for improving your editing process incrementally, and it was widely remembered after Moolenaar's death.

title: Introduction to NoSQL • Martin Fowler • GOTO 2012
title_zh: NoSQL 入门 • Martin Fowler • GOTO 2012
summary_zh: Martin Fowler 在 GOTO 2012 上介绍 NoSQL 数据库：它们的起源、数据模型、一致性思路有何不同，以及何时该使用它们。他认为 NoSQL 不会让关系型数据库过时，并提出了“多语言持久化”的概念。
why_zh: Hacker News 多次推荐它，认为它是关于 SQL 与 NoSQL 的平衡且对初学者友好的综述，一些老师还会布置学生观看。
summary: Martin Fowler's GOTO 2012 introduction to NoSQL databases: where they came from, their data models, how consistency thinking differs, and when to use them. He argues they won't make relational databases obsolete and introduces polyglot persistence.
why_hn: HN repeatedly recommends it as a balanced, beginner-friendly overview of SQL versus NoSQL, and some teachers assign it to students.

title: dotGo 2015 - Rob Pike - Simplicity is Complicated
title_zh: dotGo 2015 - Rob Pike - 简单是复杂的
summary_zh: Rob Pike 在 dotGo 2015 的演讲中提出，Go 只是看起来简单，其简单性背后隐藏着真正复杂的设计考量。他解释了 Go 在功能上保持克制的思路。
why_zh: Hacker News 常回过头引用它，解释 Go 为什么刻意抵制语法糖和新功能。
summary: Rob Pike's dotGo 2015 talk argues that Go only seems simple, and that its simplicity hides real complexity that is part of the design. He explains the thinking behind Go's restraint in features.
why_hn: HN returns to it to explain why Go deliberately resists syntactic sugar and new features.
categories: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

title: [HOPE X] Elevator Hacking: From the Pit to the Penthouse
title_zh: [HOPE X] 电梯黑客：从底坑到顶层
summary_zh: 这是一场 HOPE X 演讲，深入讲解电梯的工作原理，从电梯在黑客文化中的历史，到利用其控制系统绕过楼宇安保。它涵盖了许多大多数人从未见过的电梯特性和能力。
why_zh: Hacker News 的评论者称它是最有趣、信息量最大的大会演讲之一，也是从黑客视角了解电梯的好窗口。
summary: A HOPE X talk giving an in-depth explanation of how elevators work, from their history in hacker culture to using their control systems to bypass building security. It covers features and abilities of elevators that most people never see.
why_hn: HN commenters call it one of the most entertaining and informative con talks, and a good window into elevators from a hacker's view.

title: CppCon 2017: Titus Winters “C++ as a "Live at Head" Language”
title_zh: CppCon 2017：Titus Winters 谈“C++ 作为‘Live at Head’语言”
summary_zh: Titus Winters 在 CppCon 2017 的演讲主张，C++ 和 Google 的 Abseil 应作为“live at head”语言来维护，依靠测试和自动化工具，而不是永不改变或承诺完全兼容。演讲涉及海勒姆定律和语义化版本控制的局限。
why_zh: 每当讨论版本管理、semver、单体仓库和向后兼容性时，Hacker News 都会推荐它，因为其中对依赖关系有细致入微的论述。
summary: Titus Winters' CppCon 2017 talk argues for C++ and Google's Abseil to be maintained as a live at head language, relying on testing and automated tooling rather than never changing or promising no compatibility. It covers Hyrum's law and the limits of semantic versioning.
why_hn: Recommended whenever versioning, semver, monorepos and backward compatibility are debated, for its nuanced treatment of dependencies.
categories: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

title: Start with why -- how great leaders inspire action | Simon Sinek | TEDxPugetSound
title_zh: 从“为什么”开始——伟大的领导者如何激励行动 | Simon Sinek | TEDxPugetSound
summary_zh: Simon Sinek 在这场 TEDx 演讲中提出，伟大的领导者和公司会先传达自己“为什么”做某事，再谈“怎么做”和“做什么”，从而激励行动。他以 Apple 为主要例子。
why_zh: Hacker News 推荐它，认为它是快速了解《从“为什么”开始》核心思想、用于推销和沟通的好材料，不过也有人指出小公司并不是 Apple。
summary: Simon Sinek's TEDx talk arguing that great leaders and companies inspire action by communicating why they do something before how or what. He uses Apple as his main example.
why_hn: Recommended as a quick way to get the core of 'Start with Why' for pitches and communication, though some note small companies are not Apple.

title: Tensorflow and deep learning - without a PhD by Martin Görner
title_zh: Martin Görner 讲 TensorFlow 与深度学习——无需博士学位
summary_zh: Martin Gorner 在 Devoxx 的演讲介绍如何使用 TensorFlow 进行深度学习，带领观众用神经网络处理 MNIST，讲解如何选择架构，以及如何诊断训练失败的神经网络。
why_zh: Hacker News 多次称其为出色的实用入门，两小时内覆盖大量内容，并讲到了学术教科书常忽略的问题。
summary: Martin Gorner's Devoxx talk introduces deep learning with TensorFlow, walking through neural networks for MNIST, how to choose an architecture and how to diagnose networks that fail to train.
why_hn: Repeatedly called an excellent, practical introduction that covers a lot in two hours and explains issues academic textbooks skip.

title: How does a USB keyboard work?
title_zh: USB 键盘是如何工作的？
summary_zh: Ben Eater 讲解 USB 键盘的通信原理，涵盖电气接口、比特与数据包编码、数据包内容，并与 PS/2 进行对比。
why_zh: Hacker News 的评论者推荐它，认为它清晰而全面地解释了 USB 信号传输和键盘轮询。
summary: Ben Eater explains how a USB keyboard communicates, covering the electrical interface, bit and packet encoding, packet contents, and a comparison with PS/2.
why_hn: HN commenters recommend it as a clear, comprehensive explanation of USB signaling and keyboard polling.

title: Data Brokers: Last Week Tonight with John Oliver (HBO)
title_zh: 数据经纪人：John Oliver 的《上周今夜秀》（HBO）
summary_zh: John Oliver 在《上周今夜秀》中解释数据经纪人如何收集并出售个人信息，还设计了一个环节：他的团队购买数据，从而识别出国会议员。
why_zh: Hacker News 在讨论隐私时推荐它，认为它是了解数据经纪人行业的通俗综述。
summary: John Oliver's Last Week Tonight segment explains how data brokers collect and sell personal information, including a stunt in which his team bought data to identify members of Congress.
why_hn: HN recommends it as an accessible overview of the data broker industry in privacy discussions.

title: Life in life
title_zh: 生命中的生命：Conway 生命游戏套娃
summary_zh: 这段两分钟视频用 OTCA 元像素和 Golly 构建出 Conway 生命游戏在自身内部运行的画面，镜头在不同尺度间平滑缩放。
why_zh: 它是嵌套模拟、图灵完备与自指性的经典视觉展示，HN 读者称其震撼并反复引用。
summary: A two-minute video of Conway's Game of Life running inside Conway's Game of Life, built from OTCA metapixels and Golly. It zooms smoothly between scales.
why_hn: The canonical visual for nested simulation, Turing completeness and self-reference; HN readers call it mind-blowing and reach for it constantly.

title: The Epidemic of Fake Disease
title_zh: 假病的流行病：过度诊断与过度筛查
summary_zh: 心脏病医生 Rohin Francis 在 Medlife Crisis 视频中讨论过度诊断与过度筛查，解释发现更多疾病未必意味着拯救更多生命，并涉及不必要治疗的危害。
why_zh: 在癌症筛查、PSA 检测、全身 MRI 和消费级诊断等讨论中，它常被用来解释为何更多检测反而可能有害。
summary: A Medlife Crisis video by cardiologist Rohin Francis on overdiagnosis and over-screening. It explains how detecting more disease does not necessarily mean saving more lives, and covers harms such as unnecessary treatment.
why_hn: Pointed to in threads about cancer screening, PSA tests, full-body MRIs and consumer diagnostics as an explanation of why more testing can hurt.

title: What Languages Sound Like To Foreigners
title_zh: 外语听起来是什么样
summary_zh: 芬兰 YouTuber Saara 即兴编造无意义音节，模仿各种语言在不熟悉者耳中的听感；这些句子大多是虚构的，视频曾走红。
why_zh: HN 常把它当作惊人模仿口音、以假乱真“假语言”的典型例子。
summary: Finnish YouTuber Saara improvises gibberish that mimics how various languages sound to people who do not speak them. The sentences are mostly made up, and the clip went viral.
why_hn: HN points to it as a favorite example of astonishing accent mimicry and fake-language gibberish that sounds real.

title: James Burke Connections, Ep. 4 "Faith in Numbers"
title_zh: James Burke《Connections》第4集：Faith in Numbers
summary_zh: 《Connections》第四集追溯商业主义、气候变化和黑死病如何推动文艺复兴，并沿水力、印刷机、Jacquard 织机和 Hollerith 打孔卡等线索通向现代计算。
why_zh: HN 评论者强烈推荐，因为它讲述了 Jacquard 织机和打孔卡如何引向计算机。
summary: Episode 4 of James Burke's Connections series, tracing how commercialism, climate change and the Black Death shaped the move to the Renaissance. It follows threads through waterpower, the printing press, the Jacquard loom and the Hollerith punch card toward modern computing.
why_hn: HN commenters strongly recommend it for its account of how the Jacquard loom and punch cards led to computers.

title: Adriano Celentano - Prisencolinensinainciusol
title_zh: Adriano Celentano - Prisencolinensinainciusol
summary_zh: 这是 Adriano Celentano 1972 年的歌曲，歌词是无意义音节，刻意让非英语母语者听起来像美式英语；它是一首带摇滚和说唱风味的新奇曲目，并有音乐视频。
why_zh: 每当讨论假语言、口音或听起来像真语言的胡言乱语时它就会被提起，评论者喜欢分享给没听过的人。
summary: A 1972 song by Adriano Celentano whose lyrics are nonsense syllables designed to sound like American English to non-English speakers. It is a rock and rap-flavored novelty track with a video.
why_hn: It comes up whenever threads touch on fake languages, accents, or gibberish that sounds plausible, and commenters like sharing it with people who haven't heard it.

title: Google I/O 2009 - The Myth of the Genius Programmer
title_zh: Google I/O 2009：天才程序员的神话
summary_zh: Brian Fitzpatrick 和 Ben Collins-Sussman 认为“天才程序员”理想有害于协作，主张放下自我、尽早分享工作，并理解工具如何塑造社交行为。
why_zh: HN 老用户推荐它为塑造职业观的演讲，涉及代码审查、谦逊与协作开发。
summary: Brian Fitzpatrick and Ben Collins-Sussman argue that the 'genius programmer' ideal harms collaboration. They advocate trading ego for growth, sharing work early, and understanding how tools shape social behavior.
why_hn: HN regulars recommend it as a career-shaping talk on code review, humility and collaborative development.

title: Emacs + org-mode + python in reproducible research; SciPy 2013 Presentation
title_zh: 在可复现研究中使用 Emacs + org-mode + Python；SciPy 2013 演讲
summary_zh: John Kitchin 展示如何用 Emacs org-mode 和 Python 将叙述、数学、图表与可执行代码合并在同一文档中，可导出到 LaTeX、HTML 和 PDF；他用它写过论文和电子书。
why_zh: 它被反复推荐为 org-mode 用于文学编程和可复现研究的经典演示。
summary: John Kitchin shows how Emacs org-mode with Python lets researchers combine narrative, math, figures and executable code in one document. It exports to LaTeX, HTML and PDF, and he used it for papers and e-books.
why_hn: Repeatedly recommended as the canonical demo of org-mode for literate programming and reproducible research.

title: FarewellEtaoinShrdlu
title_zh: 告别 Etaoin Shrdlu
summary_zh: 这部纪录片记录 1978 年《纽约时报》最后一天用 Linotype 排字机印刷报纸，从新闻编辑室一路跟到印刷机，标志向计算机排版的转变。
why_zh: 常被推荐为对热金属排字和 Linotype 时代终结的引人入胜的记录。
summary: A documentary on the last day the New York Times was printed with linotype machines in 1978, following the process from the newsroom to the press. It marks the move to computerized typesetting.
why_hn: Frequently recommended as an absorbing look at hot-metal typesetting and the end of the linotype era.

title: Captain Disillusion: World's Greatest Blenderer - Live at the Blender Conference 2018
title_zh: Captain Disillusion：世界最伟大的 Blender 用户——Blender Conference 2018 现场
summary_zh: Captain Disillusion 在 2018 年 Blender Conference 上的喜剧演讲，讲述他如何用 Blender 作为其 VFX 辟谣网络系列的制作工具；既是案例研究，也是写给 Blender 社区的情书。
why_zh: HN 推荐它为一档有趣且鼓舞人心的 Blender 演讲，常在学 Blender 的讨论中被链接。
summary: Captain Disillusion's comedic talk at the 2018 Blender Conference recounts how he uses Blender as a production tool for his VFX-debunking web series. It is part case study and part love letter to the Blender community.
why_hn: HN recommends it as an entertaining and inspiring Blender talk, and often links it in threads about learning Blender.

title: Watch electricity hit a fork in the road at half a billion frames per second
title_zh: 看电在每秒五亿帧下遇到岔路
summary_zh: AlphaPhoenix 用自制高速测量装置观察电压波沿导线传播并在分叉处分流，回答电如何知道该往哪走以及这一过程有多快。
why_zh: 被誉为对传输线、阻抗和信号传播最清晰的视觉解释，多位评论者说它让一切豁然开朗。
summary: AlphaPhoenix uses a custom high-speed measurement setup to watch voltage waves travel down wires and split at a fork. It answers how electricity knows where to go and how quickly that process happens.
why_hn: Praised as the clearest visual explanation of transmission lines, impedance and signal propagation, with several commenters saying it made it all click.

title: Competition is for Losers with Peter Thiel (How to Start a Startup 2014: 5)
title_zh: Peter Thiel：竞争是给失败者的（How to Start a Startup 2014 第5讲）
summary_zh: Peter Thiel 在 How to Start a Startup 课程中讲商业战略与垄断理论，主张竞争摧毁利润、创业公司应追求建立垄断，涵盖《从0到1》中的观点。
why_zh: HN 推荐它为一堂关于市场规模和垄断的有影响力严肃演讲，但也有评论者批评其哲学是在鼓吹反竞争目标。
summary: Peter Thiel's lecture from the How to Start a Startup course on business strategy and monopoly theory, arguing that competition destroys profits and that startups should aim to build monopolies. It covers the ideas of Zero to One.
why_hn: HN recommends it as a serious, influential talk on market size and monopoly, though some commenters criticize its philosophy as endorsing anti-competitive goals.

title: Lambda Calculus - Fundamentals of Lambda Calculus & Functional Programming in JavaScript
title_zh: Lambda 演算：Lambda 演算与 JavaScript 函数式编程基础
summary_zh: Gabriel Lebec 在 Fullstack Academy 的演讲用 JavaScript 介绍 Lambda 演算语法、数理逻辑历史和函数式编程精髓，也涵盖组合子、柯里化和 Church 编码。
why_zh: 被反复推荐为最平易近人的 Lambda 演算与组合子入门之一。
summary: Gabriel Lebec's Fullstack Academy talk introduces lambda calculus syntax, the history of mathematical logic, and the essence of functional programming using JavaScript. It also covers combinators, currying and Church encodings.
why_hn: Repeatedly recommended as one of the most approachable introductions to lambda calculus and combinators.

title: I Tried To Make Something In America (The Smarter Scrubber Experiment) - Smarter Every Day 308
title_zh: 我试着在美国造点东西（更聪明的刷子实验）——Smarter Every Day 308
summary_zh: Smarter Every Day 的 Destin Sandlin 尝试完全在美国制造一把烧烤刷，过程中遭遇供应链缺失、模具和机构性制造知识的断层。
why_zh: HN 在美国制造业辩论中经常引用它，生动展示国内工业能力流失了多少。
summary: Destin Sandlin of Smarter Every Day tries to manufacture a grill scrubber entirely in the United States. Along the way he runs into missing supply chains, tooling and institutional manufacturing knowledge.
why_hn: HN cites it constantly in US manufacturing debates as a vivid demonstration of how much domestic industrial capability has been lost.

title: 4 2 1 Christopher Domas   The future of RE Dynamic Binary Visualization
title_zh: Christopher Domas：逆向工程的未来——动态二进制可视化
summary_zh: Christopher Domas 在 Derbycon 2012 介绍其 Cantor Dust 工具，通过对二进制结构进行动态可视化，提供一种 3D 逆向工程方法。
why_zh: 被视为史上最酷的演讲之一，其未来感十足的二进制可视化演示启发了后来的工具。
summary: Christopher Domas presents his Cantor Dust tool at Derbycon 2012, a 3D visual approach to reverse engineering binaries by visualizing their structure dynamically.
why_hn: Regarded as one of the coolest talks ever, with a futuristic binary visualization demo that has inspired later tools.

title: The REAL Possibility of Mapping Alien Planets!
title_zh: 绘制系外行星地图的真实可能性
summary_zh: PBS Space Time 介绍利用太阳引力作为巨型透镜的设想：向约 550 AU 外的焦点发送一列小型光帆航天器，并讨论这种望远镜如何以惊人细节成像系外行星及工程挑战。
why_zh: 每当讨论系外行星成像或太阳引力透镜望远镜时，它就是首选解释。
summary: PBS Space Time explains the proposal to use the Sun's gravity as a giant lens, sending a train of small light-sail spacecraft to the focal point roughly 550 AU out. It covers how such a telescope could image exoplanets in surprising detail and the engineering challenges involved.
why_hn: It is the go-to explanation whenever a thread touches on imaging exoplanets or solar gravitational lens telescopes.

title: The Great Global Warming Swindle Full Movie
title_zh: 《全球变暖大骗局》完整影片
summary_zh: 这是 Martin Durkin 于 2007 年为英国 Channel 4 制作的纪录片，主张人为造成的全球变暖被夸大、甚至是一场骗局，片中还请来 Richard Lindzen 等持异见的科学家，用太阳黑子和宇宙射线解释气温变化。其观点已被主流气候科学界否定。
why_zh: 在 Hacker News 上，怀疑气候变化的评论者把它当作反对 CO2 共识的证据，另一些人则把它视为气候否认论的典型样本。
summary: A 2007 Channel 4 documentary by Martin Durkin arguing that human-caused global warming is overstated or a scam. It features contrarian scientists such as Richard Lindzen and promotes sunspot and cosmic-ray explanations for temperature change. Its claims are rejected by mainstream climate science.
why_hn: Climate-skeptic commenters link it as evidence against the CO2 consensus, while others cite it as an example of climate-change denial.

title: All the Numbers - Numberphile
title_zh: 所有的数——Numberphile
summary_zh: Matt Parker 在 Numberphile 节目中讲解代数数、超越数、可计算数、正规数等各类数，并说明我们真正能命名或描述的数其实少得可怜。
why_zh: HN 推荐它，因为它通俗地解释了数的分类，以及为什么几乎所有的数都无法被我们认识。
summary: Matt Parker talks Numberphile through the different kinds of numbers: algebraic, transcendental, computable, normal, and beyond. It shows how few numbers we can actually name or describe.
why_hn: HN recommends it as an accessible explanation of number categories and why almost all numbers are unknowable.

title: The Expert Myth
title_zh: 专家神话
summary_zh: Veritasium 借助国际象棋研究以及 Klein 与 Kahneman 的工作，探讨哪些专家才真正具备专业能力。结论是：专长来自在规则有效、反馈充分的环境中刻意练习所形成的模式识别能力。
why_zh: 在关于学习、一万小时定律和刻意练习的讨论中常被推荐，被认为更清晰地说明了专长如何形成。
summary: Veritasium examines which experts have real expertise, drawing on chess research and work by Klein and Kahneman. It explains that expertise comes from pattern recognition built through deliberate practice in valid, feedback-rich environments.
why_hn: Frequently recommended in threads on learning, the 10,000 hours rule and deliberate practice as a clearer account of how expertise develops.

title: "Transducers" by Rich Hickey
title_zh: Rich Hickey 讲“Transducers”
summary_zh: Rich Hickey 介绍 Clojure 中的 transducer：它让 map、filter 等算法与数据源解耦，并可自由组合。这样，在序列、channel 和 stream 上就不必重复实现这些算法，也不会产生中间集合。
why_zh: HN 视其为 transducer 的原始且权威讲解，每当这个概念被提起就会被推荐。
summary: Rich Hickey introduces transducers in Clojure, a way to make map, filter and similar algorithms composable independent of the data source. This avoids duplicated implementations and intermediate collections across sequences, channels and streams.
why_hn: HN treats it as the original and definitive explanation of transducers, recommended whenever the concept comes up.

title: David Kriesel: Traue keinem Scan, den du nicht selbst gefälscht hast
title_zh: David Kriesel：别相信你没亲手造假的扫描件
summary_zh: 这是 David Kriesel 在 31C3 的德语演讲，讲述他发现 Xerox 扫描复印机会悄悄替换扫描文档中的数字和字母，并解释这个 bug 为何能在现实中潜伏多年。
why_zh: 它被称为 CCC（混沌通信大会）的经典演讲；其中涉及的 Xerox 的 bug 常被当作“别轻信扫描件和数字化档案”的警示案例。
summary: David Kriesel's 31C3 talk, in German, on the discovery that Xerox scanner-copiers silently replace digits and letters in scanned documents. He explains how the bug stayed unnoticed in the wild for years.
why_hn: Called a classic CCC talk, and the Xerox bug is cited as a cautionary tale about trusting scans and digitized archives.

title: Hewitt, Meijer and Szyperski: The Actor Model (everything you wanted to know...)
title_zh: Hewitt、Meijer 与 Szyperski：Actor 模型（你想知道的一切）
summary_zh: 这是 Lang.NEXT 2012 上 Carl Hewitt、Erik Meijer 与 Clemens Szyperski 围绕 actor 模型展开的白板对谈，由模型提出者 Hewitt 亲自讲解其基础。
why_zh: HN 认为这是了解 actor 模型的最佳入门视频，而且出自发明者本人；Hewitt 去世后，它又被重新提起。
summary: A standing whiteboard conversation at Lang.NEXT 2012 among Carl Hewitt, Erik Meijer and Clemens Szyperski about the actor model. Hewitt, who originated the model, explains its foundations.
why_hn: HN recommends it as the best video introduction to the actor model, straight from its inventor, and revisited it after Hewitt's death.

title: The Intense 8 Hour Hunt | Attenborough Life of Mammals | BBC Earth
title_zh: 八小时极限追逐 | Attenborough《哺乳动物的生活》| BBC Earth
summary_zh: Attenborough 的《哺乳动物的生活》片段，跟随卡拉哈里沙漠的一位 San 部落猎人进行长达八小时的耐力狩猎，在酷热中把一头 kudu 追到力竭，展现了追踪、耐力跑以及猎杀后猎人的反应。
why_zh: 在关于人类耐力跑与演化的讨论中，HN 反复把它当作耐力狩猎的经典影像资料。
summary: A clip from Attenborough's Life of Mammals following a San tribesman in the Kalahari on an eight-hour persistence hunt, running down a kudu through harsh heat. It shows tracking, endurance running and the hunter's reaction after the kill.
why_hn: HN returns to it as the canonical footage of persistence hunting in threads about human endurance running and evolution.

title: How to sound smart in your TEDx Talk | Will Stephen | TEDxNewYork
title_zh: 如何在 TEDx 演讲中显得很聪明 | Will Stephen | TEDxNewYork
summary_zh: Will Stephen 用六分钟的幽默 TEDx 演讲，展示各种演讲技巧：如何几乎什么都没说，却让人听起来才华横溢。
why_zh: HN 推荐它，认为它用搞笑方式拆解了 TED 演讲套路，是“形式远大于内容”的绝佳范例。
summary: Will Stephen's humorous six-minute TEDx talk shows presentation techniques that make you sound brilliant while saying essentially nothing.
why_hn: HN recommends it as a funny deconstruction of TED talk style, and as a favorite example of the appearance of meaning without content.

title: Containers From Scratch • Liz Rice • GOTO 2018
title_zh: 从零实现容器 • Liz Rice • GOTO 2018
summary_zh: Liz Rice 在 GOTO Amsterdam 2018 上用几行 Go 现场写了一个最小容器运行时，并讲解 namespace、cgroup 以及宿主机对容器的可见程度。
why_zh: HN 认为这是从底层理解容器工作原理的最佳演讲之一。
summary: Liz Rice live-codes a minimal container runtime in a few lines of Go at GOTO Amsterdam 2018. She explains namespaces, control groups and what a host knows about its containers.
why_hn: HN considers it one of the best talks for understanding how containers work from the ground up.
categories: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

title: I Like Notebooks
title_zh: 我喜欢 Notebook
summary_zh: Jeremy Howard 为 Jupyter notebook 辩护，认为配合 nbdev 使用时它是严肃的开发环境；他正面回应 Joel Grus 批评 notebook 的演讲，并对比 REPL 式与 notebook 式的工作方式。
why_zh: 每当 notebook 遭到批评，HN 评论者就会搬出它，作为知名实践者的标准反驳。
summary: Jeremy Howard defends Jupyter notebooks as a serious development environment, especially when paired with nbdev. He responds directly to Joel Grus's talk about why he dislikes notebooks, and contrasts REPL-style and notebook-style work.
why_hn: Whenever notebooks get criticized, HN commenters point to it as the standard rebuttal from a prominent practitioner.

title: Gabe Brown: Keys To Building a Healthy Soil
title_zh: Gabe Brown：打造健康土壤的关键
summary_zh: 农场主 Gabe Brown 讲述他如何靠免耕、覆盖作物和放牧动物重建自家牧场的土壤。演讲录制于 2014 年爱达荷州的一场可持续农业研讨会。
why_zh: HN 读者把它当作再生农业有说服力的亲身案例来分享，尤其提到其中关于土壤有机质、产量和减少化肥的说法。
summary: Farmer Gabe Brown talks about how he rebuilt the soil on his ranch using no-till farming, cover crops, and grazing animals. The talk was recorded at a sustainable agriculture symposium in Idaho in 2014.
why_hn: HN readers share it as a persuasive, first-hand account of regenerative agriculture, citing its claims about soil organic matter, yields and reduced fertilizer use.

title: How Much Do Rockets Pollute? Are They Bad For Our Air?
title_zh: 火箭污染有多大？对我们的空气有害吗？
summary_zh: Everyday Astronaut 的 Tim Dodd 用一小时的数据分析，讲解火箭究竟排放什么、与客机和其它行业相比如何；他按推进剂类型、人均与总量拆解排放，并探讨让发射更清洁的可能。
why_zh: 每当有人担忧火箭发射的污染时，HN 评论者都会引用它来反驳，因为它显示发射相对其它污染源只是很小一部分。
summary: Everyday Astronaut's Tim Dodd runs an hour-long, data-driven analysis of what rockets actually emit and how that compares with airliners and other industries. It breaks down exhaust by propellant type, per-passenger and total emissions, and ways launches could be cleaner.
why_hn: HN commenters cite it whenever rocket launch pollution comes up as a rebuttal to alarm, since it shows launches are small next to other sources.

title: A CONSERVATIVE solution to global warming (Part 1)
title_zh: 一个“保守派”的全球变暖解决方案（上）
summary_zh: Potholer54 陈述气候科学依据，并提出一套市场导向、保守派易于接受的应对全球变暖方案，附有来源列表；本片为两集系列的第一集。
why_zh: HN 用户推荐它，认为它示范了如何向保守派和自由意志主义者科普气候科学而不引起抵触。
summary: Potholer54 presents the climate science case and a market-oriented, conservative-friendly approach to addressing global warming, with sources listed. It is part one of a two-part series.
why_hn: HN users recommend it as a model of communicating climate science to conservative and libertarian audiences without alienating them.

title: "Why Zebras Don't Get Ulcers: Stress and Health" by Dr. Robert Sapolsky
title_zh: Robert Sapolsky 博士：“为什么斑马不得胃溃疡：压力与健康”
summary_zh: Sapolsky 讲解人体的应激反应本为应对短期物理性危机而演化，一旦被心理压力源持续触发，就会损害长期健康。此讲是首届 Fenton-Rhodes 讲座。
why_zh: HN 评论者推荐它，认为它既有趣又翔实地解释了压力如何影响健康。
summary: Robert Sapolsky's lecture on how the body's stress response, evolved for short-term physical emergencies, harms long-term health when triggered by psychological stressors. It was given as the inaugural Fenton-Rhodes Lecture.
why_hn: HN commenters recommend it as an entertaining and informative explanation of how stress affects health.

title: The Clean Architecture in Python
title_zh: Python 中的整洁架构
summary_zh: Brandon Rhodes 在 PyOhio 2014 的演讲，讲如何在 Python 中应用 Clean Architecture，说明这一高层设计模式如何契合 Python 特性，并解决大型应用中的可维护性问题。
why_zh: HN 指出它提供了把业务逻辑与 I/O 分离的实用方法，能减少 mock，也是“函数式内核、命令式外壳”思想的基础。
summary: Brandon Rhodes' PyOhio 2014 talk on applying the Clean Architecture in Python. He shows how this high-level design pattern fits Python's features and addresses maintainability problems in large applications.
why_hn: HN points to it as a practical way to separate business logic from I/O, which reduces mocking and underlies the functional core, imperative shell idea.

title: Brains, Sex, and Machine Learning
title_zh: 大脑、性与机器学习
summary_zh: Geoffrey Hinton 的 Google Tech Talk，把机器学习与生物学联系起来，解释 dropout 作为一种模型平均，并探讨有性生殖和随机脉冲神经元为何可能有助于防止过拟合。
why_zh: 被推荐为对 dropout 及其与大脑工作方式联系的一次简洁优雅的讲解。
summary: Geoffrey Hinton's Google Tech Talk linking machine learning to biology, explaining dropout as a form of model averaging and why sexual reproduction and stochastic spiking neurons may prevent overfitting.
why_hn: Recommended as a simple, elegant explanation of dropout and its connection to how the brain works.

title: 30 Weird Chess Algorithms: Elo World
title_zh: 30 种奇葩国际象棋算法：Elo World
summary_zh: Tom7 以 Tom Scott 式荒诞风格展示 SIGBOVIK 的国际象棋项目：用 30 种古怪算法举办锦标赛，给一个不辨颜色和棋子的国际象棋程序打分，涉及镜像、算术编码、扭曲的博弈树搜索和被稀释的 Stockfish。
why_zh: HN 评论者称其冷面幽默和极其繁复的工程令人必看，并从中获得用随机走法稀释强引擎等想法。
summary: Tom Scott-style absurdist tour by Tom7 of SIGBOVIK chess projects: a tournament of 30 weird chess algorithms used to rate a color- and piece-blind chess program. Topics include mirrors, arithmetic encoding, perverted game tree search and a diluted Stockfish.
why_hn: HN commenters call it a must-watch for its deadpan, absurdly elaborate engineering and cite it for ideas like diluting strong engines with random moves.

title: The Future is a Dead Mall - Decentraland and the Metaverse
title_zh: 未来是一座死商场——Decentraland 与元宇宙
summary_zh: Folding Ideas 的 Dan Olson 在虚拟世界 Decentraland 里待了数月，对元宇宙、NFT 和 DAO 展开长篇批判，并解释虚拟世界为何难以成为真正的场所。
why_zh: 被视为对元宇宙炒作和 Decentraland 生态的权威性拆解。
summary: Dan Olson of Folding Ideas spends months in the virtual world Decentraland and delivers a long critique of the metaverse, NFTs and DAOs, and why virtual worlds fail as places.
why_hn: Regarded as the definitive takedown of the metaverse hype and the Decentraland ecosystem.

title: Notation Must Die: The Battle For How We Read Music
title_zh: 记谱法必须死：我们如何读乐的争夺战
summary_zh: Tantacrul 用 76 分钟深入梳理西方音乐记谱法的历史及众多替代方案，如钢琴卷帘、彩色音符和 jubilate，并解释为何它们都没能取代现有体系。
why_zh: 被反复推荐为解释记谱法改革为何失败、现有体系做了哪些权衡的最权威且制作精良的视频。
summary: Tantacrul's 76-minute deep dive into the history of western music notation and the many proposed replacements, such as piano rolls, colored notes and the jubilate. He explains why none have displaced the current system.
why_hn: Repeatedly recommended as the definitive, well-made explanation of why attempts to reinvent music notation fail and what tradeoffs the current system makes.

title: How Big is Graham's Number? (feat Ron Graham)
title_zh: Graham's Number 有多大？（嘉宾 Ron Graham）
summary_zh: Numberphile 与数学家 Ron Graham 对谈，从箭头记号一路构建，展示 Graham's number 大到何种不可思议的程度；这是该主题系列视频之一。
why_zh: HN 用户推荐它，因为能听到 Graham 本人讲解，并且清晰介绍了上箭头记号和巨大数。
summary: Numberphile talks with mathematician Ron Graham about the magnitude of Graham's number, building up from arrow notation to show how impossibly large it is. It is part of a series of videos on this number.
why_hn: HN commenters recommend it for hearing Graham himself and for its clear introduction to up-arrow notation and enormous numbers.

title: Dr. Gabor Maté — Trauma, Addiction, Ayahuasca, and More
title_zh: Gabor Maté 博士——创伤、成瘾、死藤水及其他
summary_zh: Tim Ferriss 的长篇播客访谈，医生 Gabor Maté 谈创伤、成瘾、抑郁、ADHD 和死藤水，解释童年压力与情感痛苦如何成为许多成瘾和疾病的底层原因。
why_zh: HN 推荐它作为对成瘾和抑郁成因的深刻而诚实的探讨，也是比多数访谈更深入的 Maté 访谈。
summary: A long Tim Ferriss podcast interview with physician Gabor Mate on trauma, addiction, depression, ADHD and ayahuasca. Mate explains how childhood stress and emotional pain underlie many addictions and illnesses.
why_hn: HN recommends it as a thoughtful, honest look at the causes of addiction and depression, and as a deeper Mate interview than most.

title: The Man Who Accidentally Killed The Most People In History
title_zh: 历史上无意间杀死最多人的人
summary_zh: Veritasium 讲述 Thomas Midgley Jr. 的故事：他引入了含铅汽油和 CFC，视频还涵盖铅暴露与臭氧破坏背后的科学，并涉及用于揭示这段历史的同位素地球化学。
why_zh: 每当讨论含铅燃料、有毒化学品或企业逐利动机时 HN 都会推荐它，称赞其叙事和通俗易懂的科学。
summary: Veritasium tells the story of Thomas Midgley Jr., who introduced leaded gasoline and CFCs, and covers the science behind lead exposure and ozone damage. It also touches on isotope geochemistry used to uncover the history.
why_hn: HN commenters recommend it whenever leaded fuel, toxic chemicals or corporate profit motives come up, praising its storytelling and accessible science.

title: Evil Mode: Or, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Emacs
title_zh: Evil Mode：或者，我如何学会停止担忧并爱上 Emacs
summary_zh: 长期使用 Vim 的 Aaron Bieber 讲述他尝试 Emacs 加 evil mode 的经历，涵盖他的发现、他怀念的 Vim 功能，以及 Vim 可以从 Emacs 借鉴之处。
why_zh: HN 推荐给考虑转用 Emacs 的 Vim 用户，不少人说它说服了自己或同事切换。
summary: Aaron Bieber, a longtime Vim user, describes his experience trying Emacs with evil mode. He covers what he found, what he missed from Vim, and what Vim could borrow from Emacs.
why_hn: HN recommends it to Vim users considering Emacs, and several say it persuaded them or their coworkers to switch.

title: How Differential Gear works (BEST Tutorial)
title_zh: 差速器如何工作（最佳教程）
summary_zh: 一部 1930 年代 Chevrolet 培训影片，从第一性原理一步步讲解差速器的原理与发展，直到完整机构。
why_zh: HN 喜爱它，视其为老派教学影片的典范，用清晰简单的语言把差速器工作原理讲得完全易懂。
summary: A 1930s Chevrolet training film explaining the principles and development of the differential gear. It builds the idea step by step from first principles to the finished mechanism.
why_hn: HN loves it as an example of old-school instructional film that makes how a differential works fully understandable in clear, simple language.

title: User-level threads....... with threads. - Paul Turner - Google
title_zh: 用户级线程……用线程实现——Google 的 Paul Turner
summary_zh: Google 的 Paul Turner 介绍用于真实线程用户级调度的内核接口，目标是在 C++、Java、Go 和 Python 之间提供统一的同步编程模型；演讲介绍了 Google fibers 背后的 switchto 风格系统调用。
why_zh: HN 引用它作为合作式、用户调度内核线程的关键解释，以及后来异步与协程争论背后的先例。
summary: Paul Turner of Google presents kernel interfaces for user-level scheduling of real threads, aiming at a uniform synchronous programming model across C++, Java, Go and Python. It introduces the switchto-style system calls behind Google's fibers.
why_hn: HN cites it as the key explanation of cooperative, user-scheduled kernel threads and the prior art behind later async and coroutine debates.

title: Interactive programming Flappy Bird in ClojureScript
title_zh: 用 ClojureScript 交互式编写 Flappy Bird
summary_zh: Bruce Hauman 在大约六分钟内用 ClojureScript 现场编写 Flappy Bird，借助 figwheel 把改动热重载进运行中的游戏，展示无需重启即可交互式改变游戏行为。
why_zh: 它是 HN 人们在谈实时交互式开发和热重载时引用的经典演示，证明这套工作流真实可行而非花架子。
summary: Bruce Hauman live-codes Flappy Bird in ClojureScript in about six minutes, using figwheel to hot-reload changes into the running game. The demo shows game behavior being changed interactively without restarting.
why_hn: It is the canonical demo HN people cite for live interactive development and hot reloading, as proof the workflow is real and not smoke and mirrors.

title: You are being misled about renewable energy technology.
title_zh: 你被可再生能源技术误导了
summary_zh: Technology Connections 的长视频主张公众对可再生能源的理解被扭曲，讨论太阳能经济性、与乙醇玉米相比的土地利用，以及钴等电池迷思。
why_zh: HN 反复推荐它作为关于太阳能和电池的最新、以事实为依据的论述，读者可据此引用土地利用和成本问题。
summary: A long Technology Connections video arguing that public understanding of renewable energy is distorted. It covers solar economics, land use compared with ethanol corn, and battery myths such as cobalt.
why_hn: HN repeatedly recommends it as an up-to-date, fact-focused case for solar and batteries that readers can cite on land use and costs.

title: Orbital Rings
title_zh: 轨道环
summary_zh: Isaac Arthur 讲解轨道环——一种巨型结构发射辅助系统，可低成本把大宗货物送入轨道及更远处；他将其与太空电梯比较并讨论电力传输。
why_zh: HN 评论者认为它可能是低成本进入太空的未来方案，且无需奇异材料即可实现。
summary: Isaac Arthur explains the orbital ring, a megastructure launch-assist system that could move bulk cargo cheaply to orbit and beyond. He compares it with space elevators and discusses power transmission.
why_hn: HN commenters offer it as the likely future of cheap access to space, feasible without exotic materials.

title: The more general uncertainty principle, regarding Fourier transforms
title_zh: 更一般的不确定性原理：关于傅里叶变换
summary_zh: 3Blue1Brown 展示不确定性原理如何从傅里叶变换中产生：波包不可能在位置和频率上都很窄，因此该原理是波本身的属性，而非测量所致。
why_zh: HN 推荐它作为最清晰的视觉解释，说明不确定性内在于波，与测量扰动无关。
summary: 3Blue1Brown shows how the uncertainty principle arises from Fourier transforms. A wave packet cannot be narrow in both position and frequency, so the principle is a property of waves rather than of measurement.
why_hn: HN recommends it as the clearest visual explanation that uncertainty is intrinsic to waves, separate from measurement disturbance.

title: Building The World's First Computer - Greeks, Clocks and Rockets - Antikythera Mechanism Episode 1
title_zh: 打造世界第一台计算机：希腊人、钟表与火箭——Antikythera Mechanism 第一集
summary_zh: Clickspring 系列第一集，讲述手工复刻 Antikythera Mechanism 的计划与历史背景。系列记录一位机械师用传统工具和方法建造这台古希腊装置。
why_zh: HN 反复推荐该系列，因为它展现了非凡的手工技艺，并可信地演示了该装置可能的制造方式。
summary: The first episode of Clickspring's series on reproducing the Antikythera Mechanism by hand, laying out the plan and the history. The series follows a machinist building the ancient Greek device with traditional tools and methods.
why_hn: HN repeatedly recommends the series for its extraordinary craftsmanship and its credible demonstration of how the mechanism could have been made.

title: Build a real-time Twitter clone in 15 minutes with LiveView and Phoenix 1.5
title_zh: 用 LiveView 和 Phoenix 1.5 在 15 分钟内构建实时 Twitter 克隆
summary_zh: Phoenix 作者 Chris McCord 用 Phoenix LiveView 1.5 现场构建一个实时 Twitter 风格应用，约 15 分钟完成。演示展示了不写 JavaScript 也能实现交互式实时更新。
why_zh: HN 把它作为展示 LiveView 与 Elixir 为何值得一试的演示推荐给读者。
summary: Phoenix creator Chris McCord builds a real-time Twitter-style app live with Phoenix LiveView 1.5 in about 15 minutes. It shows interactive, real-time updates without writing JavaScript.
why_hn: HN points people to it as the demo that shows why LiveView and Elixir are worth a look.

title: 38C3 - From Silicon to Sovereignty: How Advanced Chips are Redefining Global Dominance
title_zh: 38C3：从硅到主权——先进芯片如何重新定义全球主导权
summary_zh: 一场 38C3 演讲，围绕 EUV 光刻及背后的全球供应链，讲解先进芯片如何制造。内容涵盖从原材料到成品芯片的技术挑战，以及半导体的地缘政治分量。
why_zh: HN 用户推荐它，认为它出色且通俗地概述了现代芯片如何生产以及 EUV 为何重要。
summary: A 38C3 talk on how advanced chips are made, centered on EUV lithography and the global supply chain behind it. It covers technical challenges from raw materials to finished chips and the geopolitical weight of semiconductors.
why_hn: HN users recommend it as an excellent, accessible overview of how modern chips are produced and why EUV matters.

title: 2016 - On The Shoulders Of Giants - Damian Conway
title_zh: 2016 — On The Shoulders Of Giants — Damian Conway
summary_zh: Damian Conway 在 Perl 大会上的约一小时主题演讲，借历史、算法和用语法构建的量子数学运算符展示 Perl 6（Raku）特性。演讲充满喜剧风格。
why_zh: HN 推荐它，认为这是一场有趣且技术精湛的 Perl 6 能力展示。
channel: The Perl and Raku Conference - Greenville, SC 2026
summary: Damian Conway's hour-long keynote at the Perl conference, On the Shoulders of Giants, showing off Perl 6 (Raku) features with history, algorithms and a quantum math operator built with grammars. It is delivered with comic flair.
why_hn: HN recommends it as an entertaining, technically masterful showcase of what Perl 6 can do.

title: CppCon 2015: Greg Law " Give me 15 minutes & I'll change your view of GDB"
title_zh: CppCon 2015：Greg Law “给我 15 分钟，我会改变你对 GDB 的看法”
summary_zh: Greg Law 在 CppCon 2015 的 15 分钟闪电演讲中，展示 GDB 超越基础用法的一面，包括文本用户界面和反向调试。适合只用过 IDE 调试器的人。
why_zh: 推荐它作为对 GDB TUI 模式和冷门功能的快速而出色的入门。
summary: Greg Law's 15-minute CppCon 2015 lightning talk shows what GDB can do beyond basic use, including its text user interface and reverse debugging.
why_hn: Recommended as a fast, brilliant introduction to GDB's TUI mode and lesser-known features, useful for anyone who has only used IDE debuggers.
categories: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

title: Jack Szostak (Harvard/HHMI) Part 1: The Origin of Cellular Life on Earth
title_zh: Jack Szostak（Harvard/HHMI）第一部分：地球细胞生命的起源
summary_zh: Jack Szostak 的讲座讨论早期地球上的化学如何可能产生细胞生命，并从银河系其他地方存在生命的概率谈起。这是关于原始细胞与 RNA 世界系列的一部分。
why_zh: 推荐它作为关于可信生命起源理论的清晰、权威讲座系列。
summary: Jack Szostak's lecture covers how cellular life could have arisen from chemistry on the early Earth, starting from the odds of life elsewhere in the galaxy. It is part of a series on protocells and the RNA world.
why_hn: Recommended as a clear, authoritative lecture series on plausible origin-of-life theories.

title: Feynman: Magnets (and Why?)  FUN TO IMAGINE  4/ higher quality version!
title_zh: Feynman：磁铁（以及为什么？）——FUN TO IMAGINE 4/ 更高画质版！
summary_zh: 1983 年 BBC 采访中，Richard Feynman 被问及磁铁如何工作，并解释为何“为什么”类问题很难用日常语言回答。他反思什么才算解释，以及类比有哪些局限。
why_zh: HN 一再提到它，视其为智识诚实与优秀解释的典范，常在讨论“为什么”问题和科学传播时引用。
summary: A 1983 BBC interview in which Richard Feynman is asked how magnets work and explains why 'why' questions are hard to answer in everyday terms. He reflects on what counts as an explanation and the limits of analogy.
why_hn: HN returns to it as a model of intellectual honesty and good explanation, often linking it in discussions of why-questions and science communication.

title: JPEG DCT, Discrete Cosine Transform (JPEG Pt2)- Computerphile
title_zh: JPEG 的 DCT：离散余弦变换（JPEG 第二集）——Computerphile
summary_zh: Mike Pound 讲解离散余弦变换，以及它如何支撑 JPEG 压缩。这是 Computerphile JPEG 系列的第二集。
why_zh: HN 推荐它作为 DCT 的轻松清晰入门，有评论者说终于看懂了。
summary: Mike Pound explains the discrete cosine transform and how it underpins JPEG compression. It is part two of Computerphile's JPEG series.
why_hn: HN recommends it as an easy, clear intro to the DCT that finally made it click for several commenters.

title: Old-fashioned rice cookers are extremely clever
title_zh: 老式电饭煲其实非常聪明
summary_zh: Technology Connections 解释老式非电子电饭煲如何工作：利用磁铁和由居里点触发的弹簧开关。它展示了一个简单电器背后的热力学与磁学。
why_zh: HN 推荐它，称其愉快地拆解了“笨”家电中的巧思，也是进入该频道的好入口。
summary: Technology Connections explains how old-fashioned non-electronic rice cookers work, using a magnet and spring switch tripped by the Curie point. It shows the thermodynamics and magnetism behind a simple appliance.
why_hn: HN recommends it as a delightful breakdown of the cleverness in dumb appliances and an entry point to the channel.

title: BlueHat IL 2019 - Andrew "bunnie" Huang - Supply Chain Security: "If I were a Nation State...”
