title_zh: BlueHat IL 2019 — Andrew “bunnie” Huang — 供应链安全：“如果我是一个民族国家……”
summary_zh: Andrew “bunnie” Huang 在 Bloomberg Businessweek 报道之后，探讨从内部人员到民族国家的硬件供应链攻击有多现实。他解释未记录组件如何被藏在电路板上，以及为何难以发现。
why_zh: HN 用户指出它是对硬件供应链安全的冷静、技术扎实且令人大开眼界的描绘。
summary: Andrew "bunnie" Huang examines how realistic hardware supply chain attacks are, from rogue insiders to nation states, in the wake of the Bloomberg Businessweek report. He explains how undocumented components could be hidden on boards and how hard they are to spot.
why_hn: HN people point to it as the sober, technically grounded picture of hardware supply chain security, and an eye-opening one.

title: golden balls. the weirdest split or steal ever!
title_zh: Golden Balls：史上最奇怪的 Split or Steal！
summary_zh: 一期 Golden Balls 节目中，一名选手宣布自己会选“偷”，却在分钱或偷钱的囚徒困境里引出意外结局。
why_zh: 它是博弈论讨论中操纵囚徒困境的经典真实案例。
summary: A Golden Balls episode in which one contestant announces he will steal, leading to an unexpected outcome in the split-or-steal prisoner's dilemma.
why_hn: The canonical real-world example in game theory discussions of manipulating a prisoner's dilemma.

title: DOOM: Behind the Music
title_zh: DOOM：音乐背后的故事
summary_zh: Mick Gordon 在 GDC 2017 讲述《Doom》（2016）配乐创作。他详述作曲流程、制作技巧，以及音乐背后的实验性乐器与合成器设计。
why_zh: HN 盛赞它是最佳会议演讲之一，展示了一位大师的创作过程与声音设计。
summary: Mick Gordon's GDC 2017 session on composing the Doom (2016) soundtrack. He details his compositional process, production techniques and the experimental instrument and synth design behind the music.
why_hn: HN raves about it as one of the best conference talks, showing a master's creative process and sound design.

title: Great Earthquakes of the Pacific Northwest
title_zh: 太平洋西北地区的特大地震
summary_zh: Central Washington University 地质学家 Nick Zentner 进行一场约一小时的公开讲座，主题是太平洋西北地区的特大地震，包括 Cascadia 俯冲带和过去巨震的证据。这是 2016 年在 Ellensburg 录制的 Downtown Geology Lecture Series 的一部分。
why_zh: HN 评论者推荐它，认为它平实但引人入胜、不炒作地介绍了 Cascadia 地震风险及历史事件证据。
summary: Geologist Nick Zentner of Central Washington University gives an hour-long public lecture on the great earthquakes of the Pacific Northwest, including the Cascadia subduction zone and the evidence for past megaquakes. It is part of his Downtown Geology Lecture Series, recorded in Ellensburg in 2016.
why_hn: HN commenters offer it as a dry but fascinating, hype-free introduction to Cascadia earthquake risk and the evidence for past events.

title: In Search of Tomorrow
title_zh: In Search of Tomorrow（寻找明天）
summary_zh: Light Table 与 Eve 语言创造者 Chris Granger 在 Berkeley 数据科学讲座中，谈十年后计算与编程可能是什么样。他回顾通向 Eve 的路径，并以演示收尾。
why_zh: HN 一再推荐它，视其为面向非程序员的编程愿景，也是理解 Eve 动机的背景材料。
summary: Chris Granger, creator of Light Table and the Eve language, gives a Berkeley data science lecture on what computation and programming might look like in ten years. He covers the path that led to Eve and ends with demos.
why_hn: HN keeps pointing to it as a thoughtful vision of programming for non-programmers and as background on Eve's motivations.

title: Coding Adventure: Ant and Slime Simulations
title_zh: Coding Adventure：蚂蚁与黏菌模拟
summary_zh: Sebastian Lague 探索一种受蚂蚁启发的算法，并用计算着色器模拟蚂蚁与黏菌行为。两个模拟的源代码均可获取。
why_zh: HN 推荐它，认为它是简单规则与计算着色器能产生何等美丽结果的范例，许多评论者受到启发。
summary: Sebastian Lague explores an ant-inspired algorithm and simulates ant and slime mold behavior, using compute shaders. Source code for both simulations is available.
why_hn: HN recommends it as a beautiful example of what simple rules and compute shaders can produce, and many commenters were inspired by it.

title: A New Car UI: How touch screen controls in cars should work
title_zh: 新的汽车 UI：车载触摸屏控制应该怎样工作
summary_zh: Matthaeus Krenn 提出一种车载触摸屏 UI 概念：屏幕一次只控制一件事，专为驾驶场景设计。短演示配有平板原型。
why_zh: 在汽车触摸屏争论中，它常被引用为优雅、合理且不分散注意力的替代方案。
summary: Matthaeus Krenn presents a concept for car touchscreen UI where the screen controls only one thing at a time, designed to suit driving. A tablet prototype accompanies the short demo.
why_hn: Repeatedly cited in car touchscreen debates as an elegant, sensible alternative to distracting automotive UIs.

title: Fourier Optics used for Optical Pattern Recognition
title_zh: 用傅里叶光学实现光学模式识别
summary_zh: Huygens Optics 讲解傅里叶变换，并演示透镜如何以光学方式完成这一变换；他还用一台 DLP 投影仪充当傅里叶滤波器，对光刻字符图形做简单的模式识别。
why_zh: 被推荐为傅里叶变换最出色的讲解之一，同时清楚展示了模拟光学计算的实际效果。
summary: Huygens Optics explains the Fourier transform and shows how a lens performs one optically. A DLP projector is used as a Fourier filter to do simple pattern recognition on lithographic character patterns.
why_hn: Recommended as one of the best explanations of Fourier transforms and a clear demo of analog optical computing.

title: Rich Hickey rants about HttpServletRequest in 1080p: Death By Specificity from Clojure Made Simple
title_zh: Rich Hickey 1080p 吐槽 HttpServletRequest：Clojure Made Simple 中的「死于过度具体」
summary_zh: 这是 Rich Hickey 在 Clojure Made Simple 演讲中约五分钟的片段（配有新幻灯片），他痛批 HttpServletRequest 这类过度具体的 API，主张用通用 map 取代大量具体的类和 getter。
why_zh: 在讨论数据建模与面向对象时，常被引为「用 map 还是用对象」之争的经典吐槽。
summary: A five-minute excerpt of Rich Hickey's Clojure Made Simple talk, with new slides, ranting about HttpServletRequest and specificity. He argues for using generic maps instead of many specific classes and getters.
why_hn: Cited as the classic rant on maps versus objects in discussions of data modeling and OOP.

title: Bret Victor - The Humane Representation of Thought
title_zh: Bret Victor：思想的人性化表达
summary_zh: 这是 Bret Victor 在 UIST 与 SPLASH 2014 的闭幕演讲，他认为我们用于思考的工具忽略了人类大部分的感官与运动能力，并勾勒出超越屏幕与键盘、调动更多感官的表达方式。
why_zh: HN 视之为 Bret Victor 的奠基性演讲，常与 Dynamicland 一同被引用，重塑了人们对软件与界面的想象。
summary: Bret Victor's closing keynote at UIST and SPLASH 2014 argues that our tools for thinking ignore most of human sensory and motor capability. He sketches representations that engage more modalities beyond screens and keyboards.
why_hn: HN treats it as a foundational Bret Victor talk that reshaped how people think about software and interfaces, often cited alongside Dynamicland.

title: Visualizing the 4d numbers Quaternions
title_zh: 可视化四维数：四元数
summary_zh: 3Blue1Brown 借助球极投影与三维空间中的旋转，帮观众建立对四元数这一四维数系的直观理解；本集是两集系列的第一部分，配有互动网站。
why_zh: HN 评论者称其为四元数最好的可视化讲解，也是理解高维的良好入口。
summary: 3Blue1Brown builds visual intuition for quaternions, showing how to think about this four-dimensional number system using stereographic projection and rotations in 3D space. It is part one of a two-part series with an interactive companion site.
why_hn: HN commenters recommend it as the best visual explanation of quaternions and a good way to visualize higher dimensions.

title: Pythagoras' theorem (a) | Math History | NJ Wildberger
title_zh: 勾股定理（上）｜数学史｜NJ Wildberger
summary_zh: N J Wildberger 数学史课程的第一讲，从勾股定理讲起，沿 Stillwell 的教材展开，重在思想脉络而非证明细节。
why_zh: 被推荐为一门轻松易跟的数学史课程，能帮人建立对这门学科的整体视野。
summary: The first lecture of N J Wildberger's History of Mathematics course, starting with Pythagoras' theorem and following Stillwell's text. It emphasizes the flow of ideas over proofs.
why_hn: Recommended as an easy-to-follow math history course that gives perspective on the subject.

title: How Valve is Profiting from Steam's Back-Door Casinos
title_zh: Valve 如何从 Steam 的「后门赌场」中获利
summary_zh: People Make Games 调查了缺乏监管的 CS:GO 皮肤赌博生态以及 Valve 在其中的角色，采访了损失惨重的当事人，并追问 Valve 为何不出手干预。
why_zh: HN 称赞这是对皮肤赌博（尤其对未成年人的影响）调查扎实的报道，在赌博与 Valve 相关讨论中常被引用。
summary: People Make Games investigates the unregulated CS:GO skin gambling economy and Valve's role in it. It includes interviews with people who lost large sums and examines why Valve does not intervene.
why_hn: HN recommends it as well-researched reporting on skin gambling, especially its effect on minors, in threads about gambling and Valve.

title: Do Chairs Exist?
title_zh: 椅子存在吗？
summary_zh: Vsauce 用约 38 分钟，从形而上学、分体论与对象分类的哲学出发，探讨椅子到底存不存在，并引用相关学术研究。
why_zh: HN 推荐它为我们如何定义和分类事物的一场有趣巡游，每当讨论概念边界时都会被提起。
summary: A Vsauce video exploring whether chairs exist, through metaphysics, mereology and the philosophy of categorizing objects. It runs about 38 minutes and cites academic work on ontology.
why_hn: HN recommends it as an entertaining tour of how we define and categorize things, and it is cited when concept boundaries come up.

title: Civil War General-Purpose Computing | Cory Doctorow | Talks at Google
title_zh: 围绕通用计算的内战｜Cory Doctorow｜Talks at Google
summary_zh: Cory Doctorow 在 Talks at Google 的演讲，论述围绕通用计算的「内战」即将到来：锁定设备、DRM 与监控正在侵蚀用户对计算机的掌控权。
why_zh: 每当设备锁定、DRM 或限制安装软件的话题出现，它都是 HN 的首选参考资料，评论者常感叹其预见性。
summary: Cory Doctorow's Talks at Google lecture on the coming civil war over general-purpose computing. He argues that locked-down devices, DRM, and surveillance threaten user control of computers.
why_hn: It is HN's go-to reference whenever device lockdown, DRM, or restrictions on installing software come up, with commenters noting how prescient it was.

title: Robust-first computing: Demon Horde Sort (full version)
title_zh: Robust-first 计算：恶魔军团排序（完整版）
summary_zh: Dave Ackley 演示在他的 Movable Feast Machine 模拟器中运行的 Demon Horde Sort，这是一台天生具备鲁棒性的排序机；本片为包含全部细节与随想的未剪辑版。
why_zh: HN 读者推荐它作为 robust-first 计算的最佳入门，这种架构把随机性与容错直接内建其中。
summary: Dave Ackley demonstrates the Demon Horde Sort, an inherently robust sorting machine running in his Movable Feast Machine simulator. This is the uncut version with all details and side thoughts.
why_hn: HN readers recommend it as the best introduction to robust-first computing, where randomness and fault tolerance are built into the architecture.

title: Why can't you multiply vectors?
title_zh: 为什么向量不能相乘？
summary_zh: Freya Holmer 在 Dutch Game Day 2023 的演讲：从复数出发，追问向量为何无法相乘，经由一条公理最终抵达几何代数、四元数与多重向量。
why_zh: HN 认为它是几何代数的最佳入门，也是直观理解四元数的一条路径。
summary: Freya Holmer's Dutch Game Day 2023 talk asking why vectors can't be multiplied, building from complex numbers to a single axiom and arriving at geometric algebra, quaternions and multivectors.
why_hn: HN treats it as the best entry point to geometric algebra and an intuitive route to understanding quaternions.

title: DjangoCon 2008 Keynote: Cal Henderson
title_zh: DjangoCon 2008 主题演讲：Cal Henderson
summary_zh: Cal Henderson 在 DjangoCon 2008 的演讲《Why I Hate Django》，以 Flickr 架构师的身份对 Django 做了一番妙趣横生的吐槽，也涉及数据库复制等扩展性话题。
why_zh: 被推荐为一场精彩又爆笑的演讲，虽然教育意义不算最强。
summary: Cal Henderson's DjangoCon 2008 keynote, "Why I Hate Django", is a funny critique of Django from a Flickr architect. It touches on scaling topics such as database replication.
why_hn: Recommended as a brilliant, hilarious talk, though not the most educational.

title: The IOU Machine: How Currency Is Created | Hidden Secrets of Money Ep. 4
title_zh: IOU 机器：货币是如何被创造出来的｜Hidden Secrets of Money 第 4 集
summary_zh: Mike Maloney 系列第 4 集，用财政部、银行与美联储之间层层欠条（IOU）的链条解释货币如何被创造，涉及债券、美联储支票、债务、税收与部分准备金放贷，视角带有金银本位倾向。
why_zh: 常在比特币与货币相关讨论中被推荐，是对美国货币体系运作的清晰入门，尽管立场明显偏向黄金。
summary: Episode 4 of Mike Maloney's Hidden Secrets of Money, explaining how currency is created through a chain of IOUs among the Treasury, banks and the Federal Reserve. It covers bonds, Fed checks, debt, taxes and fractional reserve lending, from a gold-and-silver advocate's viewpoint.
why_hn: Recommended, often in Bitcoin and monetary threads, as a clear introduction to how the US money system works, though it comes with a strong goldbug slant.

title: We're building a dystopia just to make people click on ads | Zeynep Tufekci
title_zh: 我们正在为了让人点广告而建造反乌托邦｜Zeynep Tufekci
summary_zh: 技术社会学家 Zeynep Tufekci 指出，用于投放广告的机器学习系统同时决定了人们看到哪些政治与社会信息，并解释不透明的算法如何诱导、细分和操纵用户。她警告真正的危险是权贵用 AI 控制大众。
why_zh: 每当算法推荐流、微定向投放或广告基础设施被讨论，HN 评论者都会引用它，视其为关于算法放大效应的通俗警示。
summary: Technosociologist Zeynep Tufekci argues that the machine-learning systems used to serve ads also decide what political and social information people see. She explains how opaque algorithms can nudge, segment and manipulate users, and warns that the real danger is powerful people using AI to control populations.
why_hn: HN commenters cite it whenever engagement-optimizing feeds, micro-targeting or ad infrastructure come up, as an accessible warning about algorithmic amplification.

title: George Hotz: Comma.ai, OpenPilot, and Autonomous Vehicles | Lex Fridman Podcast #31
title_zh: George Hotz：Comma.ai、openpilot 与自动驾驶｜Lex Fridman 播客 #31
summary_zh: Lex Fridman 与 Comma.ai 创始人 George Hotz 的两小时对话，聊 openpilot、自动驾驶，以及 Hotz 对 AI 与技术的看法。
why_zh: HN 推荐它，是因为 Hotz 关于摄像头与激光雷达之争的推理，以及这位有主见、思路独到的实践者对 comma 与 openpilot 的整体介绍。
summary: Lex Fridman's two-hour podcast with George Hotz, founder of Comma.ai, covering openpilot, autonomous driving and Hotz's views on AI and technology.
why_hn: HN recommends it for Hotz's reasoning on cameras versus lidar and for an opinionated, original thinker's overview of comma and openpilot.

title: Zipline - How Rwanda Built A Drone Delivery Service
title_zh: Zipline：卢旺达如何建起无人机配送服务
summary_zh: Real Engineering 讲解 Zipline 如何在卢旺达搭建医疗物资无人机配送网络，涵盖固定翼无人机、弹射起飞、降落伞投放以及背后的物流体系。
why_zh: HN 认为它是对 Zipline 整套系统运作方式的最佳讲解，也是无人机真正做实事的一个范例。
summary: Real Engineering explains how Zipline built a drone delivery network for medical supplies in Rwanda. It covers the fixed-wing drones, catapult launch, parachute drop and the logistics behind the service.
why_hn: HN points to it as the best explanation of how Zipline's whole system works and as an example of drones doing real, useful work.

title: These Stupid Trucks are Literally Killing Us
title_zh: 这些愚蠢的卡车正在实实在在地害死我们
summary_zh: Not Just Bikes 讲述了 SUV 和轻型卡车在尺寸与销量占比上的增长，以及这对行人、骑行者和城市生活为何危险。他还介绍了燃油经济性规则和“鸡肉税”等偏向这类车型的监管漏洞。
why_zh: 每当 HN 讨论车辆尺寸，它就是默认链接；评论者推荐它来了解轻型卡车监管漏洞的历史和高保险杠的安全影响。
summary: Not Just Bikes explains how SUVs and light trucks have grown in size and share of US sales, and why that is dangerous for pedestrians, cyclists and city life. He covers the regulatory loopholes, such as fuel economy rules and the chicken tax, that favored them.
why_hn: It is HN's default link whenever vehicle size comes up, with commenters recommending it for the history of the light-truck loophole and the safety effects of tall bumpers.

title: Ramanujan: Making sense of 1+2+3+... = -1/12 and Co.
title_zh: Ramanujan：如何理解 1+2+3+... = -1/12 及其同类
summary_zh: Mathologer 从 Ramanujan 1913 年写给 Hardy 的信出发，考察 1+2+3+... = -1/12 这类等式如何在 Ramanujan 的工作中出现。视频解释了无穷级数求和的规则，以及这些结果为何有意义但并非朴素求和。
why_zh: 它被推荐为对 -1/12 说法严谨而诚实的处理，常被认为优于更花哨的视频。
summary: Mathologer examines how identities like 1+2+3+... = -1/12 arise in Ramanujan's work, starting from his 1913 letter to Hardy. The video explains the rules for summing infinite series and why such results are meaningful but not naive sums.
why_hn: Recommended as a careful, honest treatment of the -1/12 claim, often preferred over flashier videos.

title: Robocalypse Now: Using Deep Learning to Combat Cheating in Counter-Strike: Global Offensive
title_zh: Robocalypse Now：用深度学习打击《CS:GO》中的作弊
summary_zh: Valve 的 John McDonald 在 GDC 2018 介绍 Valve 如何用深度学习（VACnet）检测《CS:GO》作弊者。他讲述了基于人工复核录像的训练方式，以及模型输出如何由人工审查确认。
why_zh: 它是任何反作弊讨论中的首选链接，具体而精彩地讲述了生产环境中的机器学习作弊检测。
summary: Valve's John McDonald presents at GDC 2018 on how Valve uses deep learning (VACnet) to detect cheaters in Counter-Strike: Global Offensive. He covers training on human-reviewed replays and how model output is confirmed by manual review.
why_hn: The go-to link in any anti-cheat thread for a concrete, well-delivered account of machine-learning cheat detection in production.

title: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Multiple Dispatch | Stefan Karpinski | JuliaCon 2019
title_zh: 多重分派的非凡有效性 | Stefan Karpinski | JuliaCon 2019
summary_zh: Julia 联合创造者 Stefan Karpinski 解释为何多重分派能让 Julia 代码和类型以极低摩擦跨包复用。内容涵盖共享基础类型和共享泛型算法。
why_zh: HN 评论者推荐它作为语言设计者本人对多重分派为何支撑 Julia 可组合性的权威解释。
summary: Julia co-creator Stefan Karpinski explains why multiple dispatch makes Julia code and types reusable across packages with so little friction. He covers sharing basic types and sharing generic algorithms.
why_hn: HN commenters recommend it as the definitive explanation, from a language designer, of why multiple dispatch makes Julia's composability work.

title: Stevey's Tech Talk E39 -- A guided tour of Emacs
title_zh: Stevey's Tech Talk E39——Emacs 导览
summary_zh: Steve Yegge 录下自己在 Emacs 中工作的过程，在约 45 分钟的屏幕录制里展示了十几个功能。这不是结构化教程，而是非正式且充满热情的导览。
why_zh: HN 用户推荐它作为面向新人和怀疑者的出色且有说服力的 Emacs 概览，展示者显然深爱它。
summary: Steve Yegge records himself working in Emacs and shows off about a dozen features in a roughly 45-minute screen capture. It is an informal, enthusiastic tour rather than a structured tutorial.
why_hn: HN people recommend it as an excellent, convincing overview of Emacs for newcomers and skeptics, shown by someone who clearly loves it.

title: CGA Graphics - Not as bad as you thought!
title_zh: CGA 图形——没有你想的那么糟！
summary_zh: 8-Bit Guy 介绍 IBM 1981 年的 CGA 图形系统，包括复合输出和伪影如何产生超出标称调色板的额外颜色。他认为 CGA 在当年的显示器上比在 RGB 显示器上更好看。
why_zh: HN 推荐它来展示老一代开发者如何利用复合信号的模糊特性，以及 CGA 在当年硬件上的真实观感。
summary: The 8-Bit Guy covers IBM's 1981 CGA graphics system, including how composite output and artifacting produced extra colors beyond the nominal palette. He argues CGA looked better in period than it does on RGB monitors.
why_hn: HN recommends it for showing how old developers exploited the smeary nature of composite signals and what CGA really looked like on period hardware.

title: Evan Czaplicki - Let's be mainstream! User focused design in Elm - Curry On
title_zh: Evan Czaplicki——让我们成为主流！Elm 中以用户为中心的设计——Curry On
summary_zh: Elm 创造者 Evan Czaplicki 在 Curry On 2015 谈以用户为中心的语言设计。他解释了 Elm 背后的原则，以及如何让函数式类型语言像 JavaScript 一样易上手。
why_zh: 它被推荐为对 Elm 设计思路和让函数式语言主流化的最清晰解释，其中还有广为流传的 monad 讲解片段。
summary: Evan Czaplicki, creator of Elm, talks at Curry On 2015 about user-focused language design. He explains the principles behind Elm and how to make a functional, typed language as approachable as JavaScript.
why_hn: Recommended as the clearest explanation of Elm's design thinking and of making functional languages mainstream, plus a popular monad explanation clip.

title: Visualization of Quantum Physics (Quantum Mechanics)
title_zh: 量子物理可视化（量子力学）
summary_zh: 视频用自由粒子对基础量子力学进行动画可视化，模拟基于真实方程。内容涵盖波、粒子以及测量如何使波函数坍缩。
why_zh: HN 评论者称它是波、粒子与测量关系的最佳视觉解释之一，没有愚蠢的比喻。
summary: An animated visualization of basic quantum mechanics using a free particle, with simulations based on the actual equations. It covers waves, particles, and how measurement collapses the wavefunction.
why_hn: HN commenters call it one of the best visual explanations of the wave, particle and measurement relationship, free of silly metaphors.

title: Amiga Hardware Programming 1 - Use the Assembler and wait for left click
title_zh: Amiga 硬件编程 1——使用汇编器并等待左键点击
summary_zh: 这是 Photon of Scoopex 的 Amiga 硬件编程系列第一集，演示如何设置汇编器并编写一个等待鼠标左键点击的最小 68000 程序。
why_zh: 它被推荐为进入 Amiga demo 和 68000 汇编编程的平易起点。
summary: The first video in Photon of Scoopex's Amiga hardware programming series. It shows how to set up an assembler and write a minimal 68000 program that waits for a left mouse click.
why_hn: Recommended as an approachable start to Amiga demo and 68000 assembly programming.

title: Pulling Power from the Sky: The Story of Makani [Feature Film]
title_zh: 从天空取电：Makani 的故事 [长片]
summary_zh: Makani 团队的长片记录了他们 13 年建造风力发电风筝的努力，包含夏威夷、加州和挪威测试场的画面。影片展现了工程、团队以及最终关停。
why_zh: HN 推荐它作为一部技术丰富、制作精美的纪录片，讲述雄心勃勃的硬件工程与失败。
summary: A feature-length film by the Makani team chronicling their thirteen-year effort to build energy kites that harvest wind power, with footage from test sites in Hawaii, California and Norway. It shows the engineering, the team and the eventual shutdown.
why_hn: HN recommends it as a technically rich, beautifully made documentary on ambitious hardware engineering and failure.

title: Can You Watch This Without Getting Angry?
title_zh: 你能看完这个而不生气吗？
summary_zh: CGP Grey 借用关于网络内容为何病毒式传播的研究，解释思想如何像病菌一样传播，以及触发愤怒的内容为何传播最快。他认为相互对立的愤怒驱动模因会彼此喂养。
why_zh: HN 在社交媒体、极化和愤怒的讨论中不断引用它，视其为愤怒内容为何胜出的经典解释。
summary: CGP Grey explains how ideas spread like germs, and why content that triggers outrage spreads fastest, using a study on what makes online content viral. He argues that opposing outrage-driven memes feed each other.
why_hn: HN links it constantly in threads on social media, polarization and outrage as the canonical explanation of why angry content wins.

title: The Biggest Myth In Education
title_zh: 教育中最大的迷思
summary_zh: Veritasium 通过采访 Daniel Willingham 和一项记忆实验，驳斥“视觉型学习者”等学习风格观念。它主张多模态方法对所有人都有帮助。
why_zh: 每当有人声称自己是视觉型学习者或提到学习风格时，它就是标准链接，简介中列出了来源。
summary: Veritasium debunks the idea of learning styles, such as being a visual learner, with an interview with Daniel Willingham and a memory experiment. It argues that a multimodal approach helps everyone.
why_hn: The standard link whenever someone claims to be a visual learner or learning styles come up, with sources listed in the description.

title: Alex Evans at Umbra Ignite 2015: Learning From Failure
title_zh: Alex Evans 在 Umbra Ignite 2015：从失败中学习
summary_zh: Media Molecule 的 Alex Evans 基于其 Siggraph 2015 演讲，回顾寻找 Dreams 引擎的旅程与失败。内容涵盖有向距离场和 splat 渲染方法及其背后的艺术目标。
why_zh: HN 称它是关于 SDF 渲染的鼓舞人心的必看之作，也是图形程序员最爱的技术演讲之一。
summary: Media Molecule's Alex Evans recounts the journey, including the failures, of finding the Dreams engine, based on his Siggraph 2015 talk. It covers the signed-distance-field and splat-based rendering approach and the artistic goals behind it.
why_hn: HN calls it an inspirational must-see on SDF rendering and a favorite tech talk for graphics programmers.

title: Old pinball machines are amazingly complex
title_zh: 老式弹珠机复杂得惊人
summary_zh: Technology Connections 详细长谈 1970 年代机电式弹珠机如何工作，从继电器到步进电机和机械逻辑。这是系列的第一部分。
why_zh: HN 推荐它作为深入展示，说明在没有计算机的情况下如何构建复杂逻辑。
summary: Technology Connections takes a long, detailed look at how a 1970s electromechanical pinball machine works, from relays to stepper motors and mechanical logic. It is the first part of a series.
why_hn: HN points people to it as a deep dive showing how complex logic was built without computers.

title: Bryan Cranston's Advice to Aspiring Actors
title_zh: Bryan Cranston 给有志演员的建议
summary_zh: 这是一段一分钟短片，Bryan Cranston 在学院新会员招待会上建议演员不要带着绝望去试镜，而要专注于解决问题，而不是拿下工作。
why_zh: HN 把它套用到求职面试和自信上，推荐不要从绝望的位置去面试的心态。
summary: A one-minute clip of Bryan Cranston at an Academy new-member reception, advising actors to approach auditions without desperation and focus on solving the problem rather than landing the job.
why_hn: HN applies it to job interviews and confidence, recommending the mindset of not interviewing from a place of desperation.

title: Threads (1984) ORIGINAL TRAILER [HD 1080p]
title_zh: 《Threads》（1984）原版预告片 [HD 1080p]
summary_zh: 这是 1984 年英国电视电影《Threads》的原版预告片，影片描绘核攻击后谢菲尔德的惨状，基调阴郁。预告片也暗示了整部作品令人压抑的氛围。
why_zh: HN 用户借此把人们引向《Threads》，称它是对核战争最令人揪心的描绘，认为应列为必看。
summary: The original trailer for Threads, the 1984 British TV film depicting the aftermath of a nuclear attack on Sheffield. The trailer hints at the film's bleak tone.
why_hn: HN commenters use it to point people to Threads, which they call the most harrowing depiction of nuclear war and say should be mandatory viewing.

title: TigerStyle! (Or How To Design Safer Systems in Less Time) by Joran Dirk Greef
title_zh: TigerStyle！（或如何用更少时间设计更安全的系统）—— Joran Dirk Greef
summary_zh: Joran Dirk Greef 在 Systems Distributed '23 介绍 TigerBeetle 背后的工程方法 TigerStyle，强调前期设计、断言和确定性模拟，以更少时间构建更安全的系统。
why_zh: HN 用户（包括 TigerBeetle 团队成员）推荐它，认为它清晰阐述了一种构建无缺陷、高保障软件的方法。
summary: Joran Dirk Greef's Systems Distributed '23 talk on TigerStyle, the engineering methodology behind TigerBeetle. It covers designing safer systems in less time through up-front design, assertions, and deterministic simulation.
why_hn: HN commenters, including TigerBeetle people, recommend it as the explanation of a methodology for building defect-free, high-assurance software.

title: Jancovici : Can we save energy, jobs and growth at the same time ? 08/01/2018
title_zh: Jancovici：我们能否同时保住能源、就业和增长？2018/01/08
summary_zh: Jean-Marc Jancovici 在巴黎高师演讲，讨论能源使用、就业与增长能否兼得；他从物理学视角审视经济，认为资源枯竭和气候限制使永续 GDP 增长不现实。
why_zh: 推荐为一份冷静、基于物理学的说明，解释能源如何构成经济的基础。
summary: Jean-Marc Jancovici lectures at ENS Paris on whether energy use, jobs and growth can all be preserved. He argues for a physical approach to economics, since resource depletion and climate limits make perpetual GDP growth unrealistic.
why_hn: Recommended as a sober, physics-based account of how energy underlies the economy.

title: The Inner Life of the Cell Animation
title_zh: 细胞内部生活动画
summary_zh: XVIVO 为哈佛 BioVisions 制作的获奖 3D 动画，展示白细胞响应刺激时细胞内部的分子机器。
why_zh: 推荐它是因为它令人惊叹地呈现了细胞的复杂性和机器般的运作方式。
summary: An award-winning 3D animation by XVIVO for Harvard's BioVisions showing the molecular machinery inside a cell as a white blood cell responds to a stimulus.
why_hn: Recommended as a jaw-dropping view of the complexity and machine-like nature of cells.

title: Eric Bier Demonstrates Cedar
title_zh: Eric Bier 演示 Cedar
summary_zh: PARC 研究科学家 Eric Bier 演示 Cedar 集成编程环境与语言——Xerox PARC 的 Mesa 演进版，展示 Tioga 编辑器、垃圾回收和完整的图形工作站环境。
why_zh: HN 反复引用它，证明数十年前基于 GC 的系统语言和集成工作站已多么先进，也把它当作桌面 OS 可达到何种程度的范例。
summary: Eric Bier, a PARC research scientist, demonstrates the Cedar integrated programming environment and language, an evolution of Mesa from Xerox PARC. The demo shows the Tioga editor, garbage collection, and a full graphical workstation environment.
why_hn: HN keeps citing it as proof of how advanced a GC-based systems language and integrated workstation were decades ago, and as a model for what desktop OSes could be.

title: Floyd Toole - Sound reproduction – art and science/opinions and facts
title_zh: Floyd Toole——声音重放：艺术与科学/观点与事实
summary_zh: Floyd Toole 在 CIRMMT 杰出讲座中讲述声音重放科学，基于数十年盲听研究，讨论听众偏好何种音箱，以及测量准确度和消声响应为何重要。
why_zh: HN 推荐它作为声音重放科学的速成课，尤其是盲测中听众稳定偏好更准确音箱这一发现。
summary: Floyd Toole's CIRMMT distinguished lecture on the science of sound reproduction, drawing on decades of blind listening research. It covers what listeners prefer in loudspeakers and why measured accuracy and anechoic response matter.
why_hn: HN recommends it as a crash course on audio reproduction science, especially the finding that listeners reliably prefer more accurate speakers in blind tests.

title: How to Invent the Future II - Stanford CS183F: Startup School
title_zh: 如何发明未来 II——斯坦福 CS183F：创业学校
summary_zh: Alan Kay 在斯坦福创业学校讲座第二部分谈发明未来，结合他在 Xerox PARC 等地的经历，讨论如何思考新技术以及什么让想法有用。
why_zh: 在 Ask HN 关于寻找创意、创造力以及 Xerox 等 incumbent 为何错失自己发明的讨论中常被推荐。
summary: Part two of Alan Kay's Stanford Startup School lecture on inventing the future. He draws on his time at Xerox PARC and elsewhere to discuss how to think about new technology and what makes ideas useful.
why_hn: Frequently suggested in Ask HN threads on finding ideas, creativity and why incumbents like Xerox missed what they invented.

title: Using a 1930 Teletype as a Linux Terminal
title_zh: 用 1930 年的 Teletype 作为 Linux 终端
summary_zh: CuriousMarc 将修复的 1930 年 Model 15 Teletype 连接到 Linux 机器并用作终端，展示把 5 位机械设备接入现代 OS 的挑战。
why_zh: HN 用户喜欢它，因为它生动展示终端历史，解释 ed 等工具和 tty 回显模型为何如此工作。
summary: CuriousMarc connects a restored 1930 Model 15 Teletype to a Linux machine and uses it as a terminal, after commenters requested it. The video shows the challenges of linking a 5-bit mechanical device to a modern OS.
why_hn: HN commenters love it as a vivid demonstration of terminal history, explaining why tools like ed and the tty echo model work the way they do.

title: The first 20 hours -- how to learn anything | Josh Kaufman | TEDxCSU
title_zh: 最初 20 小时——如何学会任何事 | Josh Kaufman | TEDxCSU
summary_zh: Josh Kaufman 的 TEDx 演讲认为，约 20 小时专注练习就能在几乎任何技能上达到实用水平，而非常被引用的 1 万小时；他讲述成为父母如何促使自己重新思考成人学习，并给出快速技能习得方法。
why_zh: HN 用它作为对 1 万小时定律的标准反例，也是鼓励人们开始新技能的实用配方。
summary: Josh Kaufman's TEDx talk argues that you can reach practical competence in almost any skill with about 20 hours of focused practice, rather than the 10,000 hours often quoted. He describes how becoming a parent led him to rethink how adults learn, and lays out a short method for rapid skill acquisition.
why_hn: HN uses it as the standard counterpoint to the 10,000-hour rule and as an encouraging recipe for starting new skills.

title: Over 200,000 Servers in One Place! Visiting Hetzner in Falkenstein (Germany)
title_zh: 20 多万台服务器在一处！探访德国 Falkenstein 的 Hetzner
summary_zh: 超频玩家 der8auer 参观 Hetzner 位于德国 Falkenstein 的数据中心，展示定制机架、自研主板、被动散热服务器以及架上的 ATX 式机箱。
why_zh: 每当 Hetzner 被提起，HN 就指向它，认为这是了解其独特、半定制且低成本数据中心配置的最佳窗口。
summary: Overclocker der8auer tours Hetzner's Falkenstein data center in Germany, showing custom racks, own mainboards, passively cooled servers and ATX-style cases on shelves.
why_hn: HN points to it whenever Hetzner comes up, as the best look inside their unusual, semi-custom and low-cost data center setup.

title: Java on a 1000 Cores - Tales of Hardware / Software CoDesign
title_zh: 1000 核上的 Java——硬件/软件协同设计的故事
summary_zh: Azul Systems 的 Cliff Click 在 Google Tech Talk 讲述如何在大约一千核的机器上运行 Java 业务应用，涵盖软硬件协同设计，包括垃圾回收硬件和 JIT。
why_zh: HN 认为 Cliff Click 的演讲是了解 JVM、垃圾回收和硬件辅助 Java 的极佳来源。
summary: Cliff Click of Azul Systems gives a Google Tech Talk on running Java business applications on a machine with about a thousand cores. He covers hardware and software codesign, including garbage collection hardware and the JIT.
why_hn: HN treats Cliff Click's talks as an excellent source on JVMs, garbage collection and hardware-assisted Java.

title: Ivan Sutherland Sketchpad Demo 1963
title_zh: Ivan Sutherland 的 Sketchpad 演示（1963）
summary_zh: 电视节目介绍 Ivan Sutherland 1963 年 MIT 论文软件 Sketchpad，它运行在 TX-2 计算机上，展示光笔绘图、约束、吸附、缩放和面向对象式图形，奠定 GUI 与 CAD 基础。
why_zh: HN 一再回到它，因为它有力证明 GUI、CAD 和约束编程的核心思想在 1960 年代就已存在。
summary: A TV show about Ivan Sutherland's 1963 MIT thesis software Sketchpad, which ran on the TX-2 computer. It shows a light pen drawing, constraints, snapping, scaling and object-style graphics, foundations of GUIs and CAD.
why_hn: HN returns to it as a striking demonstration that core GUI, CAD and constraint-programming ideas existed in the 1960s.

title: Bryan Cantrill from Joyent on Manta: internet-facing object storage facility that features compute
title_zh: Joyent 的 Bryan Cantrill 谈 Manta：面向互联网、带计算能力的对象存储设施
summary_zh: Joyent 的 Bryan Cantrill 介绍 Manta——一种面向互联网的对象存储，可直接在数据上运行计算；演讲穿插 ZFS 历史和 Cantrill 标志性的行业评论。
why_zh: HN 普遍推荐 Cantrill 的演讲，因其融合行业历史、技术深度和娱乐性表达，这一场在存储与数据完整性讨论中尤受青睐。
summary: Bryan Cantrill of Joyent presents Manta, an internet-facing object store that lets you run compute directly on the data. The talk is peppered with ZFS history and Cantrill's trademark commentary on the industry.
why_hn: HN recommends Cantrill talks generally for their mix of industry history, technical depth and entertaining delivery, and this one is a favorite for storage and data integrity threads.

title: DEF CON 23 - Chris Rock - I Will Kill You
title_zh: DEF CON 23——Chris Rock：我会杀了你
summary_zh: DEF CON 23 演讲展示电子死亡登记系统控制薄弱，可让人在虚拟世界“杀死”某人并获得真实死亡证明，进而影响其身份与生活。
why_zh: 每当出现伪造死亡、身份验证或记录欺诈话题，HN 就反复推荐它，称赞攻击之容易令人震惊。
summary: A DEF CON 23 talk showing how weak controls in electronic death registration systems let someone virtually kill a person and obtain a real death certificate, with consequences for their identity and life.
why_hn: HN repeatedly recommends it whenever fake deaths, identity verification or records fraud come up, praising how easy the attack seemed.

title: Where in the world is it easiest to get rich? | Harald Eia | TEDxOslo
title_zh: 世界上哪里最容易致富？| Harald Eia | TEDxOslo
summary_zh: 社会学家兼喜剧演员 Harald Eia 在 TEDxOslo 演讲中提出，北欧社会民主国家人均产生的富人比美英更多；他将原因归于高税收、福利和强大工会带来的安全网，使人们敢于冒险。
why_zh: HN 在福利国家、社会流动性和创业精神辩论中，把它当作一个反直觉的数据点。
summary: Sociologist and comedian Harald Eia argues in a TEDxOslo talk that Nordic social democracies produce more rich people per capita than the US or UK. He credits high taxes, welfare and strong unions for creating a safety net that enables risk taking.
why_hn: HN uses it as a counterintuitive data point in debates on welfare states, social mobility and entrepreneurship.

title: Classic Game Postmortem: Sid Meier's Civilization
title_zh: 经典游戏复盘：Sid Meier's Civilization
summary_zh: 2017 年 GDC 复盘，Sid Meier 和 Bruce Shelley 讲述 Civilization 如何从桌游设计与模拟游戏经验中成型，并讨论其开发历程与设计决策，包括公平性和运气。
why_zh: HN 推荐它，因为它精彩讲述了 Civilization 的诞生，并提供了关于游戏设计中感知公平性的资料。
summary: A 2017 GDC postmortem in which Sid Meier and Bruce Shelley tell how Civilization came together from board game design and sim game experience. They cover its development history and design decisions, including fairness and luck.
why_hn: HN recommends it as a great account of how Civilization was made and as a source on perceived fairness in game design.

title: "Controlling Time and Space: understanding the many formulations of FRP" by Evan Czaplicki
title_zh: Evan Czaplicki：Controlling Time and Space——理解 FRP 的多种表述
summary_zh: Evan Czaplicki 在 Strange Loop 2014 的演讲梳理了函数式响应式编程（FRP）的多种表述及其历史与理论关联，并展示 Elm 的变体如何支持热替换和时间旅行调试器。
why_zh: HN 认为这是解释 FRP 到底指什么、各流派有何差异的最清晰讲解。
summary: Evan Czaplicki's Strange Loop 2014 talk surveys the many formulations of functional reactive programming and how they relate historically and theoretically. It then shows how Elm's variant enables hot-swapping and its time-traveling debugger.
why_hn: HN people point to it as the clearest explanation of what FRP actually means and how its flavors differ.

title: Stanford Lecture: Don Knuth—"A Conjecture That Had To Be True" (2017)
title_zh: Stanford 讲座：Don Knuth——A Conjecture That Had To Be True（2017）
summary_zh: Donald Knuth 在 2017 年 Stanford 圣诞树讲座中讲述一个组合几何问题：计算出的数字与一个惊人公式吻合，他回顾了该猜想的提出与后续发展。
why_zh: HN 喜爱它，因为 Knuth 的幽默以及他把开放数学问题讲得平易近人，也常引用其中关于 dancing links 和矩形剖分计数的细节。
summary: Donald Knuth's 2017 Christmas Tree Lecture at Stanford about a combinatorial geometry problem whose computed numbers matched a striking formula. He tells the story of the conjecture and its sequel.
why_hn: HN fans love it for Knuth's humor and for how he makes open math problems feel approachable, and it is often cited for details like dancing links and counting rectangle subdivisions.

title: Taking Vector Transposes Seriously | Jiahao Chen | JuliaCon 2017
title_zh: 认真对待向量转置——Jiahao Chen 在 JuliaCon 2017
summary_zh: Jiahao Chen 在 JuliaCon 2017 的演讲主张在类型系统和线性代数库中认真对待向量转置，并解释把向量当作矩阵为何会在编程语言中引发麻烦。
why_zh: 对任何处理向量的人强烈推荐，因为它清晰阐述了向量在类型中应如何处理。
summary: Jiahao Chen's JuliaCon 2017 talk argues that vector transposes should be taken seriously in type systems and linear algebra libraries. It explains why treating vectors as matrices causes trouble in languages.
why_hn: Strongly recommended for anyone working with vectors for its clear take on how they should be treated in types.

title: Pete Hunt: React - Rethinking Best Practices (updated) - JSConf.Asia 2013
title_zh: Pete Hunt：React——重新思考最佳实践（更新版）— JSConf.Asia 2013
summary_zh: Facebook 和 Instagram 的 Pete Hunt 在 JSConf.Asia 2013 介绍 React 的设计原则，以及这些原则起初为何显得惊世骇俗。他主张 React 分离的是关注点而非技术，演讲中还发布了 React Chrome 开发者工具。
why_zh: HN 评论者称它说服自己采用 React，并引用其中“HTML 与 JS 无法真正分离”的论点。
summary: Pete Hunt of Facebook and Instagram presents React at JSConf.Asia 2013, explaining its design principles and why they seemed shocking at first. He argues that React separates concerns rather than technologies, and the talk also announces the React Chrome developer tools.
why_hn: HN commenters credit it with persuading them to adopt React, and cite it for the argument that HTML and JS cannot truly be separated.

title: A Sudoku Solver in APL
title_zh: 用 APL 写数独求解器
summary_zh: 一段 Dyalog 演示，展示如何用 APL 开发数独求解器，采用 Arthur Whitney 的算法并由 John Scholes 做性能优化。旁白逐步讲解这种面向数组的解法。
why_zh: 强烈推荐，因为它漂亮地证明了 APL 可以一步步阅读和推理。
summary: A Dyalog demonstration of developing a Sudoku solver in APL, using an algorithm by Arthur Whitney with performance work by John Scholes. The narration steps through the array-oriented solution.
why_hn: Strongly recommended as a beautiful demonstration that APL can be read and reasoned about step by step.

title: Can C++ be 10x Simpler & Safer?  - Herb Sutter - CppCon 2022
title_zh: C++ 能否简单安全 10 倍？——Herb Sutter 在 CppCon 2022
summary_zh: Herb Sutter 在 CppCon 2022 探讨 C++ 能否变得十倍简单、十倍安全，介绍实验性的 Cpp2 语法和 cppfront 转译器，并解释渐进式改进的局限。
why_zh: HN 推荐它作为 Cpp2 与 cppfront 的主要入门介绍，也是演进 C++ 的可信努力。
summary: Herb Sutter's CppCon 2022 talk on whether C++ can become ten times simpler and safer. He introduces his experimental Cpp2 syntax and the cppfront transpiler, explaining the limits on incremental improvement.
why_hn: HN recommends it as the main introduction to Cpp2 and cppfront, and as a credible effort to evolve C++.
categories: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

title: Advanced Topics in Programming Languages: A Lock-Free Hash Table
title_zh: 编程语言高级主题：无锁哈希表
summary_zh: 2007 年 Google Tech Talk，Azul Systems 的 Cliff Click 介绍一个可扩展到 768 个 CPU 的无锁并发哈希表。他解释为何其正确性需要用不同于常规 happens-before 与内存序论证的方式来推理。
why_zh: HN 视其为最佳技术演讲之一，深入而清晰地讲解了基于比较并交换（compare-and-swap）的可扩展无锁哈希表。
summary: A 2007 Google Tech Talk in which Cliff Click of Azul Systems presents a lock-free concurrent hash table that scales to 768 CPUs. He explains why it is correct by reasoning in a different way than usual happens-before and memory-order arguments.
why_hn: HN regards it as one of the best technical talks, a deep and clear walkthrough of scalable lock-free hash tables built on compare-and-swap.

title: Margin Call (2011) - Senior Partners Emergency Meeting [HD 1080p] (Re-Upload / Audio Fixed)
title_zh: 《Margin Call》（2011）——高级合伙人紧急会议 [HD 1080p]（重传/音频修复）
summary_zh: 2011 年电影《Margin Call》片段：高级合伙人在紧急会议上决定立即抛售有毒资产，背景设定在 2008 年金融危机开端。
why_zh: HN 引用该场景作为清晰果断沟通和领导者迅速行动求生的典范，并推荐这部电影为对 2008 年的最佳诠释。
summary: A clip from the 2011 film Margin Call in which senior partners hold an emergency meeting and decide to sell off toxic assets immediately. It is set at the start of the 2008 financial crisis.
why_hn: HN cites the scene as a model of clear, decisive communication and of leaders acting fast to survive, and recommends the film as the best take on 2008.

title: Interactive notebooks ~ Pluto.jl | Fons van der Plas | JuliaCon 2020
title_zh: 交互式 notebook ~ Pluto.jl | Fons van der Plas | JuliaCon 2020
summary_zh: Fons van der Plas 介绍 Pluto.jl——面向 Julia 的响应式 notebook，它追踪单元格之间的引用，并在代码变化时重新运行受影响的单元格。该演讲来自 JuliaCon 2020。
why_zh: HN 推荐它，因为它热情展示了类似电子表格的响应式 notebook，评论者认为新的 notebook 项目应当效仿。
summary: Fons van der Plas introduces Pluto.jl, a reactive notebook for Julia that tracks references between cells and re-runs affected cells when code changes. The talk was given at JuliaCon 2020.
why_hn: HN recommends it as an enthusiastic demo of spreadsheet-like reactive notebooks, which commenters think new notebook projects should copy.

title: Object-Oriented Programming is Embarrassing: 4 Short Examples
title_zh: 面向对象编程令人尴尬：四个简短例子
summary_zh: Brian Will 延续此前反 OOP 的视频，通过四个简短代码示例（包括 Uncle Bob 风格的 Java 代码）展示面向对象设计如何把简单程序复杂化。他主张 OOP 隐藏并分散状态，还增加了不必要的间接层。
why_zh: HN 评论者指出它是针对 OOP 和 Clean Code 风格的尖锐、以例子驱动的批评，常与 Brian Will 其他反面向对象视频一起提及。
summary: Brian Will follows up his earlier anti-OOP video by walking through four short code examples, including Java code in the style of Uncle Bob, to show how object-oriented design complicates simple programs. It argues that OOP hides and scatters state and adds needless indirection.
why_hn: HN commenters point to it as a sharp, example-driven critique of OOP and Clean Code style, often alongside Brian Will's other anti-OO videos.

title: Bret Weinstein on "The Portal" (w/ host Eric Weinstein), Ep. #019 - The Prediction and the DISC.
title_zh: Bret Weinstein 做客 The Portal（主持人 Eric Weinstein）第 019 期——The Prediction and the DISC
summary_zh: 一期很长的 The Portal 播客，Bret Weinstein 向 Eric Weinstein 讲述其实验室小鼠端粒研究的故事、背后的预测，以及这对科学与衰老意味着什么。
why_zh: HN 推荐它作为关于实验室小鼠问题和癌症与长寿之间演化权衡的完整叙述，尽管节目很长。
summary: A long Portal podcast episode in which Bret Weinstein tells Eric Weinstein the story of his lab mice telomere work, the prediction behind it, and what it means for science and aging.
why_hn: HN recommends it as the full account of the lab mice issue and evolutionary tradeoffs between cancer and longevity, despite its length.

title: You Suck at Excel - Joel Spolsky (Reupload)
title_zh: 你 Excel 用得很烂——Joel Spolsky（重传）
summary_zh: Joel Spolsky 演讲的重传版，教表格用户很可能错过的 Excel 功能，如键盘导航、命名区域、表格和查找。原版已消失，此副本来自 Wayback Machine。
why_zh: HN 评论者称它是互联网经典，能让你更熟练使用 Excel，并指出尽管它早于 XLOOKUP 等新函数，仍然相关。
summary: A reupload of Joel Spolsky's talk teaching spreadsheet users the Excel features they are probably missing, such as keyboard navigation, named ranges, tables and lookups. The original disappeared and this copy comes from the Wayback Machine.
why_hn: HN commenters call it an internet classic that makes you a more proficient Excel user, and note it is still relevant despite predating newer functions like XLOOKUP.

title: Michael Stonebraker | Big Data is (at least) Four Different Problems
title_zh: Michael Stonebraker | 大数据至少是四个不同的问题
summary_zh: 数据库先驱 Michael Stonebraker 主张“大数据”实际上至少是四个不同问题：大体量小分析、大分析、速度和多样性。他评论了每个市场的走向。
why_zh: HN 指出它来自图灵奖得主，是深思熟虑、从第一性原理出发的见解，能穿透 NoSQL 和大数据炒作。
summary: Database pioneer Michael Stonebraker argues that 'big data' is really at least four different problems: big volumes with small analytics, big analytics, velocity, and variety. He comments on where each market is heading.
why_hn: HN points to it as a thoughtful, first-principles take from a Turing award winner that cuts through NoSQL and big data hype.

title: We WILL Fix Climate Change!
title_zh: 我们终将解决气候变化！
summary_zh: Kurzgesagt 的动画观点认为，尽管新闻标题令人担忧，但随着技术、政策和公众态度转变，确有理由保持希望。它综述趋势与解决方案，同时承认问题规模。
why_zh: HN 评论者推荐它作为对气候末日论的清晰而振奋的反驳，不过一位批评者称其为某种否认主义，另一位指出它忽略了核能。
summary: Kurzgesagt's animated take on climate change argues that, despite alarming headlines, there are real reasons for hope as technology, policy and public attitudes shift. It surveys trends and solutions while acknowledging the scale of the problem.
why_hn: HN commenters recommend it as an articulate, uplifting counterweight to climate doomerism, though one critic calls it a form of denialism and another notes it omits nuclear.

title: CppCon 2017: Carl Cook “When a Microsecond Is an Eternity: High Performance Trading Systems in C++”
title_zh: CppCon 2017：Carl Cook《当一微秒漫长得如同永恒：用 C++ 构建高性能交易系统》
summary_zh: Optiver 的 Carl Cook 讲解如何用 C++ 构建高频交易系统：关键路径很少被走到，但一旦走到就必须极快完成。他介绍了实现低延迟且延迟可预测的一系列技巧，包括如何避免访问主存和缓存未命中。
why_zh: HN 上多次被推荐为低延迟交易工程领域最好的综述。
summary: Optiver's Carl Cook explains how to build high-frequency trading systems in C++, where the critical path runs rarely but must be extremely fast. He covers techniques for low and predictable latency, including avoiding main memory and cache misses.
why_hn: HN repeatedly points people to it as the best overview of low-latency trading engineering.
categories: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

title: Arithmetic, Population and Energy -  a talk by Al Bartlett
title_zh: 算术、人口与能源——Al Bartlett 的演讲
summary_zh: 物理学家 Al Bartlett 关于指数增长算术的著名讲座，并将其应用于人口、能源消耗与资源枯竭。他认为在有限的星球上持续百分比增长无法维系，而大多数公共讨论都忽视了这一点。
why_zh: HN 评论者称它是改变自己世界观的指数增长入门，也有人指出他对石油峰值的预测并未成真。
summary: Physicist Al Bartlett's well-known lecture on the arithmetic of exponential growth, applied to population, energy consumption and resource depletion. He argues that steady percentage growth cannot be sustained on a finite planet and that most public discussion ignores this.
why_hn: HN commenters cite it as a mind-changing introduction to exponential growth, though some note his peak oil predictions did not pan out.

title: The 919 Tribute Tour: On-board record lap, Nordschleife.
title_zh: 919 Tribute Tour：纽博格林北环赛道车载纪录圈
summary_zh: Timo Bernhard 驾驶保时捷 919 Hybrid Evo 跑出纽博格林北环 5 分 19 秒的历史最快纪录圈，全程为车载视角。
why_zh: HN 将它视为圈速纪录的标杆，并推荐即使不是车迷也值得一看，因为其速度与精准度极为震撼。
summary: Onboard footage of Timo Bernhard driving the Porsche 919 Hybrid Evo to an all-time Nurburgring Nordschleife record lap of 5:19.
why_hn: HN cites it as the benchmark lap record and recommends it even to non-car fans for its sheer speed and precision.

title: Cracking Ancient Codes: Cuneiform Writing - with Irving Finkel
title_zh: 破解古代密码：楔形文字——Irving Finkel 主讲
summary_zh: 大英博物馆的 Irving Finkel 在英国皇家学会讲述美索不达米亚楔形文字的发明与破译过程，以及它为何如此难以翻译。
why_zh: HN 用户推荐它，称其生动有趣地讲述了楔形文字的起源与破解历程。
summary: Irving Finkel of the British Museum lectures at the Royal Institution on the invention and decipherment of cuneiform writing in Mesopotamia, and why it is so hard to translate.
why_hn: HN users recommend it as a delightful, well-told account of how cuneiform developed and was decoded.

title: "I See What You Mean" by Peter Alvaro
title_zh: Peter Alvaro《我明白你的意思》
summary_zh: Peter Alvaro 在 Strange Loop 2015 的演讲主张查询语言让你直接陈述“意图”，并把这一思路延伸到分布式编程。内容涵盖 Datalog、Dedalus 以及 Bloom 一脉用于推理分布式系统的工作。
why_zh: 被推荐为了解声明式编程、基于 Datalog 的分布式系统与故障建模的绝佳入门。
summary: Peter Alvaro's Strange Loop 2015 talk argues that query languages let you state what you mean, and applies that to distributed programming. It covers Datalog, Dedalus and the Bloom lineage for reasoning about distributed systems.
why_hn: Recommended as a fantastic introduction to declarative and Datalog-based distributed systems and failure modeling.

title: ORCA Sequencer Intro (Experimental Livecoding!)
title_zh: ORCA 音序器入门（实验性现场编程！）
summary_zh: Allieway Audio 对 ORCA 做了非正式的介绍与现场编程演示——这是 Hundred Rabbits 出品的一款免费、风格奇特的编程环境，用来搭建过程式音序器。视频带观众过了一遍界面操作，演示如何用它做音乐。
why_zh: HN 评论者称它是对 Orca 最好的视频讲解，能让人一下子看懂这套古怪界面。
summary: Allieway Audio gives an informal introduction and live-coding demo of ORCA, a free esoteric programming environment for building procedural sequencers from Hundred Rabbits. It walks through the interface and how to make music with it.
why_hn: HN commenters call it the best video overview of Orca, the explanation that makes the unusual interface click.

title: The REAL Reason McDonalds Ice Cream Machines Are Always Broken
title_zh: 麦当劳冰淇淋机总是坏掉的真正原因
summary_zh: Johnny Harris 调查麦当劳冰淇淋机为何频繁故障，涉及 Taylor 机器、对加盟商的维修限制以及 Kytch 外接设备。
why_zh: 在“维修权”和麦旋风机器相关的讨论帖中，HN 都会贴出它，作为关于加盟商与 Taylor 关系最深入的解释。
topic: right to repair and mcdonalds ice cream machines
summary: Johnny Harris investigates why McDonald's ice cream machines are so often broken, covering the Taylor machines, the repair restrictions on franchisees and the Kytch workaround device.
why_hn: HN links it in right-to-repair and McFlurry-machine threads as the go-to in-depth explainer of the franchisee and Taylor arrangement.

title: The Spectacular Failure of the Star Wars Hotel
title_zh: 星球大战酒店的大溃败
summary_zh: Jenny Nicholson 用约四小时回顾她在迪士尼“星球大战：银河星际巡洋舰”沉浸式酒店的两晚住宿。她详细拆解了这段体验、剧情与制作，以及它失败的原因。
why_zh: HN 用户强烈推荐它作为了解银河星际巡洋舰的最佳综述，也是利益错位与糟糕体验的案例研究，虽长但引人入胜。
summary: Jenny Nicholson's roughly four-hour review of her two-night stay on Disney's Star Wars Galactic Starcruiser immersive hotel. She goes through the experience, its story and production, and why it failed.
why_hn: HN people strongly recommend it as the best overview of the Galactic Starcruiser and a case study in misaligned incentives and poor guest experience, engaging despite its length.

title: Distributed Systems 1.1: Introduction
title_zh: 分布式系统 1.1：导论
summary_zh: 剑桥大学本科课程中 Martin Kleppmann 八讲分布式系统系列的第一讲，介绍这门学科，并配有讲义。
why_zh: HN 经常推荐这个系列，认为它免费、易懂、偏重理论，可与他的《数据密集型应用系统设计》互补。
summary: The first lecture in Martin Kleppmann's 8-lecture distributed systems series from the University of Cambridge undergraduate course. It introduces the subject, and accompanying lecture notes are available.
why_hn: HN regularly recommends the series as a free, accessible, theory-oriented course on distributed computing that complements his book Designing Data-Intensive Applications.

title: Tom Scott vs Irving Finkel: The Royal Game of Ur | PLAYTHROUGH | International Tabletop Day 2017
title_zh: Tom Scott vs Irving Finkel：乌尔王族棋 | PLAYTHROUGH | 2017 国际桌游日
summary_zh: Tom Scott 与从楔形文字泥板中破译规则的英国博物馆策展人 Irving Finkel 对弈乌尔王族棋。Finkel 一边教规则，一边讲解这款现存最古老的可玩棋盘游戏的历史。
why_zh: 在关于古代游戏和楔形文字的讨论中，人们推荐它，称这是一场与热情专家同乐的可爱对局。
summary: Tom Scott plays the Royal Game of Ur against British Museum curator Irving Finkel, who deciphered its rules from a cuneiform tablet. Finkel teaches the game and explains its history as the oldest playable board game.
why_hn: Recommended in threads on ancient games and cuneiform as a charming match with an enthusiastic expert.

title: What does it feel like to invent math?
title_zh: 发明数学是一种怎样的体验？
summary_zh: 3Blue1Brown 从收敛到发散的无穷级数讲起，并引入 2-adic 度量，围绕“发现数学”与“发明数学”之间的循环展开。
why_zh: 被推荐为 Grant Sanderson 最受欢迎的作品之一，也是 p 进数与 1+2+4+… 这类求和的直观入门。
summary: 3Blue1Brown explores infinite sums from convergent to divergent, with an introduction to the 2-adic metric, themed on the cycle between discovering and inventing mathematics.
why_hn: Recommended as a favorite Grant Sanderson video and a visual introduction to p-adic numbers and sums like 1+2+4+...

title: How I Designed a Free Music Font for 5 Million Musicians (MuseScore 3.6)
title_zh: 我如何为 500 万音乐人设计一款免费乐谱字体（MuseScore 3.6）
summary_zh: Tantacrul 讲述他与制谱师 Simon Smith 如何为 MuseScore 3.6 设计免费的记谱字体，并追溯了 Leland Smith 开发的 SCORE 记谱软件的历史。
why_zh: HN 推荐它，认为它以有趣的方式展示了制作记谱字体有多难，也常在音乐制谱与开源相关讨论中被提起。
summary: Tantacrul explains how he and engraver Simon Smith designed the free music notation font for MuseScore 3.6. It draws on the history of the SCORE notation application by Leland Smith.
why_hn: HN recommends it as an entertaining look at how hard notation fonts are to make, and it comes up in threads on music engraving and open source.
